44zheca la ma sa sa ——— —— shā —— sgyu chi.āo po'irnagarab stsolapa/snyi 97'angs 'datshos ldebarngam992sgoga.i 'a ༄tso'adzin nas ma ragatermu chung༄rna sa tswadu — go.astonadagagibya bsnye mi' mas rigasaragyi dar 'dzin gnas ga/2①kyisgor tsos rka ri'ajigasaragyirabatsholagodzog rna 'a —btab rmi/20lkor tsos rkaji sto rig phyogadanganagakrung lugs7risaslobarag〉 rna4gye'ajagatso rabago ga slobasami lgo chod des rnam 'the rtingadu sas i chadang gsas i lagakro'u'ajiga'ajig rnamus sngasabs gsazhoradus dngasanang gidusadebacadzorshatso sa〉rtsong2①'arang〉kyitsā bababa'ajiganya sto0gye tsā khogopa ribadapes la 'dus
gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/mgon po skyabasakyisabacoms/mirigasadachaskrunakhung /

nang don gnad bsdus/gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom 'di'i brjod snying gtso bo ni deng skabs dar che ba'i nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i dbyi kun nad 'dir gcig nas gso rig gzhung lugs gzhan gyi khrod na gso bcos kyi thabs med pa dang / gnyis nas bod lugs sman pa gang mang zhig gis nad gzhi 'dir zhib 'jug gnang dang gnang mus su mchis rkyen der bod lugs gso rig gi lam nas ngos 'dzin yang gang mang bgyis mod/dernams ni 'phen bya'i mda' mo 'ben du phog med pa'i tshor snang zhig yang yang ster/ gsum nas rang nyid kyis rang re'i bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa gzhir bzung nas nad gzhi 'di'i rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul/ nad rtags bcas rtsal du bton nas dbye zhib bgyis mthar/ nad 'di gnyan nad kyi khongs su 'du ba'i blo zhig 'gog med du thon pa bcas la brten nas dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri ba'i las la zhugs pa yin/ de yang nad gzhi 'di gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro ba dang mang che ba'i mchin gnas su zhugs shing rgyas par byed pas na/ le'u dang por mchin pa'i ngo bo dang gnas lugs tsam ches mdor bsdus su bkod yod/ nad gzhi 'di gnyan nad kyi khongs su 'du tshe thog mar dris phog yams thabs mched nas 'gos 'gro ba'i gnyan rims la rgyus mnga' bar bya rgyu ni skabs 'dir g.yol thabs med pa'i las shig dang / lhag par gnyan dang rims zhes nad gzhi de gnyis kyi dbye ba zhig kyang shes dgos pas/ le'u gnyis pa ru gnyan ri~Xs

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gnyis kyi so so'i rgyu rkyen dang ngo bo/ brda don/ de gnyis kyi dbye ba sogs rang blos dpog tshod kyis cung rgyas bshad du bkod yod/ gzhung lugs gnyis bsdur dpyod bya dgos na phyogs/ gnyis kyi lugs la rgyus mnga' yod par bya rgyu ni ha cang gis gal che bas/ le'u gsum pa ru thengs 'dir bsdur dpyod du mkho ba'i nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i dbyi kun nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul sogs kyang phran tsam zhig bkod yod/ rtsom pa'i las su gzhol na rang lugs 'thad ldan du 'dzin rgyu zhig dgos pa ni bod snga rabs pa'i srol yin la/ de lta bu'i lta ba zhig med na brtsams chos der sgos snying dben/der brten le'u bzhi ba ru nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i dbyi kun nad la nye'im bod lugs gso rig tu ngos 'dzin gnang ba skor zhig cung mi 'tsham pas de'i skor gzhan lugs dgag pa'i sde tshan du bcug cing / rang gis nad gzhi 'di gnyan nad kyi khongs su gtogs par 'dod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams rang lugs 'thad ldan du 'jog pa'i sde tshan du bcug nas bkod yod/le'u lnga ba ru rang gis bod lugs gso rig gi khrod nas ngos 'dzin byas pa'i nad gzhi 'di'i rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul/ nad rtags/ bcos thabs rnams bkod yod la/ lhag par bcos thabs su gzhung lugs kho nar gzhi bcol nas ma bzhag par rang gis myong ba'i nad thog lag len dngos dang sbrag nas bris shing de'i bcos skyed kyi phan 'bras la spyi bsdoms kyang rgyab yod/

dkar chagathog mar dge ba klad0 don/ ( 1 )dang po/ mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/ ( 1 )gnyis pa/ dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri dgos don bshad pa/ ( 3 )1 zhib 'jug gi dgos pa/ ( 3 )2 zhib 'jug gi thabs lam ( 6 )3 zhib 'jug khrod 'phrad pa'i dka' gnad/ ( 7 )bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ ( 9 )le'u dang po/ mchin pa'i gnas lugs dang ja bo bshad pa/ ( 9 )dang po/ mchin pa'i gnas bshad pa/ ( 9 )gnyis pa/ mchin pa'i byed las bshad pa/ (11)le'u gnyis pa/ gnyan rims bshad pa/ (17)dang po/ rims bshad pa/ (17)1 rims nad kyi rgyu bshad pa/ (17)2 rims nad kyi rkyen bshad pa/ (21)3 rims nad kyi ngo bo dang brda don bshad pa/ (23)gnyis pa/ gnyan bshad pa/ (25)1 gnyan nad kyi rgyu bshad pa/ (26)ri gnyan nad kyi rkyen bshad pa/ (31)3 gnyan nad kyi ngo bo dang brda don bshad pa/ (32)

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gsum pa/ gnyan dang rims kyi khyad par bshad pa/ (34)le'u gsum pa/ deng rabs gso rig las bshad pa'i dbyigan nad ces pa'i skor bshad pa/ (39)dang po/ 'gos nad kyi brda don dang ngo bo bshad pa/ (39)gnyis pa/ 'gos nad kyi rgyu bshad pa/ (40)gsum pa/ 'gos nad kyi rkyen bshad pa/ (40)bzhi ba/ 'gos nad rigs 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim bshad pa/ ci (41)lnga ba/ 'gos nad rigs kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ (42)1 'gos nad rigs kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba/ (42)2 'gos nad rigs dus kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ (44)3 'gos nad kyi nad rtags dang na lugs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ (45)le'u bzhi ba/ dengarabs gso3ga las bshad pa'i dbyigan nad de bod lugs gso rig gi nad gzhi gang zhig yin pa'i skor la dpyadapa/ (47)dang po/ gzhan lugs dgag pa/ (47)1 mchin nad ldem bur ngos 'dzin pa/ (47)2 mchin nad dug thabs la ngos 'dzin pa/ (49)3 dwangs ma ma zhu bar ngos 'dzin pa/ (50)4 tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis ma'i khongs su gtogs par ngos 'dzin pa/ (55)5 gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug la ngos 'dzin pa/ (57)2 6 de sngon rang gis bton pa'i lta ba 'khrul sel/ (58)

dkar chagaganyis pa/ rang lugs 'thad ldan du 'jog pa/ (59)1 gnyan nad dang dbyi kun nad gnyis kyi rgyu 'dra ba'i skor la dpyad pa/ (59)2 gnyan nad dang dbyi kun nad gnyis kyi rkyen 'dra ba'i skor la dpyad pa/ (62)3 gnyan srin par pa ta ni rigs mi 'dra ba'i gnyan srin yongs kyi spyi ming yin tshul bshad pa/ (63)4 khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin par 'dod pa/ (70)5 gnyan nad dang dbyi kun nad gnyis kyi gyur tshul 'dra ba'i char dpyad pa/ (77)6 dus snyigs mar gnyan rims rigs mang du dar tshul bshad pa/ (78)7 deng rabs gso rig las bshad pa'i dbyi kun nad der rang lugs su gnyan nad mchin ldem zhes ming 'dogs par 'dod pa/ (87)le'u lnga ba/ gnyan nadamachin ldem dngos bshadapa/ (90)dang po/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi rgyu bshad pa/ (90)gnyis pa/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi rkyen bshad pa/ (92)gsum pa/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi zhugs tshul bshad pa/ (92)1 ma bu'i 'gos mched/ (93)2 khrag gi 'gos mched/ (94)3 sman khab kyi 'gos mched/ (94)4 'khrig sbyor gyi 'gos mched/ (35)

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/5 rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'gos mched/ (96)6 'gos mched kyi lam gzhan/ (96)bzhi ba/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi gyur tshul bshad pa/ (98)lnga ba/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi rtags bshad pa/ (101)drug pa/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi bcos thabs bshad pa (113)bdun pa/ gnyan nad mchin ldem yun lon tshe mchis 'bras su 'gyur ba'i skor bshad pa/ (131)tha ma dge ba mjug gi don/ (135)dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/ (138)

thog mar dgeg klad kyi don/dang po/ mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/rmad byung legs tshogs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pu/ /khams gsum 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mgon gcig pu/ /dug gsum tsha gdung zhi mdzad beeḍūr ya'i/ /'od kyi rgyal bo'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sman bla'i rnam sprul mtshan dpe'i gzi byin can/ /skye 'gro'i tsha gdung sel bar mnga' brnyes pa/ /bho ṭa'i gso rig nyi gzhon 'dren pa'i gnyen/ /'chi med tshe rig bdud rtsis yongs gtams pa'i/ /g.yu thog gsar rnying rnam gnyis phyag gi yul/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che/ /rgyal khams yongs dang khyad par zhing 'di ru/ /rgyal bstan tshul bzhin dar zhing rgyas mdzad par/ /rgyal sras gzhan las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /rgyal ba yab sras gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gso rig zab brgya'i gzhung na dbyar rnga bzhin/ /rigs pa gnam lcags thog gis log smra yi/ / 1

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/brag ri gtor mdzad ljongs 'dir sngar med pa'i/ /byang zur lugs gnyis sgo 'phar legs 'byed mkhan/ /'bral med spyi bor bkod nas gsol ba 'debs/ /phan bde'i 'od snang 'bum du bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /beeḍūr sngon pos rgyud bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye/ /zhing 'di'i rgud pa gso ba'i ded dpon de/ /mi dbang sde srid mchog la sgo gsum gyis/ /ji srid byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod/ /'dul khrims gtsang ma'i yon tan gyis spras shing / /rnam dkar dge bas nad pa gso ba yi/ /rin chen btso bkru man ngag rin chen sogs/ /bdag la gnang mdzad grags pa rgya mtsho mchog /zhing 'dir slar yang byon zhing rjes 'dzin smon/ /gang gi mkhyen dpyod rgya mtsho'i klong yangs las/ /gso rig shes bya rma 'bri'i rlabs kyi rgyun/ /ci dgar lag tu gtod cing brtse chen pos/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i go 'jo dbang 'dus mchog /srid mtha'i bar du zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /bskul ba'i skye bo su yang ma mchis kyang / /lte khrag 'pho sa'i zhing 'dir zhen che bas/ /gnyan nad mchin ldem rgyu rkyen nad rtags rnams/ /srol rgyun gzhung la deng rabs gso rig gis/ /cung zad brgyan te spros 'di dge gyur cig/2 ces gnam gyis sa chen bkab pa bzhin bdag cag gi bgo bskal du

thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla dang sngon byon mes po bka' drin can rnams la mchod par brjod cing dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri dgos pa'i tshig gas mdun bsus te gang gleng bar bya ba ni khyod pham nga rgyal gyi 'dur rgyugs rgod pa'i snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skabs 'dir gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro sla zhing bcos dka' ba'i gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul/ nad rtags dang bcos thabs rnams gzhung dang lag len zung du sbrel nas bris par/ spyod 'jug las/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod med/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin dpyad rtsom 'di sngar med gsar byung gi lta bas rnam par rgyan pa zhig tu mi 'khums rung / tshal ba si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis/ mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas pa'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ / chen po'i mdun sar chen po'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /blun po'i mdun sar blun po'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ / ces dang / yang spyod 'jug las/ bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa gzhan gyis kyang / / ci ste 'di dag mthong ba don yod 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang dang skal mnyam rnam par gros kyi tshul du 'di ltar 'bri dgos don yang re re bzhin brjod na gsham ltar te/gnyis pa/ dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri dgos don bshad pa/1 zhib 'jug gi dgos pa/de yang da lta gnyan nad mchin ldem phog mkhan mang zhing deng rabs gso rig gtsor byas pa'i tha dad gso rig gi bcos thabs khrod stong char lus pa'i gnas shig tu 'dug nad gzhi 'dis skye 'gro gang mang zhig gi tshe /ga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/dang bde thang la dpung 'jug byed bzhin par ma zad/ 'gos khyab kyi rang bzhin yang shin tu che/ spyir mthamyoganyan srin 'di 'gos kyang mang che ba'i lusanas bag tu nyal zhing nad rtags ci yang med pas der rdzas 'gyur rig pas brtag dpyad ma bgyis na nad ngos zin rgyu khag da lta 'dzam gling khyon yongs su mthayiganyan srin 'gos zin pa'i mi dung phyur 20dang /mthastoganyan srin bag tu nyal 'dug pa'i mi dung phyur 3tsam mchis/ spyi lo 1988lor sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na skabs der krung go'i rgyal khab tu 22myoganyan srin mi dung phyur 7la 'gos zin zhing bag tu nyal 'dug pa'i mi dung phyur 1 2mchis pas/ rgyal yongs nas mthamyoganyan srin 'gos 'dug pa'i mis spyi'i mi grangs kyi 10095zin/ gnas skabs bag tu nyal ba'i mi 'di dag las rjes sor bye ba gcig dang sa ya gnyis yas mas tsam gyi mchin pa na zhing / rim bzhin mchin rgud dang mchin skran/ mchin pa'i zags chu sogs su 'gyur srid/ mchin pa'i 'bras skran phog pa'i mi'i 805yan gyi thog ma'i nad rgyu mthagaganyan srin phog nas byung zhing / nad gzhi 'di grong khyer las grong gseb tu phog mang zhing / byang phyogs sa khul las lho phyogs sa khul du phog mang / mkhriyiganyan srin ches phog mang ba'i yul khams ni cang zes sa khul dang bod ljongs sa khul yin/ nad gzhi 'di phog pa'i mis cang shes sa khul nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 16 795zin zhing / bod ljongs sa khul nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 16 775zin/ gzhan yang hphu can nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 14 935zin/ kong tung nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 14 915zin/ kong zhi nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 13 735zin/ ho pe nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 12 515zin/ ho nan nas spyi'i mi grangs kyi 10 915zin/ phog nyung ba'i yul khams las hran zhi ru 3 815zin zhing / than cin du 488chadang / yun na/ du 4 915zin/ pe cin dang ho pe/ nang sog hran don/ hrang he/

thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/he lung cang / nyin zha/ mtsho sngon/ si khron bcas su spyi'i mi grangs kyibya:nas 105bar zin/ gnas tshul de'i dbang gis lo rer mi sa ya gnyis tsam gyi tshe srog nad rgyu 'dir brten nas byung ba'i nad kyis shor bzhin pas/ 'gro ba mi'i tshe srog gi gshed mar gyur ba'i nad 'dir gzhan lugs gso rig gi bcos thabs khrod stong char lus shing stong cha'i gnas de bod yig gi lam nas bod lugs gso rig gis kha skong mdzad thub na dge mtshan mi dman pa mchis par snyam nas rang blos ci dpog gis dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri khul bgyis pa lags/ lhag par 'dzam gling na snyan grags che zhing kha rtsang gi lo rgyus deb ther ngos su rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes rabs dang rim par bzhag myong ba'i mi rigs shig yun ring gnas thub min gyi nyen khar phrad pa'i skabs 'dir/ tshe srogagi rten gtso bo sems kyi 'phar shugs ma nyams shing dbang rtsa tshang ba'i bod mi zhig yin phyin/ 'brel 'dris che ba'i dus rabs khrod gnas pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs 'di'i yun gnas kyi las dbang dang 'byung 'gyur gyi las dbang la bsam mno mi gtong ga med yin/ de na mi rigs dang mi rigs de'i rig gnas gnyis ni dar na mnyam dar dang rgud na mnyam rgyad du 'gro ba'i ltos bcas kyi 'brel ba zhig tu grub cing / mi rigs gang zhig yin rung de nyid yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i gzhi ma mi rigs de nyid kyis rang gi skad yig la brten nas skabs de'i spyi tshogs su mkho ba'i gna' deng gi shes bya rnams bsdu gsog rgyag rgyu de yin/ der brten phran gyis kyang dbyi kun nad kyi rgyu rtags gyur tshul 'ga' bod yig tu bsgyur yod pa 'di yang bod lugs sman pa tshos bod yig gi lam nas nad gzhi der brtag thub phyir dang / 'di lta bu nga tshor nye bar mkho ba'i shes bya gang mang zhig bod yig tu bsgyur thub na mi rigs 'di'i yun gnas dang dar rgyas bcas par phan thog rgya cher 'byung ba gdon mi za bas/ mdor na phran gyis 'di ltar bgyis pa yang bya ro/ so

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/brtag pa'i bstan bcos ('di ni sngon pha spad gnyis chu grod pa gang khyer nas mya ngam thang du zhing rmo ru phyin pa na/ bya rog gis grod pa dral nas chu thams cad 'pho bas/ pha na re/ ma mchus dral ba yin zer/ bu na re/ sos dral ba yin zer nas de las 'phros te sho lo ka 'bum longs pa'i bstan bcos zhig 'byung ba la zer)lta bu ma yin par rang mnyam sman pa dang nad 'dis mnar ba'i gso bya'i 'dod don 'grub pa'i dgos pa dang ldan par snyam nas sor mo'i ngal bar ma ltos par 'di bzhin bris pa lags/2 zhib 'jug gi thabs lam/mthasaganyan srin 'gos nas byung ba'i dbyi kun nad 'di'i rgyu rtags dang gyur tshul sogs rang blos dpag tshod kyis dbye zhib bgyis mthar nad de gnyan nad cig yin par ma zad/ gnyan mkhris pa rtsar rgyugs dang gag lhogargyu gzer lta bu dang po'i dus nas dmigs bsal gyi nad rtags mngon pa zhig min par/ gnyan nad 'di 'gos phral mang che bar nyin shas yun skyug mer langs pa'am kha zas la yi ga med pa/ sgyid pa skyur ba tsam las nad rtags cher med pas/ de lta bu'i snang tshul zhig la gso bya dang sman pa su yin rung do snang cher mi bgyi bar ma zad/ srol rgyun ltar nad rtags dang na lugs/ rtsa chu sogs la brten na nad 'di'i ngos zin dka'/ de na na zug ci yang med pa'i nad gzhi 'dir thabs gang 'dra zhig spyad nas ngos 'dzin rgyu zer na/ da lta tha dad gso rig kun gyis rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i brtag 'bras la brten nas thog mar ngos bzung zhing de nas gso bcos byed/ mthar sangs drag dang drag skyed kyi tshad gang 'drar slebs 'dug pa sogs kyi mjug sdom rgyag bzhin pas/ nga tshos kyang thabs lam 'di brgyud nas nad gzhi'i ngos 'dzin par bya'o/ /6

thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/3 zhib 'jug khrod 'phrad pa'i dka' gnad/spyir bod rgyal btsan po'i dus kyi rang re'i gangs can pa'i dbu 'phang dgong dang mnyam skabs nga tsho'i mi rigs ni rang la yod pa'i shes byar bdag dam dang gzhan gyi shes bya'i nying khu bsdu gsog rgyag mkhan zhig tu 'khums pa ni sngon byung lo paṇa dag gi thugs smon las rgyal ba'i bka' dang rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams brag ri'i bongs dang mnyam pa zhig bod yig gi gzugs su bkod yod pa 'dis mtshon/ 'on kyang chos srid nyams rgud kyi 'go brtsams pa nas phyi phyogs su 'brel gtug bgyi ma thub rkyen rang la sngar yod kyi shes bya'i nang nas bskyar skor brgyab nas lus shing /rim bzhin skye bo gang mang zhig gi blor sngar dar ba'i lta ba rnams tshad ldan dang der mi mthun pa'i lta ba'am brjod tshul gsar ba re thon tshe kun gyis 'byin sgrub bgyi sar gyur 'gro bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo dge 'dun chos 'phel lags nas kyang / rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems/ / ngo mtshar phal cher than ltas nyid du bsgoms/ / zhes gsungs pa'ang gsar dar shes byar kha mi phyogs pa'i skabs de'i bod pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes la sdom tshig brgyab pa zhig go/ lhag par khong gi zhal nas/ mi lo brgyad brgya'i yun la rgya gar du/ / ma slebs phyi dal can gyi lo tsā ba/ / legs sbyar bstan bcos dngos la klog pa zhig/ da lta ma ga rda na mchis so skad/ / ces gsungs pas kyang chos srid nyams rgud kyi 'go bcoms pa nas rang re ba rnams phyi phyogs su 'brel gtug byed ma thub pa mtshon/ nga lta bus sngar med lta ba zhig gi gros mgo bton tshe der gang mang zhig gi 'byin sgrub thob pa smras med yin/ 'on kyang nga tshor kha tsha dgos gtugs kyis mkho ba'i shes bya re la phrad tshe rang nyid kyi lte khrag 'pho sa'i mi rigs 'di'i ched du de nga tshor yod na ci ma rung snyam pa'i kun slong /ga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'gog med du thon zhing de'i rigs bod yig tu bsgyur bar yang 'dod/ der brten 22myoganyan srin 'gos nas byung ba'i dbyi kun nad 'di da lta dar che yang / bod yig gi lam na de'i rgyu rtags dang gyur tshul/ rdzas 'gyur gyi dpyad 'bras la brtag srol sogs ma mchis shing / nad de thad kur bod lugs gso rig gi sngar gzhung rnams su gsungs pa'i nad 'di dang ngo 'phrod 'dug ces kha dmar gdags rgyu yang khag mod/ nad de'i rgyu rtags dang gyur tshul sogs la gzhigs tshe gnyan nad bye brag pa zhig tu 'dug pas/ de'i ming la gnyan nad mchin ldem zhes ming gsar zhig btags par gzir gnas mkhas pa'i sbyan lam du phyogs tshe bzhad gad kyi rgyur 'gro yang srid pas/ nad gzhi 'di'i ming du sngar med gsar ba zhig 'dogs rgyu shin tu khag gzhan yang nga lta bus nad 'di'i mgo rting bar gsum la dbye zhib bgyis te der gso bcos byas zhing mthar bsdur dpyod du mkho ba'i snga phyi'i rdzas 'gyur brtag dpyad rnams bsdu gsog rgyag rgyu ni dka' gnad las kyang dka' gnad cig tu 'khums/ dka' gnad 'di dag gi khrod nas rang nyid kyi lta ba zhig 'thad ldan du 'chad rgyu ni nga la mtshon na 'khur thang ri las lci ba zhig yin mod/'jig rten 'di'i shes bya gang yin yang thog mar med pa nas yod pa dang de nas rim bzhin cha tshang ba'i phyogs su skyod pa ni spyi'i 'gro lugs shig yin/der brten nad 'di'i rgyu rtags sogs dang 'brel yod rigs go rim ltar mdor bsdus khrigs chags su spel bar bya ba la sago lnga mchis pa las jog mar nad 'di'i 'bab gnas gtso bo mchin pa'i gnas lugs dang ngo bo nas 'go btsams te rim bzhin 'jug par bya'o/ /8

bar du dgeri gzhung gi don/le'u dang po/ mchin pa'i gnas lugs dang ngo bo bshad pa/dang po/ mchin pa'i gnas bshad pa/de yang mchin pa ni byang khog stod smad gnyis su dbye ba'i byang khog smad du gnas shing / byang khog stod dang smad kyi dbye mtshams ni rgyud las/ byang khog stod smad mchin dris dbye ba ste/ / nyen rus 'brel mtshams tshigs pa bcu gsum nas/ / chu babs thig gdab mchin dri nag po'i yul/ / tshigs pa brgyad nas rtsib ring gyen mtshon gang / / yol gyis bcad pa mchin dri dkar po'i yul/ / mchin dri khug pa brgyad dang bcu gsum bar/ / rtsib steng dkar nag mtshams te khra bor 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar mdun gyi lhen sna dang brang rus 'brel mtshams nas rgyab kyi tshigs pa bcu gsum bar chu babs te rim gyis dma' ba'i thig gdab pa ni mchin dri nag po'i yul yin/rgyab tshigs brgyad pa nas mdun ngos kyi rtsib ma 'og ma thung shos ste rtsib thung /de'i steng ma gsum 'das mtshams te rtsib ring / de'i sna nas gyen du mchan 'og ngos mtshon gang gi sar thig gcig 'then/ de nas slar nyen rus 'brel mtshams su thig gcig gdab/ de ltar steng 'og yol gyis bcad pa dang /dra

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/ba ni mchin dri dkar po'i yul yin/ mchin dri khug pa ni brgyad pa dang bcu gsum gyi bar/ zur gyi rtsib ring steng na sha min pags min/ dkar po dang shaganag nag po 'dom pa'i mtshams te lteb pa ltar yod pas khug pa'am khra bo'o/ / mchin pa ni byang khog smad kyi g.yas stod du mang shas mchis shing g.yon stod du'ang cha shas tsam mchis/ mchin sgang ngam mchin steng mchin drir 'brel zhing de'i thad ni byang khog g.yas pa'i mdun ngos rtsib ma lnga ba'i dkyil tsam yin/ de yang rdzong phreng las/ mchin pa dang 'brel ba'i sha mthug po de mchin dri nag po yin zhes dang / rgyud las mchin pa brag g.yang gzar 'dra gyen du bslang zhes gsungs pas kyang mchin sgang mchin drir 'brel te mar mnar yod pa gsal/ mchin gsham yang byang khog g.yas pa'i mdun ngos kyi rtsib ma dgu ba'i thad slobs tsam yin/ de ni mchin 'dabs g.yas pa'i mchin smad rtsib ma brgyad pa dang dgu ba'i 'brel mtshams kyi lha ru rtse nas rtsib mar bral te g.yon phyogs kyi stod ngos su 'khyog por gnas shing lhen sna'i 'og brgyud de rtsib ma bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i 'brel mtshams kyi lha ru rtse yod sar slebs/ nyen sna'i rtse nas mar phyogs su li smi gsum nas lnga bar yod/dbugs gtong len dang 'gul skyod dbang gis mchin gnas la 'gyur ldog ha cang che/ de yang rgyud las kyang lhen rus tshigs pa brgyad nas g.yas ngos su/ / mtshon gang gru mos gar slebs mchin pa'i yul/ / zhes lhon rus kyi dbus dang rgyab kyi tshigs pa brgyad pa'i thad nas g.yas ngos su mtshon gang bcal ba nas lag g.yas gung mdzub gnyis kyis rna ba g.yas pa'i rna shal bzung ba'i gru mos pho ba'i dkyil nas rgyab tu lus gnad ma 'phyugs par gang slebs pa'i sa/ ngo bo tshigs pa brgyad pa dang nyen rus nas tshon gang bcal ba'i 'phred thig gi 'og de mchin dri la mchin pa 'dogs mtshams dang / de na/sdu mos gar slebs mchin pa'i yul yin la/ gru mo'i gsham dang mchin

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gsham gnyis mnyam/ mang che ba'i mchin pa rtsib ma'i 'og tu gnas rkyen nad med bde thang skabs mchin par lag pas reg mi thub/ mi dar ma'i mchin pa'i ljid tshad phal cher khe 12slonas khe 1600bar tsam yin zhing / lus spyi'i lci tshad kyi bzhi bcu'i cha gcig nas lnga bcu'i cha gcig tsam zin/ byis par lus spyi'i lci tshad kyi nyi shu'i cha gcig tsam zin/ mchin pa nyid mchin thag (mchin pa'i zam chen)gis yal 'dabs g.yas g.yon gnyis su dbye/ yal 'dabs g.yas pa che zhing mthug la yal 'dabs g.yon pa chung zhing srab/mchin 'og tu gnam pa'i drang thig nyag ga gnyis dang de'i dkyil du 'phred thig nyag ga gcig bcas mchis/ 'phred thig nyag ga ni mchin sgo yin zhing /der mchin sgo'i sdod rtsa dang mchin pa'i 'phar rtsa/ mchin pa nas mkhris par mkhris khu 'bab lam/ rtsa dkar dang rmen bu bcas 'dus/ drang thig nyag ga mdun ma ni snod mkhris dang phyi ma ni khog smad sdod rtsa yin/gnyis pa/ mchin pa'i byed las bshad pa/mchin pa'i byed las ni ro drug tu gtogs pa'i zas skom gang zos pa de thog mar pho ba'i me drod gsum gyis myag bzhu byed cing dwangs snyigs legs par phye nas dwangs ma'i cha de pho ba nas dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu'i gnas brgyud de mchin par slebs/ dngas ma len pa'i rtsa dgu zhes pa de yang bod snga rabs pa 'gas pho ba dang mchin pa'i bar nas kha zas kyi dngas ma de phar tshur thengs dgur 'khor skyod byed par go zhing / re 'gas yod dgu zhes pa lta bu mang tshig cig las nges bstan gyi grangs shig min par 'dod/ re 'gas mchin pa nas gang sar 'brel ba'i rtsa mig dgur 'dod/ re 'gas sdusang

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/tshig 'grel skabs dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu brgyud nas mchin par song zhes skabs 'di'i dgu ni mang tshig cig gam nges bstan gyi grangs ka dgu gang yin mi gsal/ de rnams kyi 'dod tshul re re nas 'dir cung zad drangs na gsham ltar te/ rin spungs pa'i bla sman bsod nams ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bshad rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med kun gsal las/ mchin par 'gro ba'i lam dngas ma len pa'i rtsa dang po brgyud de mchin par song bas/ sngar dwangs ma'i mdog sngo sangs pa cig yod pa de/ mchin par cung zad ser mdangs yod par gyur ste/ slar pho bar bslog go/ yang dngas ma len pa'i rtsa gnyis pa nas mchin par brgyud de song bas/ dwangs ma'i mdog de ser ljang gi rnam pa gyur nas slar pho bar bslog go/ yang dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa gsum pa brgyud de mchin par song bas/ dwangs ma'i mdog ser po rang du gyur nas slar pho bar bslog go/ de bzhin du dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa bzhi ba brgyud de mchin par song bas/ mdog ser po dmar mdangs yod par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang pho bar byung te/ dngas ma len pa'i rtsa lnga ba brgyud de mchin par song bas/ dwangs ma'i mdog dmar ser mdangs che bar 'gyur la/ slar pho bar log ste/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa drug pa brgyud de mchin par song bas/dwangs ma'i mdog dmar ngur du 'gyur zhing / slar yang pho bar log nas dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa bdun pa brgyud de mchin par song bas/ mdog dmar rkyang du 'gyur ro/ / de nas kyang pho bar log pas/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa brgyad pa brgyud de mchin par song bas/ khrag cung zad sla ba tsam du 'gyur ro/ / de nas pho bar len gcig log pas/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu ba brgyud de mchin par song bas/ khrag skyon med rang gi mdog dang mtshan nyid 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ / de dag dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu zhes bya ba yin la/rtsa rdo ༵ ba dgu med pas/ rtsa'i rgyun cig nyid ran bu 'dren pa ltar phar tshur

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/sbas 'gro byas shing / phar tshur gnyis kur du ba thag pa zug pa ltar rtsa phra mo mang du zug cing / de dag las kyang dwangs ma phyi nang du phar tshur 'gro zhing rgyu ba yin/ yang dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu ni/ me drod rnam gsum gyis bzhu ba'i dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dang / dwangs ma de khrag tu 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang /khrag de shar 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / sha de tshil du 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / tshil bu de rus par 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / rus pa de rkang du 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / rkang de khu bar 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / khu ba de dwangs mchog mdangs su 'gyur ba'i rtsa dang / kha zas gang yang pho bar 'jug pa'i sgo'am rtsa ste/ de ltar na dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu zhes bya la/ rtsa dgu'i grangs 'dren tshul yang gong 'og gi gzhung don 'di gnyis ka ltar gnas pas de ltar bshad do/ / zhes dang /mes po'i zhal lung du/ pho ba dang mchin pa gnyis dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu 'brel te yod do snyam pa'am/ yang na gang yang dpyad ma shes par gzhung tshig lhug par btang ba tsam las ma byung mod/ de gnyis kyi bar na dngos su 'brel ba'i rtsa ni rta rnga bshags pa'i tshad tsam yang med na dgu tsam byung ba lta ci smos/ 'on kyang gzhung gi dgongs pa ni pho ba rang gi ngos na rtsa sgrubs shin tu phra ba dra ba ltar yod pa'i nang nas mchin pa'i rtsa ba phyogs dang gang reg pa'i rtsa mig gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa dgu las ngang gis 'ongs pa mchin pa'i rtsa bo cher 'gro ste/ dper na gnye ma nas sgang bar chu gsog pa 'am/ras tshags dam por chu blug par ngang gis 'dzag pa'am/ rdza so ma btang bar chu blug pa rngul ba ltar 'gru bar dgongs pa'o/ / zhes dang / drang srong zhal lung las/ zas skom gyi dwangs ma dngos de pho ba dang rgyu ma nas dngas ma len pa'itsho dgu zhes rtsa 'dab mang por drangs te mchin pa'i rtsa lam brgyud nas lus zungs su zhes gsungs pa rnams grangs kyi ngos bzung med la dgu ni mang tshig cig tu go 'dug man ngag bye ba ring bsrel du/ de rnams gang 14 na

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/mchin pa'i gnas su pho bar dwangs ma khrid pa'i rtsa dang gcig mchin pa'i gnas su mcher bar dwangs ma khrid pa'i rtsa dang gcig de bzhin du mkhris par/ glo bar/ snying du/ klad par/ mkhal mar/ mchin par/ bsam se'ur dngas ma khrid pa'i rtsa dang dgu'o/ / dgu bo 'di las/ sha khrag 'phel byed kyi nyi shu bzhir 'gro ba yin/ zas spyod lam dus gdon sogs kyis nad 'phel zad 'khrugs par gyur pa na/ rtsa sbubs dgu bo 'di nad kyis ci rigs par bkag pa'am/ ma bkag kyang / me dang mnyam pa'i rlung gis kha zas dwangs snyigs ma phyed par 'dres pa de lam dgur shor ba dang / dwangs ma gnas su 'grim pa'i sdug 'gag pa la ma thar bar/ slar lhung ba sogs kyis khong gcong phal cher bskyed pa yin no/ / rtsa 'di dgu ni/ sbom pa sog sbubs tsam dang / phra ba skud pa tsam du gnas par bshad do/ / zhes dang / dka' 'grel las/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu ni/ dwangs ma bdun gyi rgyu ba'i rtsa bdun dang / de bdun mthar phyin pa mdangs rgyu ba'i rtsa brgyad/ mkhris pa'i dwangs ma chu ser rgyu ba'i rtsa dang dgu'o zhes rigs dang byed las mi 'dra ba'i rtsa mig dgur ngos bzung / spyir mi'i phung bo dngos la zhib par brtag tshe zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i dgongs pa de gnas lugs dang mthun pa 'dra yang / phran la gong gi bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba 'di dag las gang zhig 'thad ldan du 'dzin zhing gang zhig dor byar brtsi ba'i spod pa ma mchis/ gang ltar yang dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu'i las la brten nas kha zas kyi dwangs ma'i thog ma de thog mar mchin gnas su slobs/ mchin gnas su slebs pa'i dwangs ma de yang mchin pa rang la gnas pa'i bad mkhris rlung gi bya ba byas pa la brten nas de'i dngas ma rnams khrag 'ba' zhig tu gyur la khrag gi snyigs ma ni mkhris khuragyur/ mchin gnas nas dwangs ma khrag tu 'gyur bar ma zad zas skom la/ snrong ba'i dug rigs phal mo che yang gnas 'di nas sbyangs bar bya dgos/

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/de ni mchin gnas su mchis pa'i me drod gsum gyi las la brten nas dug can rigs dug med du bsgyur ba'am dug shas che ba'i rigs dug shas chung bar bsgyur/ yang na phog zin pa'i dug de mchin nus kyis mkhris khu'am gcin lam du ded de phyir 'pho bar byed/ lus zungs rnams dwangs snyigs 'byed cing smin pa'i skabs su lus zungs rang rang gi sa na yod pa'i cha shas kyi me drod kyis myag bzhu dngas snyigs phyes nas smin par gyur ba yin la/ gnas so sor yod pa'i nyes gsum gyi cha mi 'dra zhing der gtso bo'i las byed mkhan re mchis/ dper na/ skabs 'di'i dwangs ma'i dngas ma khrag dang de'i snyigs ma mkhris khur sgyur mkhan ni mdangs sgyur mkhris pa yin/ de ni rgyud las/mkhris pa mdangs sgyur mchin par gnas pa ste/ / dwangs ma la sogs kha dog ma lus sgyur/ / zhes gsungs 'dug pas kyang gsal/ dngas ma'i dngas ma de mkhris pa mdangs sgyur gyi las la gtso bor brten nas khrag tu 'gyur bar byed pas/ mchin nus nyams rgud du gyur tshe gso byar sna khrag dang so khrag 'byung sla zhing / pho ba dang mid pa pags 'og bcas su'ang de bzhin rtsa phran rdol te khrag 'byung sla/ lhag par khrag 'khyag par byed pa'i grub cha yang je nyung du song rkyen khrag bzhur yun je ring du 'gro/ mchin nus ci tsam zhan na de bzhin khrag 'byung sla zhing yun ring bzhur srid/ rgyun ldan mir chu tshod skar ma gcig gi nang du mchin gnas su khrag ha'o hrin 100tsam 'khor skyod byed bzhin pa dang / zungs khrag tu gnas pa'i khrag ril dmar po'i 'tsho yun nyin 120yin zhing khrag ril dmar po rgas pa'i rigs mchin pa'i byed las la brten nas mchin gnas su mkhris khur gyur/gzhan yang mchin pa ni don gzhan dang mi 'dra bar der rang gi cha shas gang rung gsar skyes byed pa'i nus pa shin tu che/ dper na mchin pa'i cha shas su skran byung bar skran byung ba'i cha shas de gshags bcos byas nas tāzlos

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/tshe dus mi 'gyangs par cha shas de gsar skyes byed thub/ mchin pa'i lnga cha bzhi skran du gyur ba zhig la mtshon na de'i skran du gyur pa'i cha rnams blangs tshe shul du lnga cha gcig las med kyang / rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i khrod mchin pa'i lnga cha gcigalas med pa'i mi de dag gis zas spyod tshul bzhin bsten na zas skom 'ju bar gnod cher med/ byi ba'i mchin pa'i 755blangs rjes gza' 'khor gsum gyi rjes nas ltos tshe blangs zin pa'i mchin pa'i grub cha'i shul du gsar skyes byung nas sngon bzhin mchin pa cha tshang du grub 'dug mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis gso bya kha nas mchin rul dud khu thon zhing gom pa rang 'gros mi thub pa zhig la khrin tu'u nas brtag dpyad bgyis mthar nad gzhi (64)ru ngos bzung zhing brtag dpyad bgyi mkhan gyi phyi lugs sman pa tshos nyin bcu yan 'tsho mi srid ces kha dmar gdags zin pas/ der khong gis mchin nad dug thabs su ngos bzung nas thog mar nyin gsum la gnyen po'i sman btang bas phan skyed shin tu chen po byung / de nas mu mthud bsten pas mthar sangs drag byung zhing / lo bdun gyi rjes gcin snyi za khu'i nad phog nas shi yang / mchin par blta skabs gsar skyes byung 'dug ces rgan mig dmar lags nas rtag par gsungs pa 'di yang mchin pa nyid don snod gzhan dang mi 'dra bar phyir gsar skyes thub pa'i dpe mtshon tsam mo/ /16

le'u gnyis pa/ gnyan rims bshad pa/dang po/ rims bshad pa/1 rims nad kyirgyu bshad pa/de yang rgyud las/ nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ / bdag med don ma rtogs pas ma rig ces/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar lus sems kyi nad mtha' dag gi rgyu ni gcig pu nyid yin te/ de ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu gcig pu de gang zhe na/ don dam du dngos po thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin can kho na yin yang de'i don ma rtogs pas bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa zhes pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la thog ma med pa nas yod pa'i mi dge ba de nyid yin/ bdag 'dzin ma rig pa de yod par brten nas thog mar yul yid du 'ong bar 'dod chags skyes/ de nas yul yid du mi 'ong bar zhe sdang / blang dor gyi gnas la gti mug pas rmongs par gyur bas/ go rim bzhin 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ste khyad par gyi rgyu dug gsum byung / khyad par gyi rgyu de nas go rim bzhin nye rgyu rlung mkhris bad kun gsum byung / 'di ni spyi'i dbang du gsungs pa las bye brag rgyu'am nyer len gyi rgyu de min par bsam/ de ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi las/ dang po nad 'khrugs sna tshogs tshul can gyis/ / grangs med gyur bas lus nyid gzir gyur ba/ /de rgyu re rer bstan par mi nus pas/ / de bas nad kun sbyi rgyu brjod pa ni/ / nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ / zhes dang / 1snang

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/tshig don nyi ma las/ de la dang po re zhig rgyu mi dge ba sna tshogs spyad pa las 'bras bu nad kyi rgyu nyes gsum 'phel zad 'khrugs pa sna tshogs pa'i tshul can gyis nad kyi ngo bo grangs med par gyur nas lus ni gzir bar gyur pas nad re la ring rgyu mi dge ba re nye rgyu nyes pa gsum po 'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i ldan 'dus sam mtshan nyid re re yod na'ang / de mthun gyi nyer len rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi rgyu re re nas bstan par mi lang zhing mi nus pas de bas na nad yod do cog kun gyi spyi'i rgyu brjod par bya/zhes gsungs 'dug pas kyang gsal/ de na dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i rims nad gso ba'i le'u ru/ rims zhes bya ba'i nad 'byung rgyu rkyen ni/ / lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyur tsa na/ / mi rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis log par spyod/ / sngags pa rnams ni rdo rje nang dme dar/ / dge 'dun btsun pa rnams ni sde 'khrugs byed/ / mi stegs ban bon rnams ni sor kha 'phen/ /skye bo rnams ni mna' 'thabe shan dmar byed/ / de dus ma mo mkha' 'gro kun 'khrugs nas/ / nad kyi kha rlangs sprin du chags pa las/ / bal nad rgyu gzer gag lhog 'brum nag 'byung / / zhes dang / der skyem 'grel du/ spyir bskal ba mar 'grib kyi dus su sems can rnams kyi bsod nams bri bas nad mug mtshon gyi gnod pa 'byung la/ khyad par bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa spel ba nas bgrang bya lnga stong gnas pa la lnga brgya phrag bcur phyes pa'i lnga brgya dang po gsum la 'bras bu'i dus te/ dgra bcom pa phyir mi 'ong ba rgyun zhugs gsum 'byung / bar ba gsum la sgrub pa'i dus te/shes rab kyi bslab pa/ ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gsum 'byung / mtha' gsum la lung gi dus te/ mngon pa mdo sde 'dul ba gsum rim pa bzhin 'byung / lhag ma brgya phrag gcig ni mtha' ma ste lta spyod rnam ༵ dang mi ldan pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus te/ de dang nye ba la 'dir

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyur tsa na/ zhes lnga brgya phrag dgu 'das pa'i lnga brgya phrag gcig gi skabs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dus kyi zad mtshams mtha' maragyur pa de tsa na/ spyir mi rnams nyi tshe ba'i rang bde 'dod pa'i dbang gis dam pa'i lam las log par gol ba mi dge ba bcu sogs la spyod pa dang /khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo sngags gnyis las sngags la zhugs pa'i sngags pa rnams ni mi phyed mi 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can/ rdo rje theg par zhugs pa'i dam tshig gcig yin pa la spang blang nor nas rdo rje dam tshig can nang du thar ba'i srog gi rigs gcod pa'i dme byed/ mdo la zhugs pa'i dge 'dun nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom par 'dod pa rnams ni so so'i sde rigs bzung nas 'khrugs pa dar/ phyi rol mi stegs pa dang ban bon 'phrin las mngon spyod par 'dod pa rnams ni drag po'i las la bskul ba'i zor kha 'phen/ skye bo rang bzhin pa rnams ni dkon mchog dang lha 'dre dpang du btsugs pa'i mna' dor nas za/ ri klung gnyan pa rnams su dkar 'thab dmar 'thab nag 'thab sogs me glo bur du gsod pa'i thab gtong / shan dmar ram dmar klo ste lha 'dre gtsang sbra can yod sar sha khrag 'bag btsog gi las byed/ de lta bu dar ba'i dus su srid pa skye 'jig la dbang ba'i ma mo dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams gcig 'khrug na dam tshig yin pas kun khro zhing 'khrugs te rims kyis 'debs pa'i rigs sngags dang bcas pa'i nad kyi kha rlangs ser po dmar po nag po rnams btang bas sprin du chags pa las/ bsod nams dman pa'i skye bo la phog ste ser po la bal nad dmar po la rgyu gzer nag po la gag lhog 'brum nag 'byung ngo / / zhes 'grel pa ni snga rabs pa phal che bas dngos kyi rgyu rkyen zer mod/don dam du thog mar rgyu ma rig par brten nas pha rol bor zhe sdang ba'i blos mi dge ba bcu'i las spel ba de nye rgyu dang ring rgyu gnyis las ring rgyu 1)nga /

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/ring rgyu'i las ngan pa der brten nas de'i rnam smin du byung ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi kha rlangs las rims zhes 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i rims nad de nye rgyu las kyang nyer len gyi rgyur bzhag na 'grig par 'dod/ de yang nyer len gyi rgyu ni rang gi nye bar len bya'i 'bras bu de nyid rgyu rang nyid kyi rdzas kyi rgyun du gtso bor skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin te/ dper na lcags kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi rgyur gyur ba'i lcags de lcags kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi nyer len gyi rgyu yin la/ rdza bum gyi rgyur gyur ba'i 'jim pa de rdza bum gyi nyer len rgyu yin pa lta bu/ dpe de bzhin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis btab pa'i rims srin de rigs bsod nams dman pa'i skye bo'i phyi'i ba spu'i bu ga'am sna khung sogs brgyud nas rim bzhin lus su zhugs shing / mthar rims srin de yis gso bya'i lus nas rang gi rdzas rgyun nam rigs brgyud du gyur ba'i rims srin mang du 'phel bas nad slong bar byed pas na'o/ / khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas mdzad pa'i gso rig man ngag myong byang phyogs bsgrigs phan bde nor bu'i snye ma las/gzhan yang gsang sngags sgrub rgyud gzhung rnams las/ / dus kyi spyod ngan 'thab gzhob dme 'khon dang / / sdom khrims bslab bya khas blangs dam tshig nyams/ / dge sdig rgyu 'bras spang blang khyad du bsad/ / dus der dam can srung ma'i thugs kyang khros/ / srid pa skye 'jig dbang byed ma mo 'khrugs/ /kha rlangs ma mo'i khrag nad dal yams gtong / / zhes dang / mkhas grub ra ga a su yis mdzad pa'i ma mo'i 'khrugs skor du/ ma mo nag mo thugs khros nas/ / bud med sna tshogs stong gsum gang / / mi nad phyugs nad sna tshogs gtong / / mkha' la nad sprin sngo dmar 'khrigs/ / nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ / rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ / zhes pa'ang rims rgyur dgongs nas gsungs zhing de'i dgongs don yang rgyud las gnyis su ma ma~X/ gzhan yang slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi bum chen las

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rims rgyu bstan pa'i skabs/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams:log pa'i 'khrul 'khor (sdig pa)sna tshogs spyod: sngags pa (stag mo kha 'thab byed)rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams:btsun pa rtsa ba'i 'dul khrims nyams:(dang po bla mas mi thub ste slob dpon nyams/)skye bo ngo tsha khrel las bud:(mna' za ba la sogs )dge bshes (rnams ni/'khrug pa'i yo lang byed:ston pa'i dam chos (rnams)zong du 'tshong:rnal 'byor (rnams)tho cos nya ma bslu:sgom chen rdzun gyis bu smad gso:bla ma dkon mchog rgyab tu bskyur:(chos pa rnams ni )bdud dang mi stegs dang du len:(log pa'i spyod pa )'jig rten lha 'dre srog gis mchod:(gnya' dmar la sogs)log pa'i spyod ngan sna tshogs (de 'dra)kyis:rang gi spyod pas rang nyid phung:'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa las:rims kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o:zhes gsungs pas kyang gong rnams rims rgyur nges so/ /2 rims nadakyi rkyen bshad pa/de yang rgyud las/ gzhan yang dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman lhag log/drag shul dri dugs khro 'jigs mya ngan 'dod/ / kha zas ma snyoms pa yis rims su 'gyur/ / zhes dbyar dgun ston dpyid de nam zla dus bzhi'i 'byung ba bshad rgyud du gsungs pa ltar dman lhag log pa dang / yang na spyod lam drag shul byas pa/ rims nad de'i nad dri phog pa/ 'byung ba'i dug gzer phog pa/ zhe sdang drag po skyes te khro zhing 'khrugs pa/ gti mug can sems zhum pa'i dbang gis 'jigs skrag thon pa/ yid gcugs pa dang bral ba sogs kyi mya ngan gyis gdung ba/ yul la lhag par chags pa'i 'dod chags te dug gsum dbang du lhag par gyur ba dang kha zas bsil drod mi snyoms pa sogs lus khams dang mi mthun pa bsten pa'i dbang las kārdo gi

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'byung ba 'khrugs te rims su 'gyur bar bshad pa ni snga rabs pa rnams kyis cha mtshungs kyi rgyu rkyen du bzhag 'dug mod/ gong las gsungs pa'i rims nad de'i nad dri phog pa ni nyer len gyi rgyu dang / gzhan rnams lhan cig byed rkyen yin/ de yang rang gi lhan cig byed 'bras rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin par gtso bor skyed byed de lhan cig byed rkyen gyi mtshan nyid du nges/ yang na lhan cig byed rkyen ni rgyu'i gtso bo nyer len gyi rgyu dang lhan cig du rang gis bskyed bya'i 'bras bu de rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin yang rang 'bras kyi rgyu tshogs du ma tshogs pa dang lhan cig tu skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yang yin pas/ lhan cig byed rkyen zhes pa de rang 'bras kyi rgyu tshogs du ma tshogs pa dang lhan cig tu skyed par byed pa'i rang gi 'bras bu de rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin par gtso bor skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yang yin phyir/ nam zla dus bzhi'i 'byung ba'i 'gyur ldog dang drag shul gyi las/ khong khro mya ngan lta bu'i sems las/ bsil drod mi snyoms pa'i kha zas sogs kyis skabs 'di'i nyer len gyi rgyu rims srin dang lhan cig tu rang gis skyed bya'i 'bras bu rims srin gyi stobs cher rgyas nas lus 'khrugs par byed pas na/ de ni rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin yang de gtso bor skyed byed yin pas de bzhin 'dod do/ / slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi bum chen las rims rkyen bstan pa'i skabs/ ya bdud gza' mchog rgyal bo khros:(gnyis pa rkyen bstan pa nam mkha'i rā hu la sogs/)ma bdud gting khams ma mo (rnams)g.yos:hal khyi (sa bdag)la sogs sde brgyad 'khrugs:gdug pa can (de rnams)gyi kha rlangs 'phros(pa las):nad kyi kha rlangs sprin du chags:nad mtshon mu ge char ltar babs:mdze (bal nad rgyu gzer gzhang 'brum la sogs/) dang dmu chu gnyan nad dang:rus nad nag po (dregs pa can gsum las dang po) mdze yis 'ardo/:khrag nad dmu chu rdzing du 'khyil:sha nad don snying gnyan gyis

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rmug:ces gsungs so:'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa las:rims kyi rkyen bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o:zhes skye bo'i bya spyod ngan pa de nad kyi rgyur bzhag cing rgyu der brten nas byung ba'i nad bdag 'khrug kha rlangs rkyen du bzhag pa ni spyi'i dbang du gsungs pa yin te/ rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gtso bor bzung tshe lus la lhan skyes su grub pa'i nyes gsum rnam par ma gyur ba de'i ngo bo ma snyoms par byas nas 'khrugs par byed spyad ni skabs 'dir mtshon na ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs sam rims srin de yin pas rkyen du bzhag 'on kyang 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i rims nad gtso bor bzung tshe de thog ma'i skyed byed mkha' 'gro ma mo'i kha rlangs yin zhing rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po rims srin de lus nas smin zhing mthar 'khrugs par byed pa'i grogs su gyur 'dug pas nyes gsum rkyen du bzhag de ni rgyud las/ de la rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu/3 rims nad kyi ngo bo dang brda don bshad pa/de yang rgyud las/ rgyu rkyen de yis mkhris pa'i me drod bslang / / rngul la babs nas bad kun mkhris pa rlung / / 'jug sgo drug tu rim pas 'jug pa 'am/ /dris phog yams su rim gyis 'gos pa'i phyir/ / rims zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ming du btags/ / zhes dang / khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas mdzad pa'i gso rig man ngag myong byang phyogs bsgrigs phan bde nor bu'i snye ma las/ rim gyis zhugs pa'i phyir na rims zhes bya/ /rim gyis smin dang na phyir rims zhes bya/ / zhes dang / cha lag bco brgyad du/ 'jug sgo drug tu rim pas 'jug phyir na rims/ nad kyi dri phog pa na yams su 'gos pa'i phyir na rims kyi tsha ba zhes bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du bstan pa'i rgyu rkyen de yis lus kyi me drod bslang zhing cher bskyed pa ni rims nad kyi ngo bo yin/ dper na me dang rlung gi rgyu rkyen gyis shing la yod pa'i me ༷/sa

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/cher bskyed nas me 'bar ba lta bu/ de na nad gzhi 'dir rims nad ces ming thog don dang ming de'i brda don sogs ci yin snyam na/ rims srin de thog mar lus su zhugs dus phyi'i skyir gnas pa'i rngul la babs/ de nas bad kun mkhris pa rlung gsum la rim pas 'bab cing thog mar mig dang sna rna mchu chu so bshang lam sogs gang rung nas 'jug cing phal che ba sna kho na nas 'jugade nas nang gi 'jug sgo sha lpags rtsa rus don snod bcas drug tu rim pas 'jug pas na rims zhes ming btags pa'am/ yang na nad de'i dri ma dngos sam nad yod sa nas du ba rlung sogs kyi dris phog na yams thabs su rim gyis gcig nas gcig la 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i phyir na rims zhes ming btags/ yang slob dpon dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa ru/ rims ni nad bdag sdig can dang / / 'chi bdag mdangs za 'chi byed yin/ / khros pas myur ba'i mchod sbyin brlag/ drag po dpral ba'i mig las byung / / skye dang 'chi tshe rmongs byed pa/ / mi 'phrod sna tshogs bsten las byung / / mi bzad ming ni sna tshogs pas/ / skyes gnas du ma rnams la gnas/ / de ni nad rnams so sor 'dres/ / 'dus dang glo bur las byung brgyad/ / de la nad rnams rang rang ni/ / rgyu las 'khrugs te ldang ba yis/ / ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs gyur ba/ / lhan cig gnas nas rtsa sgo bkag/ zhu ba'i gnas nas me drod ni/ / phyi rol du ni 'byin par byed/ / de dang lhan cig mngon khyab nas/ /lus kun tsha bar byed pa yin/ / yan lag shin tu tsha byed par/ /rims ni de yin skyed par byed/ / ces dang / yang de las/ gang phyir ma zhu gnas ma zhu/ /rgyun sung bkag ste me drod nyams/ / rims kyis nyes pa skyed byed pas/ / sngon tshul byung dang rims sogs la'ang / / de phyir smyung ba bya dgos la/ /stobs ni 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rims ni tt+waṃ 4zas dang spyod lam sogs mi 'phrod pa'i rigs bsten pas byung zhing /

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/nad de mi bzad cing brnag par dka' ba dang / nad ming sna tshogs pa sogs pa'i tshul gyis rta dang glang bo sogs skye gnas tha dad pa'i lus la'ang gnas te/ glang bo che'i lus la ni smin ma 'dzin zhes bya la/ rta'i lus la ni so po'i zhes bya dang / lug gi lus la ni tal ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i ming gis gnas/ de yang 'grel ba zla zer du/ gang gi phyir ma zhu ba'i gnas la gnas pa'i nad rlung la sogs pa gang yin pa de ma zhu ba dang bcas par gnas pa na ma zhu ba ste/ des rgyun srang gi bu ga bkag cing rgyur mi rung bar byas nas khong pa'i me drod nyams shing 'bri bar byed nas rims skyed cing 'byung bar byed pas na/ de'i phyir rims la ni dang po snang ba bya dgos so/ / rims phyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sngon tshul gsal bar 'byung zhing snang bar gyur ba'am/rims la sogs pa gsal ba nyid du snang na yang smyung ba bya zhing / nad pa'i nyams stobs 'bad pas bsrung zhing bskyang bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i rims de rgyu ma zhu bar brten nas byung bas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi gtso byas pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung rnams su 'khod pa'i rims gnyis tha dad yin mod/ de gnyis kyang tsha ba'i khongs su gtogs/gnyis pa/ gnyan bshad pa/spyir rims dang gnyan zhes pa gnyis kyi thog ma'i nad rgyu dang nad rkyen de'i gyur tshul rnams phal cher gcig mtshungs su snang zhing / de gnyis kyi dbye mtshams 'di zhes gsal bo zhig mi 'dug dper na rgyud du gsungs pa'i rims nad rigs khag cig gzhung 'gar gnyan nad kyi khongs su bgrang 'dug pa lta bu/ de na rims dang gnyan zhes pa'i nad ming gnyis sdi spyan

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gcig ming gi rnams grangs su 'jog rgyu yin nam nad gzhi gcig yin pa la de'i lci yang gi khyad par zhig tu 'dod ce na/ phran gyis rims dang gnyan gang yin rung nad rgyu snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i spyod pa tha shal du gyur bas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams khros te de'i kha rlangs las btab pa'i 'gos nad yin pas de gnyis kyi spyi'i rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul rnams mtshungs kyang / bye brag gi sgo nas bshad na nad gzhi 'di gnyis kyi thog ma'i nad rgyu tha dad yin zhing /gcig nas gcig la 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i 'gos srin de'i sde khongs so sor 'dug par snyam/ de'i skor gsham nas cung rgyas bshad bya rgyu yin pas skabs babs gong tsam gyis chog par bya/1 gnyan nadabya rgyu bshad pa/de yang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod du/ gsum pa gnyan gzer bcos pa ni/ rgyu ni lta ba log padang / mi gtsang pa dang / lha 'dre khros pa dang / gnyan sar nyal ba la sogs pas gdug pa/ gnyan gyi nad 'byung ngo zhes gnyan rgyu dmigs bsal du bstan/ gzhan yang mgo log stag bla nor bus mdzad pa'i gso byed man ngag gces bsgrigs kyi gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda' ru/ dus ngan sems can dmu rgod pas:las ngan spyod pa sna tshogs kyis:ma mo lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs:khyad par mtha' ma'i dug rdzas kyis:g.yo thabs me skyogs la sogs pa'i:grib kyis mnol grib phog pa yi:lha srin ma mo mnol ba'i grib:'gro ba rnams la phog pa yin:zhes pa dang / yang de las gnyan rigs bco brgyad bcos thabs su/ deng dus mi srun snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ /khrims la mi gnas mna' za nang dme byed/ / bag med tho cos lha klu kun la bsdos/ /dam tshig mi bsrung bla ma'i bka' yang bcag/ ma rung mi dge spyod ngan sna tshokāshākyis/ / srung ma'i thugs khros lha yang bdud du babs/ / ma mo'i kha

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rlangs gdug pa sprin du chags/ / gnyan rgod rims nad char ltar 'bab pa las/ / zhes dang / khams gtsang lags nas/ yang cig skal ba dus kyi tha ma la/ / bsod nams mthu zhan snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ / skyes bus mna' za sdig stobs gang che 'gran/ / log ltas rgyud dkrugs dge 'dun dgon gnas bcom/ / bud med blo rno dmag jag kha lo bsgyur/ / thabs kyis bslu zhing dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad/ / btsun pa'i 'dul khrims mi bsrung dkor la g.yeng / / zab mo'i don dang sngags la gshe skur 'debs/ / sngags pa'i dam tshig mi bsrung bla ma bsdo/ / zab chos nyams su mi len zong dang brje/ / rnal 'byor ma grol grol brdzu'i dbang khrid 'debs/ / bsnyen bsgrub mi nus las sbyor phungs bshig bsgrub/ / mdor na mi dge spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis/ / srung ma'i thugs khros lha yang bdud du babs/ / rgya 'dre rgyal 'gong dam sri'i glags rnyed cing / / gza' klu ma mo'i kha rlangs sprin du 'khrigs/ / gnyan nad nag po'i rims rgod char bzhin babs/ / zhes gsungs pa'ang rims nad kyi rgyu dang 'dra yang / gong smras ltar gnyan rims gnyis ni dus snyigs mar ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis btab pa'i 'gos nad rigs yin pas na'o/ / yang man ngag lhan thabs su/de la rgyu ni dug gsum las skyed pa'i/ / sde brgyad la sogs drag po'i las yin te/ / rkyen ni mi bsrun snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ / khrims la mi gnas mna' za nang dme byed/ / bag med tho cos lha klu kun la bsdos/ / dam tshig mi srung bla ma'i bka' yang bcag/ ma rung mi dge spyod lam sna tshogs kyis/ /srung ma'i thugs khros lha yang bdud du babs/ / ma mo'i kha rlangs gdug pa sprin du 'khrigs/ / gnyan rgod rims nad char bzhin bab pa las/ / spra ba rlan med me dang phrad pa bzhin/ / rgyu la rkyen de tre tre ho zhes sam/ / zhes par dbye zhib tsam byas na/ gong gi 'di rnams ni rlung mkhris bad kun /snam

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'phel zad 'khrugs par byed pa la gzhir bzung nas gsungs pas na ma mo mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs las byung ba'i tre tre ho rkyen du bzhag pa las/ gnyan nad gtso bor bzung tshe tre tro ho rgyu kho na ru zad/ de ni phyi rol gyi gnyan srin tro tre ho 'di lus su zhugs nas de ru gnyan srin de yi rdzas rgyun du gyur ba'i gnyanasrin de rigs mang du 'phel zhing lus 'khrugs par byed pas na'o/ /don dam du gnyan nad skyed par byed pa'i dngos rgyu der phyi'i rgyu dang nang gi rgyu gnyis su mchis te/dang po/ phyi'i rgyu ni man ngag lhan thabs su/ rgyu la rkyen de tree tre ho zhes sam/ /par pa ta de srin gyi gzugs sprul pa/ / rtsangs pa'i mgo dbyibs kha che sbrul lta bu'i/ /mjug ring rta bla ltar du yan lag mang / /rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba ste/ /bar snang khams nas ba spu'i sna sgor 'jug/ ces dang / slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi bum chung las/ bskal ba dus kyi snyigs ma la/ gnyan nad bdun drug ma bya bas/ 'dzam gling mi yi bzhi cha phyags mas bdas bzhin 'chi ba yin nges pas/ de la bcos thabs shin tu gces pas/ mnga' bdag gi thugs la zhog khong lhog nag po gnyan gyi nad/'di la gnas ni nam mkha' la gnas/ mi la babs na nad rigs bzhi yod/don gcig las med/ gnyan nad yin/ 'di la babs sa bzhi yod/ nad gzhi gang yod par 'bab/ ming ni srin bu par pa ta bya ba yin/ rgyu ni gdon gyisakhyed/ 'jug ni ba spu'i bu ga dang sna nas 'jug ces dang / mgo log stag lha nor bus mdzad pa'i gso byed man ngag gces bsgrigs kyi gnyan 'jomasardo rje thog mda' ru/ de ru sdig pa'i rang gzugs su:yid kyi lus can srin bu'i gzugs:las ngan spyod pas stobs rtsal rgyas:nad kyi rigs gyur gang la yang:bsdong nas sems can srog la rgol:khyad par dug thos sbyotā ༵ yis:grib dang mi gtsang gos grib sogs:lus la phog pa'i sna drangs

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/nas:skye bo'i ba spu'i khung nas zhugs:zhes phyi rol du gnas pa'i par pa ta de yis sprul ba'i gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur nas bsod nams dman pa'i skye bo'i lus su 'jug par byed pas na de ni phyi'i rgyur nges/ de na gnyan srin par pa ta de nad kyi rgyur bzhag na de skyed byed ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i gdon yin pas/ nad kyi rkyen bshad skabs dus gdon zas spyod bzhi rkyen du bzhag 'dug pas mi 'gal lam zer na/ spyir gdon la rigs mang zhing gdon nad thams cad gnyan rims kyi khongs su gtogs mi srid/ de ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhir/ gdon la 'byung bo'i gdon dang smyo byed dang / /brjed byed gza' dang klu gdon rnam lngar bshad/ / ces dang / 'byung bo'i gdon dang smyo byed gdon la sogs par yang nang gses kyi dbye ba mang du mchis/ dper na/ 'byung bo'i gdon la mtshon na rgyud las/ dbye ba lha dang lha min dri za klu/ / gnod sbyin tshangs pa srin po sha za dang / / yi dwags grul bum byad stems g.yeng byed dang / / ro langs mtshun lha bla ma drang srong rgan/ /grub pa zhes bya'i gdon chen bco brgyad do/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu/yang gdugs dkar du/ lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang /lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / ku sman da'i gdon rnams dang / srul bo'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul bo'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang /grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / gnon bo'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang / re lde 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams las bdag sruX chor

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i chu mdo'i le'u ru/'dra ba'i gzugs la gdon gyis ngos bzung pa/ / rma bya'i gdongs 'dra nag smug gnod/ / ba dan 'phyar 'dra mgon po gnod/ / lcags sgrog 'dra na lha mo gnod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar nad skyed par byed pa'i gdon rigs shin tu mang zhing / rigs mi 'dra ba'i gdon de dag gis btab pa'i nad thams cadaganyan rims kyi nad kho na min pa'ang gong las gsal/ lhag par nad bdag ma mo 'khrugs pa'i gdon gyis btab pa'i gnyan srin par pa ta rkyen du ma bzhag par rgyur bzhag don yang / 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i gnyan nad gtso bor bzung tshe de thog ma'i skyed byed par pa ta yin zhing rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po gnyan srin de yis lus nas rang gi rigs brgyud dam rdzas rgyun spel zhing mthar 'khrugs par byed pa la grogs su gyur 'dug pas na gdon gyis skyed pa'i par pa ta nad rgyur bzhag cing nyes gsum rkyen du bzhag pa ni/rgyutā las/ de la rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu / ga/nyis pa nang gi rgyu ni khams gtsang lags kyi phan bde snye ma ru/ de bstun lus nang gnas pa'i srin bu ni/ / khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de/ / khrag la gnas shing rtsa nang kun tu rgyu/ / gnyan nad kun gyi rgyu dang mdze nad byed/ / ces pa'i dug can srin bu rnam pa bdun/ / zangs ltar dmar zhing phra la ltar mi mngon/ / skad cig tsam la mgo rkang khyab rgyu nus/ / srin 'khrugs lus zungs zas pas gnyan nad 'byung / / zhes dang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ru/ rgyu ni khrag gnas dug can srin bu bdun/ / zangs ltar dmar zhing phra la ltar mi mngon/ / skad cig tsam la mgo rkang khyab rgyu nus/ / zhes dang / yang de las/ khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de/ / khrag la ga/sdu shing rtsa nang kun tu rgyu/ / gnyan nad kun gyi rgyu dang mdze nad byed/ /

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ces dang / slob dpon padma'i bdud rtsi bum par/ de rgyu chu ser nag po yin/khrag gnas dug can srin bur bshad/ ces dang / gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda' ru/ gnyan srin cir yang brdzu ba ni:gnyan dang bsdong ba'i srin rigs de:srin nad nag po rtsar rgyug zer:'byung bzhis bskyed pa'i 'dus phung la:lus skyed mdangs 'dzin srog 'tsho sogs:phan gnod srin bu grangs med gnas:lus kyi 'du ba ma 'khrugs shing:rkyen ni log lam ma bsgyur na:rang bzhin srin bu tshang la nyal:'du phung cha ma snyoms pa dang:rkyen gyis bsgyur bas srin khros nas:rnam pa sna tshogs nad du gyur:gnyan gyi rigs gyur grangs yang mang:zhes gsungs pa bzhin skye bo'i lus la thog ma nas lhan skyes su grub pa'i khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar zhing gtso che ba'i sgo nas rigs bdun du mchis pa de nang gi rgyur nges/2 gnyan nadakyi rkyen bshad pa/de yang rgyud las/ de la rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus/ / skyed byed yul dus zas spyod gdon rkyen gyis/ / srin 'khrugs lus zungs zas pas gnyan nad 'byung / / zhes gnyan rgyu par pa ta gtso bor bzung nas gsungs pas rlung mkhris bad kun gsum de slong byed kyi rkyen du bzhag yang de las/ nad 'di klu bdud byang sman rkyen byas nas/ / zhes gsungs pa ni rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gtso bor bzung bas skabs 'dir de gsum 'khrugs par byed pa la klu bdud bshos pa'i bu dang sngon dbang phyug gis sbyin sreg byas pa'i rngul gyi thigs pa me nang du song ba las skyes pa'i srid pa'i ma mo bdun gtso cher/ ri rab dang kai la sha'i gling du gnas par grags/ yang na dpal ldan re ma tī ste sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas 'di'i byang shar phyogs nas mi le ding gi rgya mtsho chen por yongs 'du'i shing la brten nas sman mo'i gzugs su gnas pa la byang sman zhes bya ba de gnyis dang gzhan yadī /mu

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/bdud ni sde brgyad kyi dmu dang bdud gnyis bsdongs pa'i sras te de rnams rkyen du bzhag de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i lag lenagaces btus su/ rgyu dang rkyen ni rims gnyan spyi bzhin ldang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyan rims gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen phal cher gcig mtshungs su mchis pas skabs babs gong tsam gyis chog par bya/3 gnyan nad kyi ngo bo dang brda don bshad pa/ngo bo ni de yang gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda' ru/ skye bo'i ba spu'i khung nas zhugs:lus gnas srin bu'i khog zhugs nas:srin bu gnyan dang bsdongs pa yis:lus zungs stobs rtsal cher rgyas 'gyur:srin bu'i gnas ni gang yin las:nad 'phar lus kun khyab par byed:ces dang / slob dpon padma'i gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa'i gnyan rims lhog pa'i bcos thabs su/ nad kyi ngo bo ni:kha che la mjug ma ring:yan lag ral ba bzhi yod pa:gnas ni sa 'og tu gnas:'gyu ba bar snang khams su 'gyu:'bab pa ni sems can gyi srog bcad pa la 'bab:byi la bzhin du 'jab nas 'ong:sha khyi bzhin du rtse'u chung la mchong:dmag mi bzhin du don snying brdzangs nas 'gro:zhes dang / kurma nges legs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i sman bsdus e las/ gnyan nad ces pa ni 'khrugs tshad le'u nas bshad pa'i gnyan dang / tsha ba spyi'i le'u nas bshad pa'i gnyan dang / bal nad kyi le'u nas gsungs pa'i gnyan (gag lhog sogs/)sogs dang / gter ma rnams nas bshad pa'i gnyan nad thams cad bstan to/ / de la nad stobs che chung gi dbye ba che ste deng sang rdzi bro tshad kyi mi 'khor gtib tu shi 'gro ba phyi nad du grags pa'i nad 'di yang gnyan nad las ma 'das/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi rol du gnas pa'i srin bu de'i kha che zhing yan lag mang la mardi/ ma ring ba/ gnas ni sa 'og tu gnas shing rlung gshog dang ldan phyir

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/bar snang khams su rgyu la/ de'i ming du par pa ta dang yang na tre tre ho sogs zer/ de nyid bar snang khams nas skye bo'i ba spu'i khung nas lus nang du zhugs shing thog ma nas lhan skyes su grub pa'i khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba rigs che ba bdun yod pa rnams dang phrad nas sprin pa rlung dang 'phrad pa ltar lus kyi gang sar byer zhing phyi ru don pa'am/ yang na rdza so gsar bar 'o ma chu dang 'phrad pa bzhin re zhig lus nas bag la nyal zhing rim bzhin byi la 'jab pa'i tshul lam rdza so nas chu 'dzum pa ltar gang sar byer bar byed/skabs 'di dang bstun nas gnyan sa 'dzin par byed cing ngo bo tsha ba las ma 'das/ de ni rgyud las/ mkhris tshad phyi rol rngul gyi sgor zhugs te/ / nang du mchin mkhris don snod gnyis la babs/ / rang sar mi gnas rtsa mig kun tu rgyug/ yar la mgo dang klad pa bad yul 'phrog/ mar la mkhal ma rgyungs par chu yul 'phrog/ don la glo dang snying la rlung yul 'phrog/ pho long rgyu ma snod du mkhris yul 'phrog/ mjug tu mkhris gnas rlung gis spyad byas nas/ / rang gnas srog rtsar 'chor bas 'tsho ba nyung / / zhes ngo bo mkhris tshad dang lhan cig 'phel ba de rnams phyi rol rngul gyi sgo ste ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te nang du mchin mkhris gnyis su babs pas khrag mkhris 'dres pa rang sar rlung gis bskyed nas mi gnas par rtsa yi mig kun tu rgyug ste yar la mgo dang klad par zhugs nas bad kun gyi yul 'phrog cing / mar la mkhal ma dang rgyungs par zhugs nas chu yul yang 'phrog don glo dang snying du zhugs nas rlung gi yul yang 'phrog sha lpags kyi phyir shor nas stobs dang kha dog kyang 'phrog mjug tu mkhris pa'i gnas rlung gis spyad par byas nas rang gnas srog rtsar 'chor ba'am shor bas 'tsho ba shin tu nyung ba'i nad gzhi zhig go/ mdor na mkhris pa me yi rang bzhin la dus gdon zas spyod bzhi bud shing lta bu de yis mkhris pa'i me sbar ba de rlung gis bskyod nas phyi kātyā gi

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gnyan srin 'thab pa'i tsha ba'i nad cig go/ brda don ni dpal spungs dbon kurma bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel las/ gnyan nad ni ngo bo lus la gnas pa'i lhan skyes kyi srin bu dang nad bdag gis skyed pa'i par pa ta zhes pa'i gdug can gyi srin bu gnyis rkyen gyis phrad nas lus zungs/ dri ma bcas la babs pa'i dug rims la zer zhing / nges tshig ni srin bu khros pa'i dug gas lus zungs dri ma bcas ma rung bar byed cing 'phral du srog 'phrog pa'i gdug pa can gyi nad nyen che ba'i ming ngo / / zhes dang / skyem 'grel las/ phyi'i gdon khros pa'i dug nang du khrag srin la 'phos pa'i dug rlangs las gnyan rims zhes kyang bya zhes dang /khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas/ shin tu srog la gzan phyir gnyan zhes bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi rol gyi gnyan srin par pa ta dang lus la lhan skyes su grub pa'i khrag srin gnyis lhan cig tu 'dus nas lus kyi gnyan sa bzung zhing mthar tshe srog la'ang gzan phyir de bzhin ming btags pa zhig go/gsum pa/ gnyan dang rims kyi khyad par bshadapa/gnyan dang rims gnyis kyi rgyu dang rkyen la ltos na lan rer nad gzhi de gnyis gzhi gcig tu grub 'dug pa'am lan rer so sor mchis pa'i tshor snang re ster/ de ni rgyud du gsungs pa'i rims nad 'ga' gzhung gzhan du gnyan nad kyi khongs su bgrang 'dug cing rgyud kyi rims rgyu yang gzhung 'gar gnyan rgyur 'khod 'dug dang po rims rgyur dper na rgyud kyi rims nad gso ba'i le'u ru/ rims zhes bya ba'i nad 'byung rgyu rkyen ni/ / lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyuX dzā na/ / mi rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis log par spyod/ / ces dang /

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/khams gtsang gi phan bde nor bu'i snye ma las/ gzhan yang gsang sngags sgrub rgyud gzhung rnams las/ / dus kyi spyod ngan 'thab gzhob dme 'khon dang / / sdom khrims bslab bya khas blangs dam tshig nyams/ / dge sdig rgyu 'bras spang blang khyad du bsad/ / dus der dam can srung ma'i thugs kyang khros/ /srid pa skye 'jig dbang byed ma mo 'khrugs/ / kha rlangs ma mo'i khrag nad dal yams gtong / /zhes dang / slob dpon padma'i bdud rtsi bum chen las rims rgyu bstan pa'i skabs/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams:log pa'i 'khrul 'khor (sdig pa)sna tshogs spyod:sngags pa (stag mo kha 'thab byed )rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams:btsun pa rtsa ba'i 'dul khrims nyams:zhes dus snyigs mar tha mal mi'i bya spyod tha shal du gyur rkyen nad rgyu de thon par gsungs/ gnyis pa gnyan rgyur dper na/ gso dpyad rgyal bo'i dkor mdzod du/ gsum pa gnyan gzer bcos pa ni/ rgyu ni lta ba log pa dang / mi gtsang pa dang / lha 'dre khros pa dang / gnyan sar nyal ba la sogs pas gdug pa/ gnyan gyi nad 'byung ngo zhes dang / stag lha nor bu'i gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda' ru/ dus ngan sems can dmu rgod pas:las ngan spyod pa sna tshogs kyis:ma mo lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs:zhes dang / yang de las gnyan rigs bco brgyad bcos thabs su/ deng dus mi srun snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ /khrims la mi gnas mna' za nang dme byed/ / bag med tho cos lha klu kun la bsdos/ /dam tshig mi bsrung bla ma'i bka' yang bcag/ ma rung mi dge spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis/ / srung ma'i thugs khros lha yang bdud du babs/ / ma mo'i kha rlangs gdug pa sprin du chags/ / gnyan rgod rims nad char ltar 'bab pa las/ /zhes dang / khams gtsang lags nas/ yang cig skal ba dus kyi tha ma la/ / bsod nams mthu zhan snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ / skyes bus mna' za sdig stobs gang che 'gran/ / log ltaswā /da

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/dkrugs dge 'dun dgon gnas bcom/ / bud med blo rno dmag jag kha lo bsgyur/ / thabs kyis bslu zhing dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad/ / btsun pa'i 'dul khrims mi bsrung dkor la g.yeng / / zhes gsungs pa yang gong gi rims rgyu dang gnyis su ma mchis/ de bzhin rkyen dang gyur tshul la'ang legs par ma dpyad tshe gcig mtshungs su mchis pa'i snang ba zhig ster srid/ de na rims srin dang gnyan srin (gnyan rims)gnyis la khyad par e yod zer na de gnyis kyang gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i rigs yin yang / blo rnal mas brtag tshe gnyan nad dang rims nad gnyis la he bag shin tu che/ de ni/ thog mar rims 'jug de nas gnyan 'byung ste/ /rims ma byung bar gnyan nad 'byung mi srid/ / ces par gzhigs na rims nad kyi rgyu de gnyan nad kyi ring rgyur nges shing / par pa ta de nyid gnyan nad kyi nyer len rgyur nges/ khams gtsang 'brug rgyal mchog nas gnyan nad kyi ngo bo gsungs skabs/ rims bzhin dris phog 'gos nas mched pa sogs/ /ltar snang rims nad spyi dang 'dra na yang / / 'di la sgos kyi gnyen pos ma slebs na/ / gso ba log cing srog gi gshed mar 'gro/ zhes dang / yang khong gis/ gnyan gyi bsdongs zla med pa rims rkyang dang / / gnyan dang bsdongs pa rims smon zhes bya yin/ / gnyan rims gnyis ni pha gcig spun dang 'dra/ / gcig grogs gcig gis byed cing gros kha mthun/ / zhes dang /yang khong gis/ tsha ba rims dang gnyan nad rnam pa gsum/ /rim pas phyi ma stobs che mthu nus myur/ / de phyir ched bcos kho nas rims mi sel/ /rims bcos rkyang pas gnyan nad sel ba min/ / zhes gsungs pa rnams la gzhigs na gnyan dang rims gnyis ni 'gos nad rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis su mchis shing / de gnyis kyi nad rgyu tha dad yin phyir de gso bar byed pa'i gardi/ po'i sman yang tha dad yin pa sogs gsal bor bstan mod/ gcig

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/grogs gcig gis byed pa'i nad 'di gnyis so sor ngos 'dzin gnang skabs 'di ni rims rkyang ngo 'di ni gnyan dang bsdongs pa'i rims smyon no 'di ni gnyan rkyang ngo zhes kha dmar gdags rgyu yang shin tu khag de ni sman bsdus e las/ gnyan rims kyang spyir bal nad du 'dus mod kyang / bal nad rims rkyang zhes pa ni gnyan rims phar sel ba yin no/ / 'di la deng sang gi dus 'dir gnyan rims dang ma 'dres pa med pa'i tshod du yod 'dra la/ gal te rims kyang gi lugs su byas na rims yin pa tsam ni thams cad kyis shes sla la/ gnyan dang 'dres sam ma 'dres ni sman pas kyang dbye dka'o/ / zhes dang yang de las/ rims tshad spyi'i sman gyis 'di sel zhing / ma smin dang stong pa'i skor ni tsha ba spyi dang 'phrul shes pa nyid 'dir ma zad gnyan kyang la'ang dgos rgyur snang ngo zhes gsungs par gzhigs na rims dang ma bsdongs pa'i gnyan nad rkyang pa zhig kyang yod 'dug de na gong du bstan pa'i thog mar rims 'jug de nas gnyan 'byung ste/ / rims ma byung bar gnyan nad 'byung mi srid/ / ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun pas/ gong 'og gi lta ba 'di gnyis las gang zhig 'thad ldan dang gang zhig dor byar 'dzin rgyu'i spod pa phran la ma mchis mod/ gang ltar nad gzhi 'di gnyis kyi thog ma'i nad rgyu tha dad yin zhing mthar gso bya'i lus la dpung 'jugakhyed pa'i thabs kyang tha dad du snang / bdag gis rims dang gnyan zhes pa'i nad gzhi gnyis la 'di lta bu'i sdom tshig 'jog par 'dod de/rims rkyang zer tshe 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i srin rigs de dag skye bo'i lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga dang sna khung sogs brgyud nas lus su zhugs rjes de dag gis rang gi rigs brgyud spel nas nad du gyur ba zhig dang / gnyan nad zer tshe srin rigs de dag lus su zhugs rjes lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs dang bsdongs nas rang gi rigs brgyud spel zhing nad du gyur ba zhig la ngos /ltong

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/na legs par snyam/ rims srin yin tshe lus nas rang gi rigs brgyud spel ba las lhan skyes kyi khrag srin dang mi bsdongs pa zhig dang / gnyan srin yin tshe lhanaskyes kyi khrag srin dang bsdongs te lus nas rang gi rigs brgyud spel ba/de rims dang ma bsdongs tshe gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro bul zhing nad gzhi'i ngo bo yang ba/ rims dang bsdongs tshe yams thabs su gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro myur zhing nad gzhi'i ngo bo shin tu lci ba zhig bcas so sor go na legs snyam/

le'u gsum pa/ deng rabs gso rig las bshad pa'i dbyi gan nad ces pa'i skor bshad pa/dang po/ 'gos nad kyi brda don dang ngo bo bshad pa/dbyi kun nad ni nub lugs gso rig gi 'gos nad rig pa'i (6༅tsho)khongs su 'dus shing / nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i 'gos nad rig pa ni phyi rol gyi 'bu phra rab bam skye dngos phra rab (747)mi'i lus su zhugs rjes srin bu de dag mi'i lus nas 'phel zhing lhan skyes srin bu'i rigs 'gar 'khrugs rtsod byung ba'i rgyud rim der zer/ 'gos nad la tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen ni srog 'tsho ba la nges par du mkho ba'i lhan skyes su mchis pa'i srin rigs ma yin pa'i 'bu phra rab dang / mi'i lus/ 'bu phra rab de yis 'dzin sa'i gnas bcas gsum yin/ mi'i rigs rgyun ring phyi'i khor yug gi 'gyur ldog khrod skye dngos phra rab dag dang phrad mang yang 'dris goms sgos gang mang zhig rma byas dug zos pa bzhin 'dris par gyur/ 'on kyang zungs stobs zhan pa'am 'du ba'i cha ma snyoms pa'i skabs skye dngos phra rab de dag lus su zhugs shing rim bzhin 'phel bas mthar nad skyed par byed/ zungs stobasabazang zhing 'du ba'i cha snyoms skabs skye dngos phra rab de dag lus su zhugs kyang lus nas 'phel mi thub par rim bzhin shi 'gro ba'am yang na dri ma rnams dang lhan lus kyi phyi rol du dor 'gro/ skye dngos phra rab de dag phyi'i rgyu kho na ru zad pas 'gos nad rigs 'byung min gtso bo nang gi rgyu rkyen ༷ ༅rag

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/las/ de ni 'gos nad de rigs las thar ba'am der sngon 'gog gi nus shugs ldan pa'i rigs la 'gos mi srid/ 'gos nad tshang mar 'go ba'i rang bzhin mchis pa ni 'gos nad dang tsha ba'i nad kyi dbye ba gtso bo yin/gnyis pa/ 'gos nad kyi rgya bshad pa/mi dang dud 'gro'i lus nas nad rgyu'i srin bu 'phel zhing rim bzhin phyi rol du dor ba de 'gos nad skyed byed kyi rgyu yin/gsum pa/ 'gos nad kyi rkyen bshad pa/'gos mched du 'gro ba der yang phyi'i khor yug gi rkyen dang spyi tshogs kyi rkyen bcas gnyis mchis/ snga ma ni gnam gshes kyi dro grang dang khor yug gi skye dngos bcas la 'brel ba yod/ phyi ma ni spyi tshogs lam lugs dang dpal 'byor lam lugs/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen/ bsam blo'i go rtogs bcas la 'brel ba yod/ dper na dbyar gzhung du gnam gshes tsha bas tshad 'khru dang dbyi zhin klad gnyan (mchos7)lta bu'i nad 'gos tshad mtho/ dgun dpyid kyi nam zla grang bas nyin brgya'i lu nad (057)dang gnyan rgyungs babs ( 04 tsho ྅)'gos tshad mtho/ de bzhin 'brog khul du po hri zlum srin (lkoṣṭhapo )dang chu skran (7yo )rigs 'byung mang zhing / dung 'bu gso skyongabyed sa'i gnas su khrag 'jib srin bus ( smoyoṭha)so btab pa'i rigs 'byung mang / chu gnas srog chags kyi sha za ba'i gnas su ha kri go srin bus (44 smoyol)so btab pa'i rigs 'byung mang /40

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/bzhi ba/ 'gos nad rigs 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim bshad pa/'gos nad rigs 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim ni mi tshogs su dar zhing mched pa dang de ru rim bzhin phyir ldog pa bcas yin/ 'gos mched du 'gro bar nad rgyu'i srin bu dang 'go sa'i rgyu lam/ 'go gnas kyi mi tshogs bcas cha rkyen gsum 'dzoms dgos/ sngon 'gog byed dgos tshe nad rgyur bdag dam dang 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i rgyu lam gcod pa/ 'go gnas kyi mi tshogs la srung skyob bcas byas nas gong gi sna gsum po las sna gcig gam sna gnyis la bdag dam legs po rgyag thub na 'gos nad rigs 'go sa'i rgyun gcod thub/ de yang 'gos nad rigs kyi rgyu lam dang brgyud rim dngos ni nad rgyu'i srin bu de rang gi skye 'phel byung sa'i lus dang bral rjes gzhan zhig gi lus su 'dzul ba'i brgyud rim der zer/ 'gos nad rigs tshang mar nadagazhi rang rang skyed byed kyi 'gos srin re mchis shing 'gos srin de yis 'gos nad de kho na skyed par byed/ der skye dngos phra rab dang srin bu bcas rigs che ba gnyis yod/ nad rgyu'i srin bu'i dbye ba las thog mar lus su zhugs pa'i rnam pa'ang mi 'dra ste/ dumakha' dbugs dang mchil ma'i zegs ma'am yang na sa rdul las 'gos pa'i rigs ni gtso che ba glo yur phog pa'i 'gos nad rigs yin/ de yang sib bi dang nyin brgya'i lu nad/ gnyan rgyungs babs dag gi nad rgyu'i gnyan srin gre ba sogs brgyud nas phyir thon zhing srin bu de rigs gong du bshad pa'i mchil ma'i zegs ma sogs dang lhan gang sar rgyu/ dubatung chu dang kha zas sam yang na sbrang bus so btastu /sa

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'gos pa'i rigs ni 'ju byed ma lag las byung ba'i 'gos nad rigs yin/dper na tshad 'khru dang rgyu rims lta bu/ dulag pa dang ca lag rtse spyad sogs las 'gos pa'i rigs ni glo ba dang 'ju byed ma lag la byung ba'i rigs yin/0khrag dang zags chu las 'gos pa'i rigs ni dbyi kun dang pin kun/ya/5reg dug lta bu yin/ 'gos nad gang yin rung de'i 'go gnas sngon 'gos nad de rigs phog ma myong zhing de'i 'gog nus lus khams su grub med pa'i mi rnams yin/ de lta bu'i mi mang tshe 'gos nad de mi tshogs de'i khrod nas mched sla/lnga ba/ 'gos nad rigs kyi dbye ba bshad pa/1 'gos nad rigs kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba/nad skyed byed kyi skye dngos phra rab mi'i lus khams su skye 'phel byung ba'i brgyud rim nang / skyed byed rgyu de dang zhugs gnas mi'i zungs stobs kyi che chung dbang gis 'bras bu'i nad kyi rnam pa'ang mi 'dra bar thon pas de rigs re re nas brjod na gsham ltar te/ dund rgyu'i srin bu shi ba'am phyir 'pho ba/mi'i lus na nas 'gog gi nus pa ldan phyir skye dngos phra rab gang mang zhig lus kyi cha shas gang rung nas shi 'gro ba'am yang na dri ma rnams dang lhan du phyir 'pho bar byed pa ste/ skye dngos phra rab de dag lus su zhugs tshe pags pa'i 'byar skyir de rigs 'gog par byed pa'i nus pa ldan phyir 'gag 'phrang 'di nas gang mang zhig lus kyi nang log tu zhugs mi thub/ pho ba'i ngos kyi pho skyur dang lus kyi gang sar khyab pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba'i chu khams su skye dngos phra ༵༵ gang mang zhig gsod par byed pa'i nus pa ldan phyir nad rgyu'i srin bu

ri bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gang mang zhig lus khams su zhugs rjes shi 'gro/ sna khung dang gre ba rgyu long mkhal ma ba spu'i bu ga dag brgyud nas nad rgyu'i srin bu gang mang zhig lus kyi phyi rol du 'pho bar byed/ dund rgyu bag tu nyal ba'i rigs (lams 'icho)/ nad rgyu'i srin bu mi'i lus nas nad skyed sa'i gnas sam der thag ring ba'i don snod du 'phel yang / nad rtags ci yang mi mngon pa'i snang tshul der nad rgyu bag la nyal ba'i rigs zer/ der rgyun ldan bag nyal dang thog ma'i bag nyal/ drag skyed bag nyal bcas gsum mchis/ drag skyed bag nyal gyi dus yun phal che ba zla gsum yin zhing der rgyun ring dang gnas skabs bcas rigs gnyis mchis/ bag tu nyal ba'i rigs gang yin yang nad rgyu phyir 'pho bzhin pas/ de ltar phyir 'phos pa'i srin rigs rnams de sngon nad 'di 'gos med pa'i mi gzhan par nad de 'go bar byed pa'i rgyu yin/ mend rgyu gzha' ba'i rigs( ṣṭha 4)/ nad rgyu'i srin bu lus su zhugs rjes 'bab gnas la nad 'gyur mi byung ba'am yang na nad 'gyur phran tsam byung yang mang che bar nad rtags med cing spyir btang gi rdzas 'gyur rig pas brtag tshe nad rgyu'i srin bu mi mthong ba/ 'gos thar rig pa'i ched spyod 'phrul chas (rdo ༅༅lkoṣṭha༅)kyis brtag tshe nad rgyu'i srin bu 'gos 'dug pa mthong / nad rgyu gzha' ba'i rigs mang che ba nad de'i gnyen po'i sman la bston nas nad rgyu'i srin bu rtsa med du gtong skabs srin bu re gnyis gsod ma thub par lus khams nas gzha' zhing lus/ lus yod pa'i srin bu de dag kyang gong gi bag nyal rigs kyi srin bu ltar gso bya gzhan par 'go byed kyi rgyu yin/duthog ma'i skabs ( ṣṭhaṣṭha lko)/ nad rgyu'i srin bu lus su zhugs rjes lus kyi lhan skyes srin bu dang nad rgyu'i srin bu gnyis phan tshun 'thab rtsod 'og re zhig do mnyam pa'i tshul du gcig gshed gcig gis byed ma thub pa'i skabs der nad rtags ci yang med/ gal te mi'i lus kyi sngon 'gog gi cha dīsna'

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/bar gyur tshe lus su zhugs pa'i srin bu de rigs 'phel zhing nad skyed par byed/spyir thog ma'i skabs 'dir srin bu lus kyi phyi rol du mi 'pho bas mi gzhan par 'go mi srid/ dund rtags gsal ba'i skabs (2cho lko)/ nad rgyu'i srin bu lus su zhugs rjes de yis 'bab gnas sogs su nad 'gyur btang bas nad rtags gsal bar gyur/ gso bya 'di dag las mang che bar sangs drag byung zhing lus khams su nad rgyu'i srin bu de med par gyur/ re gnyis dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi bag tu nyal ba'i rigs su gyur zhing gso bya gzhan par 'go byed kyi rgyu yin/ gong gi rigs lnga bo cha rkyen nges can 'og phan tshun 'gyur 'gro zhing / de dag las ches mthong mang ba gzha' ba'i rigs dang de nas bag la nyal ba'i rigs yin/ ches mthong nyung ba rtags gsal ba'i rigs yin/2 'gos nad rigs dus kyi sgo nas dbye ba/'gos nad rigs dus kyi sgo nas dbye bar rnam pa bzhi mchis te/ ()yib pa'i dus ( 57)/ 'gos rgyu'i srin bu lus su zhugs pa nas thog ma'i nad rtags mngon pa'i yun der zer/ 'gos nad so so'i yib dus kyi dus yun mi 'dra mod/ spyir yib dus ni 'gos rgyu'i srin bu lus nas 'phel zhing gzhan gnas su zhugs pa dang / de ru gnas bzung bas cha shas der nad 'gyurabyung zhing cha shas de'i byed las la 'gyur ldog byung rjes kyi nad rtags mngon pa'i sngon gyi dus der zer/ rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'gos nad so so'i yib dus kyi yun der ches ring ba'i dus yun la nyin ga tshod tsam mam dus tshod ga tshod tsam/ ches thung ba'i dus yun la nyin ga tshod tsam mam dus tshon ga tshod tsam lta bu'i gtan khel gyi yun re mchis/ dus yun de'i ring thung gis nad gzhi'i ngos 'dzin par grogs byed/ duthog ma'i dus (mo༅7)/ na ba'i 'asdi )rtsam pa nas nad shugs rdzogs te nad rtags gsal ba'i dus yun la

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/zer/ 'gos nad yongs sam phal che ba'i gtso bo'i nad rtags su nyin gcig nas nyi shu bar mgo na zhing tsha ba rgyas pa dang sgyid pa skyur ba/ zas kyi dang ga med pa/ yan lag bzhi na ba sogs kyi rtags thon/ 'on kyang myur ba'i rigs la thog ma'i dus med/ ༷rtags gsal ba'i dus(47777)/rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'gos nad so sor gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nad rtags dang na lugs/ rdzas 'gyur brtag dbyad kyi dpyad 'bras re mchis/ nad gzhi mang che ba yang ba nas lci ba dang / de nas nad shugs rdzogs pa/ mthar de'i 'gog nus ('gos nad de las thar ma)thon pa/ dus 'dir bla gnyan gyi nad 'byung sla/ rjodrag skyed byung ba'i dus(ṣṭha77)/ na lugs dang nad rtags phal che ba med par gyur zhing / zungs stobs dang zas kyi yi ga sngar bzhin thon pa ste/ phyi'i rnam par ltos na nad gzhi de dang yongs su bral 'dug pa'i dus der zer/ skabs 'dir gso bya'i zungs khrag la rdzas 'gyur gyis brtag tshe 'gos nad de'i 'gog rdzas kyi cha je mthor song 'dug la/ rim bzhin 'gog rdzas de'i cha ches mtho sa'i tshad du slebs nges/ gso bya re gnyis la sangs drag ma byung bar dal ba'i rang bzhin can du 'gyur ba'am nad gzhug lus srid/ dubaskyar byung gi skabs(zo'iXrsā7)/ drag skyed kyi dus sam sangs drag byung ba'i thog ma'i dus su nad rgyu'i 'gos srin slar lus nas 'phel zhing na bar bskyar byung zer/3 'gos nad kyi nad rtags dang na lugs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ca tsha ba rgyas pa ni 'gos nad mang che bar yod pa'i rgyun mthong gi nad rtags sheg yin/ der yun ring tsha ba rgyas shing chu tshod nyer bzhi'i ring tsha tshad la 'gyur ldog tu'u gcig las mi brgal ba'i rigs shig dang / yun ring tsha ba rgyas shing chu tshod nyer bzhi'i ring tsha tshad la 'gyur ldog tu'u gcig las brgal zhing ches dma' ba'i skabs tsha tshad rgyun ldan las mtho bar yokā sna'i

rigs shig dang / chu tshod nyer bzhi'i ring lan rer tsha tshad shin tu mtho zhing lan rer rgyun ldan skabs las tsha tshad dma' bar thon pa'i rigs shig dang /thog mar nyin shas ring tsha ba chen po rgyas shing de nas nyin shas yun rgyun ldan du gyur ba dang / de nas yang tsha ba rgyas pa'i rigs shig bcas bzhi mchis/
