le'u bzhi ba/ deng rabs gso rig las bshad pa'i dbyi gan nad de bod lugs gso rig gi nad gzhi gang zhig yin pa'i skor la dpyadapa/dang po/ gzhan lugs dgag pa/nye lam rang cag bod lugs gso byed pa tshos nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i dbyi kun nad mchin nad ldem bur ngos 'dzin pa'am mchin nad dug thabs la ngos 'dzin pa/ dwangs ma ma zhu bar ngos 'dzin pa sogs shin trī mang bas/ lta ba de rnams la zhib tu dpyad na gsham gyi sdom tshig 'di sdubam chi/ na nad ldem bur ngos 'dzin pa ni/rgyud bzhi las/ mchin nad ldem bu na ba mi tshor bar/ / gnyid med khong snyoms lus lci zas mi 'dod/ / khrag 'bros sha dang rus pa khad kyis skem/ / zhes 'phral du na ba mi tshor bar na rgyu ci yang mi 'dug snyam zhing gnyid med pa dang / khong snyoms pa ste sgyid lug pa/ lus po lci la kha zas mi 'dod pa/ khrag 'bros sha dang rus pa khad kyis zhes cha cha nas rim gyis skem 'gro/ dbyi kun nad kyang ches thog mar kha zas la yi ga med cing sgyid pa skyur ba tsam las na rgyu ci yang med pa'am/ yang na gnyan srin bag la nyal ba'i rigs rnams dus rtag tu na rgyu med pas/ de gnyis la na ba mi tshor bdī /da

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/rtags re mchis shing nad rtags gzhan rnams kyang cung mtshungs phyir nub lugs dbyi kun nad de bdag cag bod lugs gso rig gi mchin nad bco brgyad kyi nang gses mchin nad ldem bur 'dod pa'i lta ba de thon/ spyir gzhung lugs gnyis kyi khrod nas bsdur dpyod sgos nad gzhi gcig la dbye zhib mdzad dgos tshe/ gzhung lugs so so'i lam nas nad de'i nad rgyu dang de slong bar byed pa'i rkyen/ de'i gyur tshul dang nad rtags rnams gcig mtshungs su 'dug min la dpyad rgyu ni g.yol thabs med pa'i 'gro lam zhig yin/ de na skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i nub lugs dbyi kun nad 'di mchin nad ldem bu yin min brtag tshe thog mar gzhung lugs so so'i lam nas de gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul la dbye zhib tsam bgyis na 'di lta ste/dang po mchin nad ldem bu zhes pa'i brda don 'dir gzhi bcol nas cung dpyad par bgyis na/ mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis mdzad pa'i drang srong zhal lung du/ mchin nad ldem bu zhes mchin pa mnyen po chags pa'i don la go bas/ mchin pa spyir dus rgyun khrob khrob gcig yod pa la/ mchin par tshad rnying zhen nas khrag dang brlan bsher gyi cha nyung drags nas mchin pa 'khums pa'am skem drags nas mchin pa'i nus pa shor ba ma zad/ ngo bo chung du song ba dang / skom du phyin nas mchin pa de nyid mnyen po ldem ldem gnyer ma can chags pa zhig yin/ de'i rtags su 'phral du na ba mi tshor ba ste mi bde mngon gsal med pa/ de nas rim bzhin gnyid med pa dang / khong snyom pa ste sgyid lug pa/ lus khams lci ba la zas mi 'dod cing / de'i rkyen pas ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu bzhin du khrag 'bros pa ste/ khrag rgyun gsor nyung bas rim bzhin nyung du phyin pas na sha dang dus pa khad kyis zhes dal ba'am rim gyis skom 'gro ba zhig yin/ zhes snga na ma grags pa'i bla med kyi gsal 'grel mdzad cirshatāng gi dgongs don de las nga tshos gsal rtogs thub pa ni nad 'di'i

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/thog ma'i nad rgyu mchin par tshad rnying zhen zhing / khrag dang brlan bsher gyi cha je nyung du gyur bas mchin pa de nyid mnyen po ldem ldem gnyer ma can du chags pa zhig yin mod/ dbyi gan nad kyi nad rgyu ni phyi rol gyi gnyan srin ba spu'i bu ga'am sna khung dang / lus na rma yod pa'i rma kha sogs brgyud nas gnyan rims spyi'i 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i rim pa ltar 'gos pa zhig yin zhing / gnyan srin 'gos yod tshad kyi mchin pa 'khums shing mchin nus shor ba dang / ngo bo chung du song zhing ldem ldem gnyer ma can sogs su 'gyur mi 'dug la/ khrag dang sha rus pa sogs kyang skem mi 'gro bas/ nad gzhi de gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbyar thabs bral/2 mchin nad dug thabs la ngos 'dzin pa/dbyi kun nad kyi rgyu g.yayiganyan srin yin zhing / yaktamyoganyan srin der nub lugs gso rig gis yaktamyos zer/ la zhes pa'i ming tshig de rgya bod tshig mdzod sogs su thad bsgyur byas nas nad dug ces bkod 'dug cing / mchin nad dug thabs kyang dug gis skyed pa red snyam nas de gnyis nad gzhi gcig tu yin par 'dod/ spyir dug thabs ni gso rig kun 'dus las/ dug thabs ni dug nad rtags ltar ston pas na mig dmar zhing gdong sngo la rtsib steng zug gzer dang pho mchin gang snyam sems/ kha zas 'ju dka' la zos tshe na ba dang brun skom par 'gyur/ bol gong skrangs shing mur gong dang mthil bzhi ser por 'gro/ yun lon tshe gzhug nas mchin pa rul zhing dud khu lta bu lu ba 'byung zhes dang / bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel du/ nad dngos dug nad ma yin yang nad rtags dug nad ltar pho mchin mi bde zhing zas mi 'ju ba dang lus kyi sha skem zhing pags mdog nag por 'gyur ba'i nad cig ces gsungs pa dag las kyang nad 'di'i nad rgyu dug min pa gsal/ thabs ni 'dra ba'i don la'ang 'jug ste/ da~X na

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/bkra shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel du/ glang ltar 'khun pa glang thabs nad ces glang bu'i rwas bsnun pa ltar zug rngu drag po 'phral 'phral du 'byung ba la glang thabs nad zer ba lta bu/ dpe de bzhin dug nad phog pa ltar mchin pa na ba la mchin pa dug thabs zhes brjod/ mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen drang srong zhal lung du/ mchin pa dug thabs ni mchin pa de nyid kha zas bcud can rul skyur dang / chang mang sogs mchin pa phog thug shor bas gnyan kha rgyas te na zug che la thu tshabs che ba'i nad cig yin/ de'i rkyen gyis rang gi me tog gyur pa'i mig sprin gyi mdog dmar ba dang / gdong ba sngo ba/ rtsib steng du gzer zug che ba/ pho mchin gyis khong pa gang ba snyam du sems pa/ zas 'ju dka' ba'i kha zas zos pa'i tshe na na ba/ brun skem por gyur pa/ bol gong g.yo ba ste spangs pa/mur gong dang rkang lag gi mthil bzhi ser por gyur pa/ rnyings nas yun ring song tshe mchin pa gnyan kha rgyas shing smug thig chags nas gzhug tu mchin pa rul nas dud khu lta bur bshal skyugs dang lu ba 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa 'di dang / dbyi kun nad kyi thog ma'i nad rgyu nas mtha' mjug gi nad rtags bar tha dad du snang bas de gnyis la 'brel ba spu tsam yang med la/ nad gzhi 'di gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbyar ba ni don gyi ngo bor phyin ci log tu 'khrul nas byung ba'i log par bshad pa'i lta ba zhig las ci yang med/ yang cig bshad na rgyud du gsungs pa'i dug nad dang nub lugs gso rig gi nad dug gnyis kyang ngo bo gcig ma yin zhing / de gnyis la he bag ha cang che mod/ de'i skor skabs 'di'i brjod gzhi ma yin pas 'dir ma spros so/ /3 dngas ma ma zhu bar ngos 'dzin pa/ches thog mar mkhas pa'i dbang bo mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis nad de gdī/ dus mchin pa'i rtsa la gnas pa'i dwangs ma ma zhu dang / rnyings nas

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/mchin nad la 'gyur 'gro zhes gsungs par brten/ gang mang zhig gis de bzhin brjod/ re gnyis kyis lta ba 'di 'thad ldan du sgrub byed la/ dbyi kun nad 'di 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni zas dang spyod lam mi mthun pa bsten drags pas me drod gsum gyis myag bzhu dwangs snyigs legs par 'byed ma thub par ma zhu ba'i nad du gyur te dwangs snyigs 'dres nas mdangs bsgyur mkhris pas zungs khrag tu ma smin par yun ring bo'i mchin pa'i rtsa la gnas yod pa dang / dwangs ma ma zhu ba dang dbyi kun gnyis nad 'gyur gyi cha nas gcig mthun yin/ de ni rgyud las/ dwangs ma ma zhu rnying ba'i dug tu 'gyur zhes dang / nad rtags kyang sha skem zhing sgreg pa mang ba dang / khong pa sbo ba/yig 'gag pa sogs gcig mtshungs yin zhes smras ba ni sgrub gzhi yang dag cig la gzhi bcol ba'i sgrub byed brtan mo zhig min par bsam/ spyir dwangs ma ma zhu ba zhes pa ni/ rgyud las/ me mnyam rlung gis dngas snyigs ma phyed pa'i/ / snyigs ma dngas ma'i rtsa mig shor ba yis/ / mdangs bsgyur mkhris pas zungs khrag ma smin te/ / yun ring mchin gnas dwangs ma ma zhu yin/ /zhes rlung me mnyam gyi mthu nyams pas dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa'i snyigs ma yang dwangs ma rgyu ba'i rtsa mig tu mnyam por shor bas mdangs bsgyur gyi mkhris pas kyang zungs dang khrag ma smin te yun ring mchin par gnas pa'i dngas ma ma zhu ba zhes par 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gi 'grel chen du/de ltar zhu ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis mthar me mnyam rlung gis dwangs ma dang snyigs ma dbye ba phye ba'i tshe na'ang dngas snyigs legs par ma phyed pa'am phyed ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis/ dper na sman tshags hral por tshags brgyab pa dang 'dra bar snyigs ma yang dwangs ma kho na 'gro ba'i rtsa mig nang dbang med du shor nas 'dres pa yin/ mdangs sgyur mkhris pas dwangs ma kho na'i mdangs sgyur nus pa las snyigs ma'i mdangs bsgyur mi nus pas/ zungs khrag tu 'gyur swā /ba

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/stabs lus zungs su ma smin pa yin te/ de nyid yun ring por mchin pa'i rtsa sbubs su gnas pa ni/ dwangs ma ma zhu zhes pa de yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa dag la gzhigs na dbyi kun nad dwangs ma ma zhu bar ngos bzung pa ni kun gyi blo ngor 'bab pa'i gtam zhig min la de gnyis nad gzhi gcig tu 'jog par ngo 'phrod rgyu yang dka'/ kha cig gis phran la khyod kyis lan rer mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gi lung tshad mar bzung nas rang gi lta ba'i rgyab rten du lung 'dren bzhin pa dang / skabs 'dir khong gi lta bar 'byin sgrub byed bzhin pas mi 'gal lam zhe na/ spyir dbyi kun nad la rgyus mnga' yod par byed na nye sngon bod yig gcig pu'i lam nas de'i rgyu rtags dang gyur tshul sogs la rtogs 'jug bya thabs bral/ de ni nad 'di'i nad 'gyur ngo bo dang thog ma'i rgyu rkyen dag rgya yig dang dbyin yig sogs kyi thog na gsal cha ldan pa re mchis pa las bod yig tu de bzhin dben/ gzhan khong gis de ltar lta ba bton pa'i skabs ni da lta bzhin nub lugs dbyi kun nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul sogs rgyal nang dang 'dzam gling khyon yongs nas gsal rtogs byung med pa'i dus yin/ yang cig bshad na dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i nang skabs de'i bod sman mkhas pa mang che bas nub lugs dbyi kun nad 'di mchin nad ldem bu yin par zhal bzhes bzhin pa dang / mkhas pa'i dbang bo mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis skabs der phal cher de bzhin 'dod yod tshod 'dug rjes sor dam pa khong gis skabs der bton pa'i nub lugs gso rigagi gso byed pa tsho'i dgongs don gzhir bzung nas dwangs ma ma zhu bar ngos bzung bar gzhigs na mkhas dbang khong gis rab dang rim par nad gzhi 'dir rtogs 'jug bgyis mthar snga ma'i lta bar 'gyur ldog byung bar bsam/ yang cig bshad na bdag gis dbyi kun nad dang dwangs ma ma zhu ba ga~X so sor 'dod don yang nad 'di gnyis kyi thog ma'i rgyu rkyen mi mtshungs

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/pa ste/ dbyi kun nad pho ba nas myag bzhu dwangs snyigs 'byed ma thub par snyigs ma dwangs ma'i lam du shor ba zhig min zhing phyi rol gyi gnyan srin gso bya'i rma kha'am sna khung dang ba spu'i bu ga sogs brgyud de lus su zhugs pa'am/yang na nad can khrag nad med la blugs pas 'gos pa sogs gnyan rims spyi'i rgyu rkyen dang gnyis su med/ gzhan dwangs ma ma zhu bar gnyan rims ltar gcig nas gcig tu 'gos pa'i gnas tshul med cing der ma zhu ba'i nad rtags mngon gsal mchis/ dbyi kun nad phog tshad la mngon gsal gyi nad rtags med cing da lta gsal rtogs byung ba zhig ni gnyan srin 'dis mchin gnas kho na ma yin par klad pa dang rgyungs pa/ mkhal ma dang tshigs mtshams bcas su gnas bzung ste rang gi rigs brgyud spel nas gnas de dag tu nad 'gyur byung yang gso bya de rigs kyi mang che ba'i mchin par nad 'gyur ma byung bar rgyun ldan yin/ gnas tshul der ltos na mthamyoganyan srin gyi mtha' mjug gi 'bab gnas sam dpung 'jug byed gnas kyang mchin pa kho na ma yin pa gsal/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na mkhas pa su dang su yin rung kho tshos gnang ba'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi lta ba de dag las rang gi tshe stod kyi lta bar tshe smad du 'gyur ldog byung ba'i rigs kyang mang du mthong / de ni de dag gas dus nam yang mu mthud zhib 'jug gnang bzhin yod pa las/dka' ba'i gnad de lta bur 'gyur med rtag brtan gyi lta ba zhig thog ma nas grub pa zhig yong mi srid pa ni dngos gtso smra ba'i tshan rig pa dang bden don mtha' 'khyongs mdzad mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i dbang po kun gyi rang gshes yin par sems/ dper na/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che yis bee dkar mdzad nas yun tsam song rjes de ru nor 'khrul dang kha ma tshang ba'i cha mchis pas rjes su bee dkar g.ya' sel mdzad/ skye dngos rig pa'i mkhas dbang tar wen gyis mi'i rigs kyi thog ma'i mes po'am 'byung khungs ni spra mi las /snar

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/zhes bshad par/ rjes sor tar wen nyid nas rang nyid kyi thog ma'i lta ba de nor 'dug mi'i mes po ni mi yin zhes bshad/ krung go'i dngos gtso smra ba'i rtsom rig mkhas chen lo'i zhon yang tshe mjug tu nang chos la dad mos byed mkhan zhig tu gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo go 'jo dbang 'dus lags nas mdzad pa'i g.yu thog dgongs rgyan du rgyu grog rtsa mkhal ma nas lhang bar 'brel ba'i gcin 'dren sbu gur ngos bzung yang / da lta khong gis rang gi thog ma'i rgyu grog rtsa'i ngos 'dzin de nor 'dug rgyu grogs rtsa dngos ni de yin zhes pa lta bu dag kyang rang gis sngon bton pa'i lta bar 'gyur ldog byung ba'i dpe mtshon tsam yin/ ji skad du/ bstan bcos phyi ma phyi ma btsan/ /bka' rnams sngon ma sngon ma btsan/ / zhes gsungs don yang rgyal ba'i bka' ma yin pa'i bstan bcos zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang tshe gzhung de ru nor 'khrul lam cha ma tshang ba'i skyon mchis srid cing / snga ma'i skyon phyi ma'i rigs kyis mthong rjes brjod bya der dag bcos sam de las rgyas par bstan bzhin pas yin/ gnas lugs 'di 'dra zhig la gzhi bcol tshe/ mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis dbyi kun nad dwangs ma ma zhu bar ngos 'dzin gnang rung / spyi lo 1997lo'i sngon dbyi kun nad dam g.yamyoganyan srin mchin pa kho nar byung ba'i nad cig tu ngos 'dzin zhing / da lta bzhin de'i rgyu rtags gsal bo rnyed med pa'i dus yin pas de bzhin gyi lta ba zhig bton par bsam/ gal te nub lugs gso byed pa tshos da lta bzhin gnyan srin gyi 'bab gnas mchin pa kho na ma yin zhing nad 'gyur byung gnas kyang de kho na ma yin pa'i gnas lugs shig rtogs 'dug na/ dam pa khong gis kyang nad 'dir bod lugs gso rig gi khrod nas bzhag pa'i sdom tshig gong bzhin gtan nas yin mi srid/de yang mkhan chen bee ro tsa nas kyang / bden zhing 'thad na legs bshad byiX pa'i tshig kyang nyon/ / mi bden don dang 'gal na rgyal ba'i bka' yang

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/snrog ces gsungs 'dug pas phran gyis kyang 'di ltar brjod na 'gal ba 4da sdu shā snadri/ grang ba gnyis ma'i khongs su gtogs par ngos 'dzin pa/ bod sman gyi gzhung nas bshad na rigs brgyud nas byung ba zhig dang yang na spyi tshogs kyi 'brel 'dris thog gcig nas gcig la 'gos mched du 'gro/ nad 'dir tsha ba'i rang bzhin can dang grang ba'i rang bzhin can/myur ba'i rang bzhin can dang dal ba'i rang bzhin can sogs yod/ phan tshun 'gos mched du 'gro bar tsha ba dang grang ba/ myur ba dang dal ba sogs rigs mi 'dra ba bcu drug mchis/ nad 'di mtha' dag gi 'byung rkyen ni pho mtsher gyi nus pa nyams zhan du gyur zhing dngas snyigs 'byed ma thub pas/mchin nus nyams par bzos shing khrag gi dwangs snyigs 'byed ma thub/mkhris nus nyams par bzos shing mkhris khu'i dwangs snyigs 'byed ma thub/gnas tshul der brten nas nad gzhi 'di byung zhes se'u bcu ba'i ngag ltar (se'u bcu ba'i ngag ni bstan dar lha rams pas don gcig la bstun mi rung ba'i tshig ste/ dper na mi ston pas gang byung du lab brdol smra ba lta bu 'brel ba med pa'i tshig go zhes gsungs/)nyog gtam lung ba gang bshad/ spyir log snang der dogs sel byed dgos don med mod/ nar ma son pa'i las dang po ba dang nad 'dis mnar ba'i gso bya gang mang zhig la sus 'ur rgyab pa'i skad mgo mtho na der lta ba bzhin 'di'i phyogs su blo kha 'khor zhing yang dag gi lta ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed bzhin gda'/ de'i rkyen gyis 'dir nor 'khrul gyi lta ba der re re nas 'byin sgrub tsam byas na thog mar ngas nyog gtam mkhan po der khyod kyis gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de rim bzhin 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i nad gzhi 'di bod lugs gso rig gi nad gzhi gang gi khoX su

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/ngos 'dzin rgyu dang / khyod kyis ngos bzung ba'i nad gzhi der rgyu mtshan ci la brten nas rigs bcu drug tu dbye ba yin/ de ltar gzhung gang du gsal/sgrub byed kyi lung gang dag yin zhes dri tshig cig bton par 'dod/lan du deng rabs gso rig gis der rigs bcu drug dbye 'dug pas de bzhin brjod pa yin zer na/ khyod kyis deng rabs gso rig ltar na zhes 'bri rgyu las bod lugs gso rig ltar na zhes 'bri mi rung / lhag par deng rabs gso rig gis nad gzhi 'di gcig nas gcig tu 'gos nas thon pa'i lta ba sogs bton rjes/ khyod kyang gzhan rjes su 'brangs nas nad 'di gcig nas gcig brgyud de yams thabs su 'gos 'gro ba'i lta ba bton/ de na bod sman gzhung du dris phog yams su rim gyis 'gos pa'i nad de gnyan rims kyi sde khungs su 'du'am mi 'du zhes pa'i dri ba zhig kyang bton par 'dod/ de'i lan du gnyan rims shig tu ngos mi 'dzin zhe na/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi las/'jug sgo drug tu rim pas 'jug pa'am/ / dris phog yams su rim gyis 'gos pa'i phyir/ / rims zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ming du btags/ / zhes dang / lhan thabs su/ dris phog yams thabs 'gos nas mched pa sogs/ / zhes gsungs pa'i nad gzhi de'i phog pa'i brgyud rim dang gcig las gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ gal te gnyan rims zhig tu ngos 'dzin rgyu zhe na/ der tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis kyi dbye ba 'byed srol med/ de ni sman bsdus e las/ lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/ / sems can log spyod sna tshogs kyis/ / sde brgyad 'khrugs pa las byung nad/ / ha la cog 'gyel zhes bya ba/ / 'dzum bu ltag dgye so gtsigs nas/ / na long med par 'chi ba 'byung / / gang byung sa der mi thog bcod/ / de rgyu chu ser nag po 'am/ /khrag gnas dug can srin bu bdun/ / ngo bo gnyan zhes bya ba ste/ / sa chu me rluX spyar zhon mod/ / kun kyang tsha ba las ma 'das/ / zhes dang / yang de

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/las/ rims gnyan nad kyi rgyu 'di deng sang shin tu dar zhing de'i bcos tshul yang shes dka' bar snang bas/ 'di'i rnam dbye rgyas par 'chad na spyir nad 'di'i rgyu rtags bcos gsum/ rgyud kyi tsha ba spyi'i le'u las 'byung zhing /de'angand 'di'i ngo bo tsha ba las ma 'das zhes gsungs 'dug pas der tsha grang gnyis su dbye srol ma mchis so/ / gzhan pho mtsher gyi nus pa nyams zhan du gyur zhes pa ni krung lugs gso rig gi brda chad cig las bod lugs gso rig gi brda chad cig gtan nas min/ skabs 'di'i khyod kyi brjod 'dod kyi gtam de bod sman ltar na pho ba'i me drod gsum gyi nus pa nyams par gyur zhes brjod na 'tshams/ rjes phyogs su dang su yin rung 'di lta bu'i stong lab re rgyag par 'dod tshe thog mar bod sman la don ngo mas rgyus mnga' yod pa tshor bka' 'dri re gnang zhir rang nyid kyi spyo gtam de dag la dag bcos re byed du 'jug rgyu gal che/ don dam du skabs 'dir 'ur chen po zhig rgyab pa las mdo don spu rtse tsam yang ma mchis shing bod sman las nad gzhi 'di'i khongs su gtogs zhes pa'i lta ba tsam bton rgyu phar shog tha na tsha grang gnyis kyi gang yin pa'i nges pa tsam yang rnyed med pas/ skabs bab sgrub byed gong tsam gyis chog par bya/ mdor na khyod kyis bsam blo ci yang ma btang ba'am blos ci yang ma dpog par/ bod sman gzhung du zhes brtag dbyad gang yang med par gzhan gyi zer sgros chu babs su bshad pa 'di/ bod mi'i kha dper/dgod pa'i gdong la ltos nas dgod pa dang / ngu ba'i bzhin la ltos nas ngu ba zhes pa'i dpe las gnyis su med/5 gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug la ngos 'dzin pa/yang skye bo 'gas gnyan nad bco brgyad las dbyi kun ( 27)nad rtags dang cha 'grig ma'i le'u zhig mthong ma byung la gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs kyi nad rtags dang rgyu rkyen rnams phyi lugs gso rig gis ngos //na

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/pa'i ca kun (tsho༅kha 7)dang cha mtshungs pa/ dbyi kun nad kyang de'i khongs su e gtogs snyam/ zhes 'khod 'dug par zhib blta zhig byas tshe/ kho bos gong du drangs pa'i tshig rkang gcig po 'di'i mgor nad gzhi 'di (dbyi kun)gnyan nad bco brgyad kyi gang gi khongs su mi gtogs pa'i kha tshod bcad 'dug kyang / tshig rkang de'i mjug tu gnyan nad bco brgyad kyi nang tshan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug gi khongs su e gtogs snyam zhes brjod pa ni/ rang gis rang la 'gram lcag tsha yer ba zhig bzhes pa'i dpe las gnyis su ma mchis shing / bud med 'di bdag gi ma yin zhes dam bca' rjes slar yang de mo gsham mo zhes dam bca' ba rang tshig snga phyi dngos su 'gal ba ltar ro/ /gzhan dbyi kun nad gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug tu ngos bzung tshe/ gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug nad ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi las/ smin pa'i long med bdun dgu'i dus na 'chi/ / blun po 'ga' zhig smin byed dus la sdod/ / ces gsungs pas/ ca kun dang dbyi kun phog pa'i nad pa rnams nyin bdun nam dgu tsam gyi yun nas 'chi bar 'gyur zhes brjod tshe gso ba bo sman pa ma zad gso bya'i nad pa rnams la'ang dgod spro ba sha stag yin/ yang dpal ldan rgyud bzhir/mjug tu mkhris gnas rlung gis spyad byas nas/ / rang gnas srog rtsar 'chor bas 'tsho ba nyung / / zhes gsungs pas/ ca kun dang dbyi gan gnyis mjug tu srog rtsar yang mi 'bab pas a pha'i zhwa shul du a ma'i lham bzhag pa lta bu'i 'chal gtam 'dir bdag mi 'thad do/ /6 de sngon rang gis brtan pa'i lta ba'i 'khrul sel/nga ni rang gi thog ma'i lta bar mkhregs zlodzin byas nas bden don gyi gnas lugs la mig zhag mi 'phen mkhan zhig min la/ ri bong cal 'drog ltar mig mdun gyi gnas lugs la rgyus lon mi byed par gzhan rjes su hol rgyuX spyad mkhan zhig kyang min/ de'i rkyen gyis rang nyid nas nye sngon dbyi kun

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/nad bod lugs gso rig las mchin nad ldem bur gnyan nad kyi bsdongs zla yod par ngos bzung mod/ spyir gnyan nad kyi khongs su bgrang ba ni ches 'os 'tsham gyi lta ba zhig tu 'khum yang / mchin nad ldem bur gnyan nad kyi bsdongs zla yod ces brjod na mchin nad ldem bu'i nad phog 'dug pa gzhir bzhag byas 'dug pas/ mchin nad ldem bu'i nad phog 'dug na mchin par nad 'gyur byung 'dug pa smras med yin/ 'on kyang dbyi kun nad phog pa'i mi tshang ma'i mchin pa na bzhin med par ma zad/ gnyan srin 'di'i 'bab gnas mchin pa kho na ma yin zhing mtha' mjug gi nad 'gyur byung gnas kyang mchin pa kho na min pas de ni nor 'khrul gyi lta ba zhig tu rtsis na legs/ 'di ltar bshad don yang de sngon gong gi lta ba 'di gzhir bzung nas dpyad rtsom gnyis dus deb steng bton zin pas yin/gnyis pa/ rang lugs 'bad ldan du 'jog pa/1 gnyan nad dang dbyi gan nad gnyis kyi rgyu 'dra ba'i skor la dpyadapa/(1)gnyan rgyu dang dbyi gan nad rgyu gnyis kyi bsdur gshib/ de yang man ngag lhan thabs su/ dris phog yams thabs 'gos nas mched pa sogs/ / ltar snang rims nad spyi dang mthun na yang / / zhes gnyan nad rigs yams thabs su 'gos 'gro ba'i rnam pa yang rims nad dang 'dra yang /deganyis kyi nad rgyu srin bu'i ngo bo tha dad yin pa ma zad/ gso bya'i lus su zhugs nas rang gi rdzas rgyun spel skabs rims srin rigs lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs dang bsdongs mi dgos par gson lus der brten naX /nga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gi rdzas rgyun spel te 'phel bzhin pas/ nad gzhi de rigs la phyi rol nas thon pa'i rgyu las med/ gnyan nad rigs de ltar ma yin par phyi rol du gnas pa'i par pa ta zhes gcig nas gcig la yams thabs su 'gos 'gro ba'i srin bu phra mo de tha mal mi'i lus su zhugs pa ni phyi'i rgyu dang / srin bu de mi'i lus su zhugs rjes lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs dang bsdongs shing bsdongs grogs de nang gi rgyur nges pas der phyi nang gi rgyu gnyis su mchis/nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i 'gos nad rig pa ni phyi rol gyi 'bu phra rab bam skye dngos phra rab ( 747)mi'i lus su zhugs rjes srin bu de dag mi'i lus nas 'phel zhing lhan skyes su 'dug pa'i srin bu'i rigs 'gar 'khrugs rtsod byung nas 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad cig yin zhing / mi dang dud 'gro'i lus nas nad rgyu srin bu 'phel zhing rim bzhin phyi rol du dor ba de 'gos nad skyed byed kyi rgyu yin pa dang / 'gos nad tshang mar 'go ba'i rang bzhin mchis pa'i dgongs don 'di rnams gnyan rims gnyis kyi spyi rgyur gsungs pa'i gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos 'gro ba'i rnam pa der yongs su mthun/ nub lugs 'gos nad rig pa'i nang gses dbyi kun nad kyi rgyu ni g.yamyoganyanasrin tha mal mi'i lus su zhugs rjes gnyan srin mang che ba mchin pa'i srin phol du 'dzul zhing de gnyis gzhi gcig tu grub pa dang / grub gnas de ru rang gi rigs brgyud 'phel bar byed pa sogs gnyan rgyu par pa ta lus su zhugs rjes lhan skyes su grub pa'i khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de dang lhan cig bsdongs nas zhugs gnas de'i lus nas gnyan srin de rigs 'phel bar byed bzhin pa'i gnas lugs dang mthun rkyen/ dbyi kun /tā spra/nā /sdos gnyis las kyang gnyan nad kyi khongs su gtogs 'dug 60(2) gnyan srin par pa ta'i ngo bor gzhi bcol nas dbye zhib bgyis

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/pa/ man ngag lhan thabs su/ par pa ta de srin gyi gzugs sprul nas/ /rtsangs pa'i mgo dbyibs kha che sbrul lta bu'i/ / mjug ring rta bla ltar du yan lag mang / / rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba de/ / bar snang khams nas ba spu sna sgor 'jug/ ces gsungs par gzhigs na par pa ta ni gso bya gcig nas gcig tu 'go zhing mi'i lus su zhugs rjes lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs dang bsdongs mkhan gyi phyi rol du gnas pa'i srin bu sna gcig yin pa'i tshor snang tsam ster yang / de ltar ma yin par gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin tshul sogs gsham gyi tshan pa zhig tu cung rgyas pa'i tshul gyis 'god rgyu yin pas skabs bab 'di tsam gyis chog par bya/ par pa ta srin bu gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin tshe srin bu de rigs kyi gzugs shin tu chung zhing yang ba sogs kyi rnam pas ches phra ba'i nyi rdul dang chu rdul ltar bar snang khams su rlung gi gshog pa ldan pa bzhin rgyu thub pa zhig yin phyir gong bzhin brjod/ nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i 'gos nad rgyur gyur ba'i srin bu de dag rang gi skye 'phel byung sa'i lus dang bral rjes mkha' dbugs dang mchil zegs/ sa rdul sogs dang 'grogs nas gang sar rgyu thub cing gang sar rgyu ba'i srin bu de nad med mi'i sna khungs dang ba spu'i bu ga'am lus kyi rma kha sogs brgyud nas lus su zhugs par byed/ 'gos nad rigs tshang mar nad gzhi rang rang skyed byed kyi 'gos srin re mchis shing 'gos srin de yis nad de kho na skyed par byed/ der skye dngos phra rab dang srin bu bcas rigs che ba gnyis yod/nad rgyu'i srin bu'i dbye ba las thog mar lus su zhugs pa'i rnam pa'ang mi 'dra ba sogs tha dad gzhung gnyis kyi tshig gi brjod stangs tsam las gong 'og gi lta ba gnyis gzhi gcig tu grub/ de ni gong 'og gi lta ba gang yin yang nad rgyu'i srin bu de ha cang chung zhing yang bas gang sar rgyu thub pa dang / de nas mi'i lus su thog mar zhugs pa'i rnam pa'ang gcig mtshungs su mchis/ sdusan

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'gos nad so sor 'gos rgyu'i srin bu re mchis pa'i dgongs don yang gcig tu 'dug pas so/ /2 gnyan nad dang dbyi gan nad gnyis kyi rkyen 'dra ba'i skor la dpyadage~X /nga rgyud dang sngar gyi nyams yig rnams su gnyan nad kyi rkyen ni mdor bsdus na/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid de nam zla dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman lhag log pa'am spyod lam drag shul rigs byas drag pa/ zhe snang drag po skyes te khro ba'am sems zhum pa'i dbang gis 'jigs skrag thon pa/ yang na mya ngan dang sems las kyi gdung bas mnar ba/ kha zas bsil drod mi snyoms pa'am bcud med rigs bsten drag pa sogs lus khams dang mi mthun pa'i zas spyod rnams bston pa'i rkyen gyis nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs te gnyan nad rnams slong bar gsungs/ de ni rgyud las/ de la rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus/ / skyed byed yul dus zas spyod gdon rkyen gyis/ / srin 'khrugs lus zungs zas pas gnyan nad 'byung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / nub lugs gso rig tu skabs 'dir rkyen zhes dmigs su bkar nas 'chad pa'i skabs med kyang / 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim du de'i skor cung mchis pas de rnams zur du byung nas 'dir cung 'khod na 'di lta ste/ 'gos mched du 'gro ba der yang phyi'i khor yug gi rkyen dang spyi tshogs kyi rkyen bcas gnyis mchis/ snga ma ni gnam gshes kyi dro grang dang khor yug gi skye dngos bcas la 'brel ba yod/ dper na dbyar gzhung gnam gshes tsha ba'i dus 'gos nad gang dag 'byung sla zhing / dgun dus gnam gshis grang ba'i skabs 'gos nad gang dag 'byung sla/ rong ba dang 'brog pa grong khyer dang groX spraseb so so'i khul nas 'gos nad gang rigs 'byung mang ba lta bu/ phyi

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ma ni spyi tshogs lam lugs dang dpal 'byor lam lugs/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen/bsam blo'i go rtogs bcas la 'brel ba yod pas/ sde tshan 'di ru gso bya'i sems khams dang bsam blo'i go rtogs/ kha zas dang spyod lam bcas shin tu mang po zhig 'dus/ yang cig bshad na nad skyed byed kyi skye dngos phra rab de mi'i lus khams su zhugs shing skye 'phel byung ba'i brgyud rim nang / zhugs gnas mi'i zungs stobs kyi che chung dbang gis nad rgyu gcig tu mchis kyang 'bras bu'i nad kyi rnam 'gyur mi 'dra bar thon pa ste/ gso bya'i zungs stobs bzang tshe gnyan srin gang mang zhig thog mar lus su 'jug mi thub pa'am zhugs kyang lus nas 'phel zhing 'khrugs pa'i go skabs rnyed dka'/ dper na/ gso bya de'i lus nas nad rgyu'i srin bu shi 'gro ba'am dri ma rnams dang lhan lus kyi phyi rol du dor bar byed pa/ yang na lus khams su ma 'khrugs par bag la nyal 'dug pa lta bu/ de las ldog ste zungs stobs zhan skabs thog mar lus su zhugs sla zhing / de nas 'phel ba dang 'khrugs kyang sla ba lta bu/ 'di rnams 'gos nad rigs thog mar lus su zhugs shing de nas 'phel ba dang mthar 'khrugs par byed pa la grogs byed pa'i rkyen yin/ 'gos nad slong bar byed pa'i rkyen 'di rnams gong gi gnyan nad kyi rkyen las gnyis su med/ de ni bod lugs gso rig dang nub lugs gso rig gang yin yang gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos 'gro ba'i nad rigs 'di slong bar byed par dus dang spyod lam/ sems khams dang kha zas/ yul dang zungs stobs bcas la 'brel ba yod pa'i dgongs don zhig bstan 'dug pa de yin/3 gnyan srin par pa ta ni rigs mi 'dra ba'i gnyan srin yongs kyi sbyi ming yin tshul bshadapa/de yang man ngag lhan thabs su/ par pa ta de srin gyi gzugadī /la

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/nas/ / tsangs pa'i mgo dbyibs kha che sbrul lta bu'i/ / mjug ring rta bla ltar du yan lag mang / / rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba ste/ / zhes dang /rgyud du/ dbye ba babs sa ming gis tha dad de/ / mgo la babs na klad gzer zhes bya zhing / / gre bar gag pa zhes gsungs pa dag la gzhigs na par pa ta zhes pa ni 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i srin bu'i rigs gcig tu nges zhing de lus kyi phyi nang bar dang stod smad sogs 'bab yul gyi dbang gis nad bye brag pa re byung zhing / der ming yang bye brag pa re btags pa 'dra ba'i snang ba zhig ster rkyen/ sman pa gang mang zhig gis de bzhin ngos 'dzin gnang /don dam du nga tshos tshig la mi rton don la rton zhes pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung nas der rang blos lcogs tshod kyis dpyad tshe/ de yang dpe skas kyi them pa bar ma de 'og ma nas yar 'gro sa'i them pa gong ma dang / de'i stong mar bgrod pa'i tshe them pa 'og mar 'jog pa bzhin brjod bya'i tshig de yis skabs don gyi ston bya de kho na mtshon pa'i skabs kyang mang / der brten gzhung gi tshig 'bru gnyer ba tsam gtso bor byas te don gyi ngo bor dpyis phyin par thon mi nus pa ni ma rtogs pa'i dri mar 'khums/ de na rtog dpyod med par tshig tsam gyi rjes su rgyug pa min par don gyi char blang dor 'jug ldog gi gnad rnams gtso bor bzung ste skabs 'di'i brjod bya dngos kyis sne khrid nas/mthar nges don dang sbyar bar gzhol na 'di lta ste/ rgyu mi gcig par brten nas byung ba'i 'bras bu yang tha dad yin zhing rgyu gang yin pa'i 'bras bu yang de bzhin thon pa ni 'jig rten 'di'i chos nyid yin phyir/ nad bdag rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs kyis btab pa'i nad kyang gcig kho na yin mi srid/ de ni skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i rims dang gnyan gnyis la mtshon na/dang po rims las bal nad ni nad bdag bal mo he le 'bar ma zhes pa gdīkā dpal ldan lha mo'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas des btang bar

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/grags pa'i 'go ba'i rims nad cig yin phyir nad bdag gi ming nad la btags pa zhig yin/ gnyan mkhris rtsa rgyug la mtshon na/ skyem 'grel du/nad 'di 'byung ba'i rkyen ni sngon dbang phyug gis sbyin sreg byas pa'i rngul gyi thigs pa me nang du song ba las skyes pa srid pa'i ma mo bdun du grags pa de gtso cher ri rab dang nye ba ke la sha'i gling du gnas pa'am yang na dpal ldan lha mo ste sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su 'di byang shar phyogs su yongs 'du'i shing la brten nas sman mo'i gzugs su gnas pa la byang sman zhes bya/ dmu bdud ni sde brgyad kyi dmu dang bdud gnyis bsdongs pa'i sras te de rnams kyis rkyen byas nas zhes thog ma'i nad rgyu gtor ba bo'i gdon bye brag tu ngos bzung / gnyan lhog par mtshon na/ skyem 'grel du/ sde brgyad dang gnyan nad sogs gdon gyi rkyen gyis zhes thog ma'i nad rgyu gtor ba bo sde brgyad sogs yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang / gong gi snang tshul 'di las nga tshos thad kur rtogs thub pa zhig ni dang po bal nad la mtshon na nad gzhi 'di rims kyi nang gses sam bye brag pa zhig yin zhing de skyed byed kyi rgyu yang rims rigs gzhan dang ma 'dra bar bal mo he le 'bar mas btang ba yin/ gal te rims nad yongs kyi thog ma'i skyed byed rgyu bal mo he le 'bar mas btang tshe/ rims nad spyi'i ming la rims nad dam bal nad ces brjod chog la/bal mo he le 'bar ma rims kyi spyi rgyur bzhag na'ang chog mod/ de bzhin bgyis med pa rgyud du gsal/ der ltos na rims bye brag pa re la nad bdag bye brag pa re mchis rkyen rgyu yang bye brag pa re mchis pa gsal/ gnyis pa gnyan nad la mtshon na/ gnyan mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad dmu bdud dang byang sman khros pas thog ma'i nad rgyu gtor ba zhig dang / gnyan lhog pa'i nad sde brgyad dang gdon sogs kyis btang ba zhig tu 'dug pas/ gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug dang gnyan lhog pa gnyis kyi thog ma'i rgyu gtong ba bo tha dad sditā lta

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gsal/ rgyu der brten nas byung ba'i gnyan nad kyi ngo bo dang lci yang / nad rtags sogs kyang tha dad du mchis/gzhan yang slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i gnyan gag lhog gzer gsum gyi gcun 'khor nag po zhes pa ru/ gnyis pa ngo bo la dgu ste:dang po gang nas byung:gnyan yul pho ma g.yag lding nas byung:pha gnyan po thod de rgyal ba dang:ma bram ze nag mo gnyis 'tshogs pa las:bu gnyan po lhog pa spun dgu byung ste:gnyan chen 'gying ba dang gcig:gnyan chen ldem bu dang gnyis:skug pa 'dzum dmul dang gsum:rakṣa thum po dang bzhi:nag po chig chod dang lnga:gnyan rdol skyes gcig pu dang drug:gnyan chung dkar po dang bdun:chu byin sngon po dang brgyad:spar mgo mang dang dgu'o:de las gyes pas gnyan rigs brgya rtsa brgyad:de las gyes pa'i gnyan rigs sa ya 'bum sde yod do:zhes gsungs par gzhigs na gnyan nad ces pa'i nad rgyu gtong ba bo'i nad bdag sna gcig ma yin zhing rigs mi gcig pa'i nad bdag de dag gis btab pa'i nad kyang 'bab gnas tsam ma yin par tha dad du 'dug pa'i sdom tshig gsal bo zhig bzhag 'dug pa de yin/ yang slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i rims srung gi zab dgu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa las/ glo la phog na gas:de la rigs bzhi 'byung:glo gzer:gzer thung:glo cham stod gzer nad stobs che:zhes gsungs par gzhigs na gnyan nad kyi 'bab gnas glo bgacig pu yin yang der rigs mi 'dra ba re 'byung bzhin pas kyang gnyan nad ni nad rgyu gcig yin pa la 'bab gnas kho nar dmigs nas dbye ba mdzad pa zhig min pa'i bden dpang zhig yang bskyar rnyed/ da dung zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag bye ba ring bsrel gyi khong lhog nag po gnyan srin gyi sgos bcos pa mi bslu bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng du/ rgyu la rkyenā spyas srin gyi gzugs sprul pa(kha che mjug ring rkang lag mang ba'i ming ni

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/tro tre ho'am par pa ta zhes pa'o/ / kha cig ni 'ja' tshon 'dra ba'ang yod/)/ / ces mchan bkod pa du'ang phyi rol tu gnas pa'i par pa ta'i dbyibs kyang so sor 'dug pa mtshon/ yang cig bshad na gnyan glo tshad gzer thung dang gnyan glo rims khrag 'byams gnyis kyi gang yin rung gtso bo'i 'bab gnas glo ba nyid yin mod/ gal te par pa ta zhes pa srin bu rigs gcig gi ming yin tshe/ phyi rol tu gnas pa'i nad rgyu'i 'gos srin rigs gcig 'bab gnas glo ba nyid du babs na der tha dad kyi nad ming dang tha dad kyi nad rtags mngon pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de ltar mchis pa ni khams gtsang 'brug rgyal gyi phan bde'i snye ma las/ ro stod gnyan babs glo tshad gzer thung la/ / rtags bcos gnyis las rtags ni dbugs thung rgod/ /gzer 'pho lce mchu skya ser lud pa dmar/ / sna khrag 'dzag cing dpung sgrog brang mdo na/ / rtsa ni grims spun chu mdog dmar la dugs/ / de yang rlung gnyan khrag gsum bsdongs pa la/ / gang shas che ba'i rang rang nad rtags ldan/ / bye brag khrag shas che na g.yas phyogs gzer/ / gnyan gzer g.yon dang rlung gzer nges med 'pho/ / khyad par tshig pa za ba gnyan gyi rtags/ /nad 'di gtso cher glo ba la babs kyang / / zhes gsungs pa'i skabs 'di'i gnyan nad kyi 'bab gnas gtso bo glo ba nyid yin zhing de'i nad rtags dang /der bla gnyan gyi nad 'di dang 'di 'byung srid ces gsal por gsungs/yang de las/ rims nad glor babs glo rims khrag 'byams zhes/ / ro stod rtsib logs gzer che lus kun tsha/ / dbugs 'degs gre ba ngar la mig rtsa dmar/ / lud pa khrag can lus rngul skom dad che/ / mtshan mo gnyid med zug che kha sna skam/ / tshabs che glo khrag mang brdol lus stobs 'chor/ / dus 'gyangs glo ba nad zin rnag tu smin/ / mi 'tsho gshin rje yul du 'gro dus babs/ / zhes gsungs pa yang gnyan nad glo bar babs pa yin mod/ 6/ga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/ris tsam la ltos tshe rims nad kho na nyid glo bar babs pa'i tshor snang zhig ster mod/ nad gzhi 'di'i ming du gnyan glo rims khrag 'byams zhes rims kho na ma yin par gnyan gyi bsdongs zla yod pa'i gnyan rims nad cig yin pa'ang nad 'di'i nad ming gi steng nas rtogs thub/ yang de las de'i bcos thabs skabs/ gnyan gsod tsha ba don babs 'joms byed pa'i/ / gnyen po gang 'phrod rig mdas bsnun la gtong / / zas spyod gnyan tshad spyi dang mthun par shis/ / zhes gnyan 'joms kyi zas sman rigs gsungs yod pa las rims nad gzhom byed kyi zas sman kho na gsungs med/ de na gnyan glo tshad gzer thung dang gnyan glo rims khrag 'byams gnyis kyi gang yin yang gnyan nad glo bar babs pa zhig tu 'dug kyang / de gnyis la tha dad kyi nad rtags re mchis pa gong las gsal/ gal te gong nad gnyis las gong ma gnyan nad kho nar gtogs shing phyi mar gnyan nad la rims kyi bsdongs zla mchis rkyen de'i nad ming du'ang gnyan glo rims khrag 'byams zhes btags shing rims nad glor babs zhes dmigs su bstan pa de gnyis kyi nad rgyu tha dad du 'dug pas so sor tha dad kyi nad rtags re mngon zer na/ yang de las gnyan rgyu gzer mkhal lhang du babs par/ mkhal lhang she rul be snabs 'dra ba 'ongs/ / zhes dang / gnyan khong lhog nag po mkhal lhang du babs tshe/'di ni mkhal lgang nyid la babs pa yis/ / mkhal lhang gzer drag lus la thor phran 'byung / / grang shum byed cing rkang ba brkyang bskum dka'/ / chu sri skyigs bu mang zhing khrag 'dzag nas/ / mig zlog gzer mi 'pho na gsum la 'chi/ / zhes gsungs pa yang skabs 'di'i gong 'og gnyi ga'i gnyan nad kyi 'bab gnas mkhal lhang yin yang / de gnyis la tha dad kyi nad rtags re mchis/ gzhan yang gnyan mtsher babs gzer thung dang gnyan rgyu gzer pho mardokā du babs pa gnyis la dper na/ de las/ mtsher babs gzer thung

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gnyan rgod srog 'joms ni/ / rtags dang bcos thabs gnyis las dang po la/ / 'di ni bcos pa'i long cher med pa yin/ / zhag gsum lnga bdun dgu na 'chi ba mang / / nad 'di phog ma thag nas sems mi bde/ / dbugs rgod rngam pa 'degs shing rtsib g.yon gzer/ / shes pa 'thib cing mgo na rus tshigs khol/ /mig ni 'bur tshugs blta zhing sbrid pa mang / / ba spu brtse zhing lus la 'brum chung 'ong / / dros tshe sbo zhing lud pa smug kham 'byung / / rtsa ni thung la bud rbud lan mang 'phar/ / chu mdog ljang dmar nag la lbu ba rgod/ / ces dang / gnyan rgyu gzer pho mtsher du babs pa'i rtags ni de las/pho mtsher rtsam pa be snabs dud pa 'dra/ / zhes tha dad kyi nad rtags re mchis/snang tshul 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og nas nga tshos blo rnal mas bsam gzhigs re btang tshe/ gnyan rgyu par pa ta zhes pa ni 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i gnyan srin yongs kyi spyi ming yin zhing tha dad kyi srin bu rer tha dad kyi nad rtags re mchis zhes sdom tshig rgyab na 'os 'tsham gyi gtam zhig tu 'khums so/ /lhag par nad gzhi gang dang gang yin rung der gso bcos bya skabs nad de'i thog ma'i nad rgyu gang yin rtsad gcod byas rjes nad rgyu de gzhom byed kyi gnyen po'i sman sprod rgyu ni spyi 'gros kyi lugs shig yin/ de yang / rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa/ / dug rtsa ma byung lo ma bcad skyur 'dra/ / zhes gsungs pa'ang rgyud rang gi rtsa ba'i dgongs don yin/ de bzhin man ngag lhan thabs kyi gnyan nad mgor babs klad gzer bcos pa ru/ nad gzhan gso ba'i thabs tshul du shes kyang / / 'di la sgos kyi gnyen pos ma slobs na/ / sman dpyad gang yang nad kyi grogs yin te/ / 'chi bdag kha ru de srog myur du 'gro/ / zhes pa yang gnyan nad so so'i rgyu mi gcig pa las byung ba'i nad kyang mi gcig pas der gnyen po'i sman yang rigs gcig ma yin par gnyan nad bye brag pa de'i nad rgyu gzhom dīkā kyi

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gnyen po'i sman yang bye brag tu gsungs/ de na lung gang gi brjod bya la cung zad lkog gyur gzhal ba'i dngos stobs tshad mas dpyad na gnod pa med pa dang / gser gyi skyon yon shin tu rtogs dka' ba rdo nag po'i steng du brdar nas bzang ngan brtag pa ltar gong gi lung tshig snga phyi rnams phan tshun bsdur tshe gnyanasrin par pa ta ni rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'gos srin gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin pa dngos shugs gang du'ang 'gal ba med pas/ lung don la 'thad sgrub kyi rigs pas dpyad pa gtso bor byas te 'di ltar gtan du dbab pa yin/4 khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin par 'dod pa/de yang rgyud las/ srin bu'i rigs ni brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ / zhes dang / gdugs dkar las/ zas su mdangs za ba dang / zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba dang / zas su zhag za ba dang / zas su sha za ba dang / zas su tshil za ba dang / zas su rkang za ba dang / zas su btsas pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog pa dang / zas su skyug pa za ba dang / zas su phyi sa za ba dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba dang / zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang / zas su snabs za ba dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba dang /zhes gsungs par gzhigs na mi lus 'dom gang gru bzhi 'di'i cha shas kun na de za bar byed pa'i srin rigs mang du mchis shing de dag gis lus 'di nyid bde mi bde'i las mtha' dag byed bzhin par mtshon/ gzhan yang kurma 'phrin las kyis rgyal ba'i bka' rin po che las phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i lus khams nyi ma'i gnyen po ru/ mi rnams dang po mngal nas byung nas zhag bdun lon pa dang srog chags srin bu'i rigs stong phrag brgyad cu lus las skyelha /sa de las za bar byed pa dang / lus 'tsho bar byed pa dang / nad

bar dudagebagazhung gi don /bskyed pa sogs lus kyi bde mi bde'i bya ba mtha' dag srin rigs brgyad cu'i skor mtsho shin tu che ba yod ces dang / skabs 'dir mdor bsdus pa'i srin rigs brgyad cu po rim par phye na/(1)mgo bor thod pa'i srub bzhir kun tu rgyu ba'i srin bu dang klad phor la rgyu ba'i srin bu/ klad phor gyi rus gseb tu 'gro ba'i srin bu/ skra za ba'i srin bu/ rna ba la spyod pa'i srin bu/ snabs la 'jug pa'i srin bu/ tshil gyi nang na spyod pa'i srin bu/ tshigs kyi gseb na rgyu ba'i srin bu/ lud pa za ba'i srin bu/ so rnams kyi rtsa bar gnas pa'i srin bu bcas bcu/(2)mgrin par kha chu za ba'i srin dang mchil ma 'byung bar byed pa'i srin/ skyug par byed pa'i srin/ srin mngar myos/ srin rab myos/ ro drug la zhen pa'i srin/ ghu ra ghu ra ka zhes pa'i srin/ ro la rab tu sdang ba'i srin/nyal ba la dga' ba'i srin/ srin sbom po bcas bcu/(3)mngal du srin spu za ba dang srin 'bigs byed dang / srin dzachu māndar/ srin u dum wa ra:srin kun tu 'dzim pa/ srin spu'i gling / srin khrag la rab tu khro ba/ srin khrag za ba/ srin rab rib byed pa/ srin i bya ka bcas rsharta/sha la srin rmas kun nas slong ba dang srin tsun tsu ra ga:srin rgyus pa sgul ba/ srin pags pa za ba/ srin drod sgul ba/ srin 'phel byed/ srin dri ngan pa/ srin rngul la rgyu ba bcas bcu/(5)mkhris par srin tsu ru ba:dang srin sgul byed/ srin rdzas kyis rgyas pa/ srin chen po'i rigs/ srin nags pa/ srin zas chen po/ srin dro ba la rgyu ba/ srin rnam par sreg byed/ srin me drod nyams byed/ srin me chen po bcas stusta/rus par srin dus pa ldag pa dang srin shin tu 'brud byed/ )spyan

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/tshigs pa gcod cing rgyu ba/ srin dri mi zhim pa/ srin rus pa'i rnag gi rigs/srin kha dmar ba/ srin myang bar byed pa/ srin pags pa za ba/ srin grog ma/srin spu gri'i kha bcas bcu/(7)rtug par rgyu ba ru srin be'u snabs dang srin khab kyi kha/ srin phi spi skye ba/ srin rkang ba med pa/ srin bshang ba rnam par 'thor byed/ srin skom pas gdung ba/ srin rgyu ma 'byed byed/ srin rnam par rings byed/ srin mdog bzang / srin gzhang smin byed bcas bcu/(8)lha bar rgyu ba'i srin ni srin spu la yod pa dang srin kha nag pa/ srin spro ba med pa/ srin lu ba'i gzer zug chen po/ srin rmongs bar byed pa/srin me mdog can/ srin 'on du 'gro ba/ srin charnyisgyu:srin kun tu rtog pa/srin dga' ba pa bcas bcu bsdom pas brgyad cu'o zhes dang / de'u dmar ba'i lag len gces btus las srin nad ya ma'i bcos bsdus don gsum pa ru/ rgyu ni gnyan yin mtshan nyid phyi nang bar/ / gsum las gzugs can gzugs med gnyis su yod/ / gzugs med nad yin gzugs can srin bu ste/ / gnyis ku'i sna 'dren gdon yin bsdongs zla'i grogs/ / yang na tsha ba yang na grang ba'i nad/ / phyi gnas lhog pa spun dgu dring mo gnyis/ /gzugs can yin la nang gnas klad gzer sogs/ / khong lhog spun dgu gzugs med yin par bshad/ / bar gnas gag pa spun dgu gzugs med de/ / ya ma dkar nag khra gsum gzugs can yin/ / de ltar phyi nang lhog rigs bco brgyad dang / / gag drug ya gsum bsdoms pas nyi shu bdun/ /snga ma nyer bzhi 'dir man logs su gsal/ / zhes dang / yang de las/spyir ni mi lus 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ / srin bu'i grong khyer nyi shu chig stong dang / / brgyad cu la sogs yod par bshad na'ang / / rnam par ma gyur tshe na lupa dritsho byed/ / gyur tshe 'jig byed de yang gdug pa'i rigs/ / gsod

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/par byed pa'i srin bu dkar nag khra/ / sngo ser lnga las nang rigs so sor ni/ /dkar po dung 'dra rlung srin der rigs bzhi/ / nye rgyu ser po mkhris srin la rigs drug / sngon po sbrul 'dra bad srin la rigs bdun/ / nag po rkang gcig khrag srin la rigs lnga/ / khra po sdom 'dra 'dus pa'i rtsa srin gsum/ / skya bo chu ser srin la rigs bzhi dang / /ya ma dkar nag khra gsum bcas pa la/ / gsod byed sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes su 'bod/ / de las bsdus pa gnod pa skyel byed bcu/ / kha leb gru gu long gi srin dang gcig/ smug po sbrul 'dra pho ba'i srin dang gnyis/ / skya spun so dang yan lag srin dang gsum/ / ser po nye rgyu mkhris pa'i srin dang bzhi/ / keng rus mjing bsnol rus pa'i srin dang lnga/ / ya ma 'khor ba mig gi srin dang brgyad/ / ma ru tse zhes mngal gyi srin dang dgu/ gcig rgyug mda' 'phen lus kun khyab ste bcu'o/ / de las bsdus pa srin bu bdun yod pa/ / 'gu ya nag po so la gnas pa dang / / btsan bya ser po mig la gnas pa dang / / rkang gcig pa ni so la gnas pa dang / / rkang gnyis pa ni kun tu rgyug pa dang / / rkang gsum pa yis glo snying 'jigs pa dang / /dmar po sbrul 'dra mchin par rgyu ba dang / / slar yang bsdu bas srin bzhi zhes bya ba/ /kun rgyug rtsa la gnas pa'i srin dang gcig/ grol ma khong du gnas shing khro dang gnyis/ / stod srin yan lag la gnas srin dang gsum/ / ya ma mgo la gnas dang bzhi yin no/ /shin tu bsdus pa srog gcod byed po gsum/ /long srin kha leb gru gu khong ba'i bdud/ /klad srin dkar po mchu non mgo yi gshed/ / gcig rgyug mda' 'phen lus kun khyab pa'i bdud/ / de sogs dbye ba rnam grangs bshad mang yang / /rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa khrag dang lngar/ / ma gyur med cing tsha grang gnyis su 'dus/ / zhes dang / rgyud kyi srin nad gso ba'i le'u ru/dbye ba phyir gnas shig dang sro ma ste/ / nang gnas bad kun rlung mkhripa sdug

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/dang bzhi/ / bad kun pho ba rlung srin long na gnas/ / mkhris srin so mig lpags gzhang mtshan mar gnas/ / khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba ste/ / khrag la gnas shing rtsa nang kun tu rgyug/ gnyan nad kun gyi rgyu dang mdze nad byed/ / klad srin ya ma dkar nag de las byed/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin tha mal mi'i lus la lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong mchis shing / de dag gi ngo bo ma 'khrugs pa'i skabs lus 'di nyid 'tsho bar byed pa'i grogs byed cing / 'khrugs tshe nad skyed pa'am tha na srog kyang 'dor bar byed/ srin bu de rnams kyi gzigs shin tu phra zhing chung bas tha mal mi'i mig gi spyod yul ma yin/ de ni lus khams nyi ma'i gnyen po las/ de la dge slong dag nga'i srin bu dag gis lus 'di'i yul phyogs gang dag tu nad du gyur pa'am nad med par gyur pa yang las ci dag byed pa yin na/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab dag gis sam/ lha'i mig gis mthong bar gyur pa zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs rnams tha mal mi'i mig gi spyod yul ma yin phyir lus khams nyi ma'i gnyen po las kyang lus 'di nyid kyi bde mi bde'i las gtso bo byed mkhan gyi srin rigs brgyad cu zur du byung nas de rnams kyi dbyibs dang byed las sogs gsungs/ de bzhin de'u dmar lag len gces btus su'ang rim bzhin mdor bsdus nas gsod byed srin rigs so gnyis dang de nas gnod pa skyed byed bcu/ 'gu ya nag po sogs bdun/ kun rgyugs rtsa la gnas pa sogs bzhi/ srog gcod byed po gsum bcas phyi ma phyi ma nyung bar bsdus/ rgyud du'ang phyir gnas shig dang sro ma gnyis/ nang gnas rlung srin mkhris srin bad srin khrag srin bzhir gsungs shing de dag gi byed las tsam las srin rigs gzhan gyi dbyibs dang byed las sogs ma gsungs phyir/ thad kur ltos na skabs 'dir gsungs pa/byin rigs bzhi bos lus yongs kyi bde mi bde'i bya ba mtha' dag byed

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/bzhin pa'i tshor snang zhig ster zhing / gnyan nad kun gyi bsdongs grogs byed mkhan yang khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de gcig pu yin par 'dod mod/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don dngos dang gzhung gzhan rnams su mig zhag re 'phang tshe gong gi 'di tha mal mi'i blo dang bstun phyir ches mdor bsdus sgos sa bcad ma stong tsam du nyes gsum dang khrag tu gtso bo'i las byed mkhan gyi srin bu rer de dag gi ming sbyar nas bkod cing / srin bu de dag gi byed las su'ang de dang 'brel yod srin rigs yongs kyi byed las sbyar bar bsam/ de ltar yin pa'i dbang du btang tshe gnyan nad kyi bsdongs grogs su gyur ba'i khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de yang srin bu rigs gcig gi go don min par phyi'i gnyan rgyu de'i 'bab gnas dang ngo bo'i dbang gis bsdongs grogs nang rgyu yang tha dad du mchis/ de ni de'u dmar ba'i zab gsang ya ma drungs 'byin gsang ba'i bka' rgya can las/ nad de gzugs chung mgo gcig gam/ / gnyis gsum lnga sogs mgo nag gam/ / mgo dmar 'gul nus 'gul bral sogs/ / mang nyung ma nges sna tshogs thon/ / na ba'i dus su lus gnas la/ / thogs med glog ltar 'khyugs pa'i phyir/ / dbyung tshe chu la nya ltar ram/ / sa las rlangs pa ji bzhin las/ / bu ga'i lam la ga la ltos/ / ci phyir zhe na mi lus la/ / nam mkhar glog 'khyugs thogs med ltar/ / spyi bo'i gtsug dang rkang mthil bar/ / sha khrag rus la mi thogs par/ / thogs med mda' ltar ma rgyugs sam/ / rdzas ma tshogs dang sngags nyung na/ / thon yang phan pa chung ba dang / / de ltar ma thon gyur kyang phan/ /rnam pa chung bas ma gtses par/ / bde ba'i srin bu dbyung mi bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin lus la nad skyed byed kyi srin bu de dag gi dbyibs dang che chung sogs mi mtshungs pa'i dgongs don gsal bor bstan yang rgyud du tha mal mi'i blo ngor nges phyir srin rigs bzhi las gsungs med/ de kta/na

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/gnyanand so so'i nang rgyu yang srin rigs sna gcig min par gang mang zhig mchis pa'i 'char snang yang bskyar ster/gzhan yang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag bye ba ring bsrel gyi khong lhog nag po gnyan srin gyi sgos bcos pa mi bsru bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng du/ bar snang khams nas ba spu'i sgor 'jug cing / / 'di zhugs lus kyi srin gzhan lhan skyes rnams/ / zhes gsungs pas kyang gnyan nad kyi nang rgyu ni lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs gcig tu ma nges par gang mang zhig yin pa'i bslu med bden kha zhig ster byung / da rung yang man ngag bye ring las gnyan kha med kyi bcos 'chi bdag zhags gcod ces pa ru/ srin bu me ru rtse zhes bye chung khab rtse'i tshad tsam la/ / rlung la bsten nas mkhris rtsar rgyu(rgyud las rgyu ni khrag gnas dug can srin bu bdun/ / zangs ltar dmar zhing phra la ltar mi mngon/ / skad cig tsam la mgo rkang khyab rgyu nus/ / )/ /zhes mchan bkod pa ru gnyan nad kun gyi nang rgyu khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de srin rigs sna gcig ma yin pa shin tu gsal/ de ni gnyan kha med kyi nang rgyu srin me ru rtse yin zhing srin bu de rgyud kyi khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de yin zhes mchan bkod don yang don dam du gnyan nad skabs kyi khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba ni srin bu gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin pas so/ / skabs 'dir rang lugs kho na las bskyar skor rgyab nas ma bsdad par phra mthong che shel gyi lam nas gsal rtogs byung ba'i nub lugs gso rig gi dgongs don la yang zur lta tsam bgyis tshe/ 'gos nad rigs khag gcig gi 'gos srin lus su zhugs rjes gso bya de'i lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs shig tu zhugs nas 'phel bzhin pa de dang / rang gzhung nas gnyan srin par pa ta yang khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba der bsdongs nas 'phel bzhin pa/ spyad las gnyis gcig mtshungs su mchis/ nub lugs dgongs par

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/'gos nad khag cig gi 'gos srin lus su zhugs rjes 'gos rgyu'i srin bu'i dbang gis lhan skyes su grub pa'i zhugs gnas kyi srin rigs yang so sor 'dug pa tshan rtsal gyi lam nas mig gi spyod yul du ster bzhin pas/ gnyan nad kyi nang rgyu khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de yang rigs gcig ma yin pa'i blo 'gog med du byung /mdor na gnyan nad so so'i nang rgyu khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de srin rigs sna gcig min par 'dod pa 'di/ lung dang rig pa'i rgyab rten dben par rang gi zhen phyogs tsam brjod pa ma yin par/ tshad mar gyur ba'i snga rabs lo pan rnams pa'i gsungs la sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin brtag na dngos shugs gang nas kyang brjod 'dod kyi gtam 'di'am lta ba 'di rnyed thub/5 gnyan nad dang dbyi gan nad gnyis kyi gyur tshul 'dra ba'i char dpyadage~X /nga stag bla nor bus mdzad pa'i gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda' ru/lus gnas srin bu'i khog zhugs nas:srin bu gnyan dang bsdongs pa yis:zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang cag bod lugs gso rig tu gnyan nad kyi gyur tshul ni phyi'i rgyu par pa ta de nyid gso bya'i sna khungs dang ba spu'i bu ga sogs brgyud nas lus su zhugs tshe/ nang rgyu'i srin bu'i dbang gis rang gi 'bab gnas de ru gnas bzung zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / mthar 'khrugs nas nad rtags ston pa'i brgyud rim 'di dang nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i dbyi kun nad kyi thog ma'i nad rgyu lus su zhugs tshul dang de 'phel tshul/ mthar 'khrugs par byed pa'i brgyud rim gnyis yongs su mthun/ de ni g.yamyoganyan srin yang gso byar lhan skyes su grub pa'i sdishā bu

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/zhig min par yams thabs su 'gos nas byung ba zhig dang / gnyan srin 'di thog mar gso bya'i khrag tu zhugs shing zungs khrag gi 'khor skyod kyi 'gros dang bstun nas gang sar rgyu/ gso bya mang che bar mthamyoganyan srin mchin gnas su mchin pa'i srin phol dang bsdongs nas 'phel zhing 'khrugs par byed/nyung shas kyi mkhal ma dang lhang ba/ mkhris thum/ tshigs mig bcas su gnas pa'i srin bu dang bsdongs nas 'phel zhing 'khrugs par byed pa'i lta ba 'di dang gong gi par pa ta lus su zhugs shing lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin bur bsdongs nas 'phel ba dang mthar 'khrugs par byed pa'i lta ba gnyis par shing gcig las btab pa'i par gnyis ngo sprad pa dang 'dra/6 dus snyigs mar gnyan rims rigs mang du dar tshul bshadapa/de yang gnyan rims kyi rgyu'i skabs su lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru nad 'di dar zhing mched par gsungs mod/ gal te lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar ma slebs kyang 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho sdod du gnas pa'i mi'i rigs kyi bya spyod tha shal du gyur tsa na skabs der yang dar zhing mched/ de ni dus da lta'i bar bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa spel nas bgrang bya gnyis stong lnga brgya lhag las min zhing / da lta ni lnga brgya phrag bcur phyes pa'i bar ma gsum gyi dus yin pas/ dus 'di ni sgrub pa'i dus te shes rab bslab pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gsum 'byung ba'i dus yin mod/ spyir mi rnams kyis dkar po'i las su 'bad na snyigs dus tshe lo bcu ba'i skabs kyang zlog thabs mchis zhes ston pa bcom ldan 'das dang dam pa gong ma dag gis gsungs/ de na lnga brgya tha ma'i skabs su ma slebs pa'i dus da lta mi rnams kyis dug rdzas mtshon cha bag med du spyod cing rgyal khab dang rgyal khab bam mi rigs dang mi rigs bar 'khrugs rtsod mang du bgisdu shing / re re'i cha nas bshad na mdo la zhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rnams kyis rang gi khyim gzhi'i ched grong du myul zhing nor lug gi tshong byed/gsang sngags la zhugs pa'i sngags pa rnams kyis chags sdang gi lam nas pha rol bor dmod mo byed/ sprul sku tshos rig ma zhes chung ma mang du blangs shing khangakhyim rgya cher dkyil zhing gshin po'i rnam shes bde ba can du 'dren zhes yon bdag gi lag nas 'bul nor rgya cher len/ grong ba rnams kyis mna' za zhing nang dme byed pa dang pha rol bo'i rgyu nor brku zhing 'phrog yang na rgyal bo 'gug pa dang nyal tha 'then pa/ ri dgas rngon pa sogs kha na ma tho ba'i bya spyod ngan pa rigs spel mang tshe snyigs dus su 'byung ba'i nad dag dus da lta'ang 'byung srid/ de ni las bde sdug dkar nag gi sa bon gang btab na 'bras bu yang de thon pa ni 'jig rten 'di'i spyi 'gros shig te/ dper na sa bon du nas btab na 'bras bu yang nas smin la/ sa bon du gro btab na 'bras bu yang gro ru smin pa lta bu/ dpe de bzhin 'dzam gling 'khrugs chen dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs de dang bstun nas sngar ma grags pa'i gnyan rims rigs mang du byung zhing nad gzhi de dag gis skye 'gro gang mang zhig lnga lam du brdzangs/ spyi lo 2000lor rgya gar srid gzhung gis dug rdzas mtshon cha sa 'og tu tshod blta byas pas/ lo de'i rjes mar sngon byung ma myong ba'i mtsho rlabs byung zhing de dang bstun nas rims nad kyang mang du byung / da lta 'di lta bu'i bya spyod ngan pa'i rigs 'dzam gling khyon yongs nas nyin re nas nyin rer rgya cher spel bzhin pa'i 'gros 'di dang mnyam du nye ba'i lo 'gar ༅/5reg dug dang sa si'i glo tshad sogs sngar ma grags pa'i gnyan rims rigs mang du dar zhing snga ma'i rigs las phyi ma'i rigs kyi ngo bo lci ba'i gnas tshul 'di byung / skabs 'di'i 'chad 'gyur gyi mthamyoganyan srin yang da lta rgya cher mched nas 'dzam gling yongs kyi mi'i 605yas mas la phog 'dug pa lta bu las kyis smin pa'i nad gzhi 'di dag la rang rang so so/ /ra

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/bcos kyi gnyen po ma rnyed na sman dpyad gang yang nad kyi grogs su 'gyur 'gro/mi'i rigs kyi spyod pa ni mar ngo'i zla ltar rim bzhin je btsog dang je sdug tu 'gro bzhin pas de bzhin de'i 'bras bur gnyan rims kyi nad kyang je mang dang snga ma'i rigs las phyi ma'i rigs kyi ngo bo lci zhing bcos dka' bar thon bzhin pa ni bod lugs gso rig gi snga rabs pa'i gzhung rnams las phan tshun bsdur dpyod byas na rtogs sla/ de yang 'o skol tsho'i mig mdun na mngon pa'i bod rang gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos snga ma ni sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo'am so ma rā dza dang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi/ cha lag bco brgyad sogs yin/de na gzhung de rnams nas snga phyi ltar bsdur dpyod bgyis na/ so ma rā dza ni bod rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi skabs bod rang gi sman pa khyung bo dam tshugs gtso byas nas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos shig yin/ gzhung der gnyan rims kyi rigs sam dbye bar 'brum pa dang gag pa/ lhog pa/ rims las skyed pa'i 'bras dang sur ya bcas lnga mchis/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ni yongs grags su spyi lo 708lor 'khrungs pa'i g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos gsar du mdzad cing spyi lo 1126lor 'khrungs pa'i g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon pos kha snon mdzad de grub pa zhig yin la/ gzhung de ru rims la bal nad dang rgyu gzer/ gag pa/ lhog pa/ cham pa'i rims bcas lnga dang /bal nad la'ang rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba du ma mchis/ de ni rgyud las/ de la rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa dang / / gnyan rims zhes bya rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ / 'dar bu yer bu rlung gi rims yin te/ / leb rgan klad gzer zhes bya mkhris pa'i rims/ / rmongs bu lkugs pa bad kun rims su bshad/ / 'dus rims dbye ba rgyun rims rtag pa'i rims/ / nyin gcig nyin gsum nyin bzhi rnam pa lnga/ / mkhris pa rtsar rgyug rims dang klad gzer dkā 0/ / rims smyon tree tre hos su btags pa gsum/ / don mthun gnyan

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rims ming gi rnam grangs yin/ / zhes gsungs/ gzhung 'dir gnyan nad dmigs bsal gyi le'u med kyang bal nad kyi le'u'i khongs su bsdus te 'khod pa 'di ni bod lugs gso rig gi thog nas ches thog mar gnyan zhes pa'i nad ming thon pa de yin/ gzhan yang de ru/ dbye ba babs sa ming gis tha dad de/ / mgo la babs na klad gzer zhes bya zhing / / gre bar gag pa ro stod gzer thung ste/ / pho bar gnyan glang rgyu mar rgyu gzer la/ / lpags la me dbal tshigs la men bu skyed/ /nywa la nywa log shar babs lhog par bshad/ /sha rus rtsar bem 'drul phyir 'bras zhes bya/ / 'on kyang 'di ru gag lhog gnyis su bsdu/ / zhes rigs bcur dbye zhing / gnyan nad kyis skyed pa'i 'bras dang sur ya me dbal gsum lhan skyes rma'i khongs su bsdus nas 'khod yod/ g.yu thog gsar mas mdzad pa'i cha lag bco brgyad du gnyan rims kyi dbye ba rgyud bzhi ltar mchis/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi bum pa ru/ tshe lo (bzhi ba rims 'byung ba'i dus bstan pa)drug cu kha ral la:(sems can gyi)srog gcod snying rje med pa'i dmag:mtha' ma'i (hor gyis)dbus yul bzung nas su:bod khams (sems can bzhi gsum dbugs dang bral nas)cham la 'bebs pa'i tshe:sa yi 'khrul 'khor (sa g.yos pa)chen po 'byung:rtsi shing nags tshal 'gul zhing ldeg:ri rdo klungs su char ltar babs:sems can thams cad ('ga' zhig lus srog dbugs dang bzhi gsum 'bral)'jigs shing skrag:de rjes mkha' la me 'bar nas:nyi zla gza' skar gzi mdangs nyams:char rgyun me tog ri bong ra:('dra ste med)skye 'khrungs me tog ma rungs (brlag pa)byas:rdo yi 'khrul 'khor (yos 'thagapa)rgyun thag chad:tsha grang 'thab pa'i nga ro nyams:kug(lhog pa la zer)ces bya ba'i nad kyang 'byung:dbang bo'i grwa chag (nad des bzhi gsum 'joms par byed) gzi mdangs shor:yi dwags lta bur rid 8sang

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/nyams:bag med lus po stan la 'byar:gso ba'i thabs bral sman mchog dkon:de 'byung spyod pa snga ltas ni:gos ngan khyi thul gon pa 'ong:nywa ngan rtsid zhu gyon pa 'ong:phu dung kha mthud dmar po 'dogs:lta ba mthon por khas blangs nas:phaṭa kyi (mtshan nyid mi shes pa)de nyid mi shes par:kha la phaṭa ces zer ba 'ong: (gang gis kyang ci byed 'chi ba 'ong bar gda' zer 'dodasred su bas che ba zhig go)chos med log chos spyod pa 'ong:de 'dra'i dus rnams byung dus su:nag po rgyug 'gyel dar bar 'gyur:'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa las:rims 'byung ba'i dus bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga ba'o:zhes dang /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gso dpyad rgyal bo'i dkor mdzod du/ gnyan la rigs dgu yod de/ mgo la byung na klad gzer/ og ma la byung na gag pa/ gre ba la byung na thor ba/ snying dang mchin pa la byung na stod gzer/ glo ba la byung na glo tshad/ pho ba la byung na pho log rgyu ma la byung na rgyu gzer/ rkang la byung na nywa byin log phyi rol tu spangs na lhog pa/ zhes dang / yang de ru/ de yang stod du byung na gzer thung / rgyu ma la byung na rgyu gzer/ gre ba la byung na gag pa/ phyi ru byung na lhog pa bya ba yin zhes gsungs/gzhung 'dir sngar gzhung rnams su med pa'i gnyan stod gzer dang gnyan thor ba/ gnyan glo tshad gsum byung / mkhas mchog zur 'tsho ba phyag rdor mgon pos mdzad pa'i rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i thugs bcud gces bsdus rin chen phreng ba'i gnyan nad gzer thung bcos pa'i yig chung du/ ngos 'dzin nad kyi sde gcig la/ / bab sa'i khyad par rims dgu ste/ / klad gzer gag pa rtsa rgyug dang / / glo tsha gam 'khrugs gzer thung dang / / rgyu gzer lhog pa byin lhog go zhes gzhung 'dir sngar gzhung rnams su med pa'i gam 'khrugs dang byin lhog gnyis mchis/ 'bri gung chos grags sogs kyis mardoX pa'i 'bri gung gso rig gces btus las gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rgyugs la sogs pa'i gnyan nad bcos tshul bsdus pa zhal lung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du/ gnyan rims don la babs par gzer thung dang gnyan rims snod du babs pa'i bshal rims zhes snga gzhung rnams su med pa gnyis mchis/skabs 'di'i gzer thung ni gnyan rims don la babs pa zhig dang rgyud du gsungs pa'i gzer thung ni gnyan rims stod du babs pa zhig yin pas de gnyis kyi ming gcig kyang don so sor 'jug spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga ba'i nang 'khrungs ba'i gong sman dkon mchog bde legs kyis mdzad pa'i gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung du mkhris rims dug thabs zhes sngar gzhung rnams su ma grags pa zhig mchis/ mi dbang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog gis mdzad pa'i man ngag lhan thabs kyi gnyan nad mgor babs klad gzer bcos pa ru/ gnyan zhes bya ba'i gdug can nad sna ni/ / bsod nams mthu zhan snyigs dus sems can la/ / gzhung chen rnams su ma grags nad sna dang / /phyogs tsam ma gtogs ma gsungs du ma 'byung / /zhes dang / yang de las/ dbye ba babs sa ming gis tha dad de/ / mgo la babs na klad gzer zhes bya zhing / / gre bar gag pa ro stod gzer thung ste/ / pho bar gnyan glang rgyu mar rgyu gzer la/ /lpags la me dbal tshigs la rmen bu skyed/ /nywa la nywa log shar babs lhog par bshad/ / sha rus rtsar bem 'brul phyir 'bras zhes dang / /rgyungs par babs na 'dzum bu ltag dgye dang / / mkhris babs rtsar rgyug rims smyon tre tre ho/ / rgya nad mig ser nag po sum 'gril zhes/ /srog rtsa don (sger smos min pa phal cher)snod nang babs nang lhog dang / /gnyan rims kha med 'khyams po 'bar 'bur dang / / rna rtsa phus 'debs ngam ru zhes pa sogs/ / mdor na ming bzung mi lang nad kyi rigs/ / du mas 'gro ba'i tshe srog myur du len/ / zhes sngar gzhung rnams su med pa'i gnyan 'dzum bu ltag dgye dang gnyan kha med/ gnyan 'khyams po/ /sdun

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'bar 'bur/ gnyan rna rtsa phus 'debs/ gnyan ngam ru bcas rigs drug gi rgyu rkyen dang nad rtags bcos thabs sogs gsal por bkod/ de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i lag len gces btus las gdug pa'i nad ngan tree tre ho bcos pa'i gdams pa things gsos zla ba'i thigs pa ru/ mdor bsdus 'di la rigs lnga dang / / gnas kyi dbye ba bco brgyad bshad/ / dang po rigs kyi dbye ba lnga/ / dug 'khrugs tre tre ho zhes pa/ / gnyan tshad spyi mthun rlung rtags ldan/ / de las khyad par lud pa las/ / khrag dang chu ser 'ong na yang / / gzer che dbugs rgod glo mi thon/ / stod 'tshangs lus tshad shin tu che/ / rims smyon tre tre ho zhes pa/ /spyi las khyad par mgo dang ni/ / rked pa na zhing rkang lag gzer/ /dang ga mi bde phyi tshad che/ / lhog rgod tre tre ho zhes pa/ / spyi las khyad par mgo na zhing / / rkang lag rgyu 'dar gzer zug che/ / gzer shul skrangs pa sra la mkhregs/ /shes pa gsal la 'grim snar sdar/ / phyi tshad rim pas chung ngur 'gro/ / khrag gzer tre tre ho zhes pa/ / nu mchin ro stod mkhal rked gzer/ / gzer ngos 'og tu gtad mi bzod/ / shes pa bying la phyi tshad che/ / mngal nad tre tre ho zhes pa/ / lud pa khrag mi chags pa 'ong / / lus po lci la min rnams spang / / zhes tre tre ho rigs lngar dbye/ kurma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i phan bde nor bu'i bang mdzod dam sman bsdus waṃ du gnyan srin bcos pa zhes sngar med pa zhig 'dug byang chub rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bla ma zab don snying thig las:'gro ba'i srog 'dzin bdud rtsi'i char rgyun du/ mkhris pa skya ser gnyan tshad can dang / mkhris pa tsha rims/mkhris pa grang rims/ mkhris pa gnyan rims/ mkhris 'dam tsha rims/gdon rims/ rgyu rims/ dug rims/ mkhal ma sogs don lnga'i gzer rimastu/ ske rims/ sna rims/ klad rims/ rims nad ltag pa 'gyel

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gdong / rims nad 'gyur thag nag po rgyug gzer/ rims nad 'og 'then 'dzum bu thur rgyug nag po/ nying lag chu 'thor rims/ gnyan nag chu bur nag po/ khong bu nag po gzer 'thor rims/ rims nag tre tre tsha rdor/ tre tre tsha rdol/ tre tre 'bur nag gnyan ya ma nag po gzer thung / gnyan gzer hrid/ gnyan gzer 'thor/ gnyan gzer 'bur/ gnyan gzer 'byams/ sogs sngar ma grags pa'i gnyan nad rigs nyer bdun tsam gsar du bstan/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gso rig zin tig gces bsdus bdud rtsi'i thigs pa ru/ gnyan rims ni deng sang dus dbang gas shin tu mang zhing nad rtags sna tshogs pa 'byung bas shin tu brtag dka' zhing nad gzhan la'ang gnyan shas med pa cher med pa lta bu snang bas thon thengs dgos zhes gsungs/ gter chen rdo rje 'chang o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo'i zab gter las byung ba'i khra bkod mkha' 'gro'i las tshogs las/ deng sang dus kyi nad gyur pa: glo bur srog la rgol ba yi:gnyan rigs mi 'dra brgyad cu yis:zhes gnyan nad la rigs mi 'dra ba brgyad cu yod par gsungs pa der stag bla nor bu'i gnyan 'joms rdo rje thog mda'i lhan thabs nyung bsdus su/ 'di nyid nas bshad pa'i gnyan srin nag po rtsar rgyug dang / bye ba ring bsrel nas bshad pa'i gnyan mthing nag ste nyi shu po re re la'ang rlung shas che ba nyi shu/ mkhris shas che ba nyi shu/ bad kun shas che ba nyi shu ste brgyad cu po gzhung 'dir dngos bstan dang / zhes de rnams 'di dang 'di yin zhes spyi tsam gyi ngos 'dzin gnang / yang de las/gzhan yang snyigs dus mi rnams kyis spyod pa log pa dang / mtha' ma'i dug rdzas dar ba'i rkyen gyis da dung yang nad rigs dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal la zad mtha' med pas rang re sman pa rnams kyis rgyal sras rigs gsum sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la brtson te srog chags kun yang kātā kyi

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/sdug bsngal las bskyab pa la brtson pa'i mthu shugs gal che/ zhes snyigs dus skye bo'i spyod pa log par gyur zhing pha rol bo'i srog gcod par byed pa'i dug rdzas dang dug rdzas mtshon cha dar ba'i rkyen gyis de'i rnam smin du gnyan nad rigs zad mtha' med par 'byung srid ces pa'i dgongs don 'di yang khong nyid gcig pu ma zad/ bod snga rabs kun gyis gnyan nad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen du bzhag pa'i sdom tshig cig yin/ khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas mdzad pa'i gso rig phan bde'i snye ma ru/ babs sa'i ming dang bstun na grangs mang yang / / mgo la babs na klad gzer mgo 'thom dang / / gre bar babs na gag pa mid 'char zer/ / snying la babs na nag po rgyug 'gyel dang / / srog rtsar babs na kha lkugs dgye rengs zer/ / mchin mkhris la babs mkhris pa rtsa rgyug dang / / rgya nad mig ser nag po sum sgril zer/ /mtsher babs gzer thung gnyan rgod gzer 'joms dang / / mkhal lhang la babs khong lhog nag po zer/ / pho bar babs na gnyan glang gzer 'bar dang / / rgyu mar babs na rgyu gzer khong rul zer/ / long la babs na khong lhog khrag 'byams zer/ / bsam ser babs na gnyan nad kha med zer/ /sha la babs na lhog pa nag po dang / / lpags la babs na me lce 'khor lo zer/ / tshigs la babs na rmen bu zhes bya dang / / sha rus rtsa ru zhen na 'bras zhes bya/ / yan lag la babs nywa log 'khru skyugs zer/ / rgyungs par babs par 'dzum bu ltag dgye zer/ / sor rtse nas zhugs gnyan srin nag po zer/ / gzhan yang gnyan rims rna rtsa phus 'debs dang / / skrangs pa 'bar 'bur ngam ru 'phyi dug dang / / 'khyam po nyag gcig gnyan nad rus zhugs nag/ klu gdon dang bsdongs pags mdze nag po dang / / gnyan srin gnyan rma gnyan 'bam gnyan ske skrangs/ / gnyan 'grams gnyan 'khrugs la so~X so so ni/ /'og tu bye brag rang rang le'ur gsal/ / gong bshad myur

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ba'i rang bzhin can gsum dang / / bsdoms pas gnyan nad rims bcas sum cu dgu/ / rgyas par nad rigs kun la gnyan bsdong pa/ / shin tu mang ba phal cher rig pas dpyod/ / ces dang / yang de las/ de phyir gnyan nad gdug pa'i rims rgod la/ / rnam pa mang yang rgyud du cher ma gsungs/ / dus kyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston/ / zhes gsungs pa ltaragazhung snga ma rnams las phyi ma'i rigs kyi khongs su gnyan nad kyi rigs gsungs mang don yang dam pa de dag gis gzhung de rnams mdzad skabs sngar gzhung rnams su ma mchis pa'i gdug pa can gyi gnyan nad gsar ba zhig dar yod pa la de'i rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul nad rtags sogs la legs par dpyad byes kār gzhan dang mi nor ba'i ming gsar ba re btags te bris pa'i rkyen gas de/nga /rabs gso rig las bshad pa'i dbyi gan nad der rang lugs su gnyan nad mchin ldem zhes ming 'dogs par 'dod pa/skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i nub lugs dbyi kun nad 'di'i rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul sogs la zhib tu dpyad mthar gnyan nad kyi khongs su gtogs pas/ gnyan nad bye brag pa zhig yin pa'i sdom tshig gong las rgyab zin zhing / lhag par du snyigs mar skye bo'i spyod pa tha shal du gyur rkyen rim bzhin sngar byung ma myong zhing sngar gyi gzhung chen rnams su ma grags pa'i gnyan nad rigs kyang mang du 'byung bar brten/ gsar dar gyi gnyan nad de rigs la skabs der nad de'i na lugs dang nad rtags na gnas sogs la brtag nas gsar dar nad de'i khyad chos 'dzin pa'i ming gsar ba re btags pa yang lag len gces btus dang phan bde'i snye ma sogs las gsal/ spyir bya dngos gang dang gang yin rung de gzhan dang mi nor phyirā /nga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/re gdags rgyu ni 'jig rten 'di'i chos nyid yin la/ ming der yang 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub gnyis su mchis pa las/ phyi ma ni gdags gzhi'i bya dngos de'i ngo bo dang dbyibs/ byed las sogs la gzhigs nas rang gi khyad chos 'dzin pa'i ming re btags pa de yin/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dgos pa ni langs kur gshegs pa'i mdo las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ / 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur/ / de bas rmongs pa spang ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad/ / ces dang / slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long ma ru/ gal te sgra don snang ba yis/ /'khor ba gsal bar ma byas na/ / 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag ni/ /smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / rgyu mtshan der brten nas gnyan nad gang mang zhig gi ming yang de'i nad rtags dang na lugs/ yang na na ba'i gnas sogs la gzhi bcol nas ming re gdags shing /de ltar btags pa'i ming phal che ba mthong tshe der nad de'i spyi'i na lugs sam nad rtags dang yang na na gnas tsam rtogs thub pa'i dge mtshan ldan/dper na gnyan glo tshad gzer thung dang gnyan glo rims khrag 'byams/gnyan rgyu gzer/ gnyan me dbal/ gnyan rmen bu lta bu/ gzhan gnyan nad ma yin pa'i nad gzhi gang mang zhig gi ming yang de bzhin btags par ma zad/nadagazhi re gnyis kyi nad ming ni nad rtags dang na lugs sogs gang zhig dang 'dra ba'i cha der gzhi bcol nas kyang gdags bzhin mchis/ dper na na lugs su glang bu'i rwas bsnun pa ltar zug rngu drag po 'phral 'phral du 'byung bas na nad gzhi de'i nad ming du glang thabs zhes btags shing skabs 'di'i thabs ni 'dra ba la go ste/ thabs ni 'dra ba'o zhes gsungs pas so/ / mchin nad dug thabs la mtshon na'ang nad de'i nad rgyu dug ma yin yang nad rtags su hā/ nad kyi rtags ltar thon pas na de bzhin btags/ de na skabs 'di'i

le'u lnga ba/ gnyan nad mchin ldem dngos bshad pa/dang po/ gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi rgyu bshad pa/de yang gang gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi gnyan nad mchin ldem la mtshon na/gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de 'gos mched du 'gro ba'i nad gzhi 'di gnyan rims gnyis las gnyan nad kyi khongs su gtogs shing / gnyan nad yin tshe der phyi'i rgyu dang nang gi rgyu bcas gnyis su mchis/ nad gzhi 'di'i phyi'i rgyu ni gso bya de'i lus 'tsho bar byed pa la grogs bgyi ba'i lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi khongs su ma gtogs pa'i phyi rol tu gnas pa'i gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin gso bya de'i lus kyi rma kha'am ba spu'i bu ga sogs brgyud de lus kyi nang logs su zhugs pa de yin/ nang gi rgyu ni gnyan nad kun gyi phyi rgyu'i bsdongs grogs khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba de yin/ skabs 'di'i khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba ni der byed las mtshungs pa'i srin bu gang zhig gi spyi ming yin la/ de'i rkyen gyis gnyan mchin ldemaganyan srin la yang 'bab gnas kyi dbang gis nang rgyu gcig tu ma nges/de ni gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin gyis mchin gnas bzung tshe phyi'i rgyu de mchin pa'i srin phol de mchin srin dang bsdongs nas nad skyed bzhin pa dang /mkhal mar zhugs nas de ru gnas bzung tshe mkhal ma'i srin phol de mkhal srin dang bsdongs nas nad skyed par byed/ de bzhin tshigs dmigs dang lgadī ༵/ mtsher ba bcas kyi gnas su zhugs tshe gnas de'i srin bu zhig dang

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/nang ngos spri dkar yin zhing / 544ni zags thon rang bzhin gyi spri dkar yinapas 54khudang lhan du 'brel nas cha tshang ba'i sa 2myoganyan srin du gyur/ 'on kyang cha tshang ba'i gnyan srin grub byed kyi rgyu yin mod/gtso saponi de bzhin cha tshang ba'i gnyan srin grub byed kyi rgyu min zhing dus rtag tu gtsomyoganyan srin gyi phyi ru zags nas 766(7dang lhan khrag tu rgyu bas/rdzas 'gyur gyis khrag tu brtag skabs mthong thub kyang sa snga bar khrag nas med 'gro/ mdor na ni gdags yin pa'i khrag tu 'byung zhing / rtag tu g.yasto bas lus khams su 'phel bzhin pa'i skabs su'ang gdags yin/ der brten gdags yin pa'i rtags mtshan sdi lus khamazi su g.yayiganyan srin 'phel skyen zhing der 'gos pa'i rang bzhin ba ba(cazlo zi/go/ga rdzas —g.yeni med rjes kyi dus thung ngu'i nang 'byung srid/ 'gog rdzas mkha thon rtags ni mthamyoganyan srin lus khams su skye 'phel chung zhing der gzhan la 'gos pa'i rang bzhin chung ba'i rtags bcas yin/ 'on kyang 'gog rdzas mkhangal gnyan srin 'gog srung gi nus pa med/ mi re gnyis kyi 'gog rdzas mtshe gdags yin pa'i khrag tu bkra'u'abyung srid cing mchin srin du'ang g.yam bas lus 'dug 'gog rdzas —54ni nad gzhir sangs drag byung rjes kyi lo 1nas skyabar gso bya de'i khrag tu 'dug nges/106
