bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/rtsal 'di ni gso bya'i nad gzhi'i lci yang sogs la rtogs byed kyi thabs lam med du mi rung ba zhig yin/rig pa 'dis gsum nas gnyen po'i sman gang rigs 'phrod min du brtag rgyu ste/ gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin lus khams su bag tu nyal yod pa'am 'khrugs bzhin pa sogs kyi gang yin rung gtsom bas gdags yin tshe gnyan srin de gzhom sman gtso bor bsten rgyu dang / gnyen po'i sman yun ring bsten rjes gso bya de rigs la lag rtsal 'dis bskyar brtag byas tshe mthag bas sribs la 'gyur 'dug na gnyen po'i sman der phan nus che zhing lus khams su gnyan srin 'phel bzhin med pa dang nad gzhir sangs drag byung 'dug par mtshon/ gal te ga2ma bas gdags yin yang grangs je nyung du gyur 'dug na gnyen po'i sman la phan che yang nad gzhi gting 'don ma thub rkyen gnyan sman mu mthud bsten dgos par mtshon/bdu2lag rtsal 'di 'dus rdul skyes dngos rig pa'i thabs lam (7cha47stsaṭhaṣṭha)zhig yin zhing / thabs lam 'dis bas ldab sa ya gcig gis je cher gtong thub pas tshor rtogs kyi nus pa shin tu rno/ lag rtsal 'dir ched spyod kyi 'phrul chas dang ched spyod kyi khang pa ched las mi sna bcas 'dzoms dgos/ de ltar ma ldan tshe lan rer brtag 'bras log par yang 'byung srid/ de'i rkyen gyis lus khams su mtham bas yod med brtag dgos tshe rgyal khab 'phrod bsten pu'u yisabadu2lag rtsal bkol chog pa'i mchog chan thob pa'i sman khang du phyin nas brtag rgyu gal/ spyir bdustulag rtsal der bkol gnas kyi dbang gis rigs mang mod/ nad thog tu mkho ba ni ngo bo gtan khel gyi thabustulag rtsal dang grangs gtan khel gyi 'dusalag rtsal bcas gnyis yin/ skabs 'dir mtshon na ngo bo gtan khel gyi 'dustulag rtsal gyis mthamyo bas gdags dang sribs gang yin brtag dgos/ 1sdu/ga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/'bras su sribs yin tshe ya'amyoganyan srin 'gos med pa dang gdags yin tshe gtsomyoganyan srin 'gos 'dug pa mtshon/ grangs gtan khel gyi 'du2lag rtsal gyis thog mar ngo bo gtan khel byed dgos pa ma zad 22ga bas gdags yin pa'i mthaskyoganyan srin gyi grangs gtan khel byed dgos/khrag ho hrin gcig tu mthayiganyan srin ga tshod yod par zhib rtsis bya dgos pasalag rtsal 'di ni ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig yin/ de yang thog mar lag rtsal 'di gso bya'i cha gnyis dang phyed kyi brtag 'bras la gzhigs nas spyod dgos min thag gcod bya dgos/ de ni gdags che ba gsum lta bu'i gso byar mtshon na de'i lus khams su mthamyoganyan srin 'phel bzhin pas der thadustulag rtsal gyis brtag dgos don med/ gdags chung ba gsum dang gcig pu gdags yin pa lta bu sogs gzhan rnams la bdu5lag rtsal gyis brtag na g.yayiganyan srin lus khams su 'phel bzhin yod med dang grangs ga tshod mchis pa bcas brtag thub/ gzhan gso bcos ma byas pa'i sngon g.yamyoganyan srin gyi grangs dang gso bcos byas rjes kyi grangs gnyis bsdur dpyod byas tshe gnyen po'i sman der phan nus yod med kyang rtogs thub/nad rtags su gnyan mchin ldem phog tshe mang che bar kha zas la yi ga med cing snum rigs za mi thub pa dang / grod pa spos rgyangs byed pa sogs kyi nad rtags thon don ni/ gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin mchin srin du 'dzul nas rim bzhin 'phel zhing mthar 'khrugs nas mchin nus je zhan du gyur zhing mchin par gnas pa'i me drod gsum gyi mthu nyams/ khrag snyigs mchin pa nas mkhris khur 'gyur dgos pa de rgyun ldan ltar 'gyur ma thub par mchin gnas nas 'gag par gyur rkyen/ mkhris khu je nyung du gyur zhing lhag par me drod mkhris pa'i mthu nyams pas zas la yi ga med cing snam rigs za mi thub pa/ gyur/ de bzhin me drod mkhris pa'i mthu nyams par brten zas skom gang

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/zos pa myag bzhu dwangs snyigs 'byed ma thub par pho ba nas yun ring lus shing der rlung zhugs pas grod pa sbos brgyangs byed pa'i rtags thon/ spyir mchin pa'i gnas su me drod gsum gyi byed las la brten nas dngas ma nas khrag tu 'gyur bzhin 'dug mod/ gnas der gnod phog tshe dwangs snyigs legs por 'byed ma thub par dwangs ma'i gnas su snyigs ma shor rkyen dug nad phog pa ltar dug thabs kyi rtags ston/ gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin gyis mchin gnas bzung zhing yun ring na bar gyur tshe gso bya khag cig gi nad gzhi rim bzhin mchin rgud dang mchin 'bras sogs su 'gyur srid/ gso bya de dag gi grod pa'i steng sdom gyi dra ba'i dbyibs ltar gyi ri mo thon don ni mi'i lus kyi skul rtsir khrag rtsa je sbom byed pa'i nus pa ldan/ de yang skul rtsi ni mchin nus kyis med par bzo dgos mod/ mchin pa'i nus pa nyams zhan du gyur skabs sngon ltar skul rtsi je nyung du gtong mi thub par lus shing mang du gsog rkyen de'i byed las kyis khrag rtsa phra mo'i rigs je sbom du gyur bas sdom gyi dra ba lta bu'i khrag rtsa'i ri mo mang du thon/ gzhan skul rtsi mang du 'phel bas khrag rtsa phra mo'i rigs cher rgyas pas lag ngos su dmar thig kyang thon srid la/ re gnyis kyi rkang mthil du'ang de bzhin dmar thig 'byung srid/drug pa/ gnyad nad mchin ldem gyi bcos thabs bshad pa/spyir nad gzhi gang zhig yin rung de gso ba'i thabs su gzhol tshe/ nad de sel bar byed pa la zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi mchis pas/ gnyan nad mchin ldem bcos dgos tshe nad gzhi der gnod pa'i zas spyod rnams spang zhing phan pa'i rigs shugs cher bsten rgyu ni spyi 'gros kyi gnas lugastu /ga

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/yin/ des na zas ni rgyud las/ de phyir dkar mngar gnod cing dug gis 'joms/ / zhes dang / yang de las/ gnyan ma sod par gtar dang dkar mngar spang / /'bras thug yos thug bskol grang chu grog btang / / zhes dang /stag bla nor bu'i gnyan rigs bco brgyad kyi bcos thabs su/ kha zas mngar skyur dkar dmar dug 'dra spang / / zhes dang / khams gtsang mchog gi gnyan rims spyi'i bcos thabs su/ gnyan ma sod par gtar dang dkar mngar gnod/ / dkar gsum mngar gsum zas kyi spyang ki yin/ / zhes gsungs ba bzhin gnyan srin ma sod bar du kha zas su ro mngar che ba'i rigs ka ra lta bu dang / dar ba dang chur ba/ dus tshod yun ring bsnyal ba'i skyur po lta bu ro skyur shas che ba'i rigs/ sems can gyi 'o ma'i rigs dkar po dang /sha'i rigs dmar rnams nad gzhi 'dir dug bzhin gnod pas spang zhing /'bras thug dang yos thug bskol grang ngam yang na chu la rtsam pa phran bu btab pa'i chu grog rnams gtso bor bsten rgyu/ spyod lam du/ rgyud kyi gag lhog gso ba'i le'u ru/ spyod lam chags pa nyin gnyid drag shul dang / / rta zhon khro 'tshig chu rgal mi sdug spang / / zhes dang / stag bla nor bu'i gnyan nad bco brgyad kyi bcos thabs su/ spyod lam g.yeng med mun nag dben pa'i sar/ / ra phyar gdan bting byang la sngas bstan nyal/ / dam nyams yug sa 'dre can grib la 'dzem/ / lha rje nad g.yog phag rgod mche ba btags/ / ka ca khyer len rol mo'i sgra skad spang / / tshogs bsags 'chi bslu la sogs rim gro 'bad/ / de dag gnyan nad spyi yi chings su bshad/ / ces dang / khams gtsang mchog gi gnyan rims spyi'i bcos thabs su/ spyir na gnyan la 'grul sna shin tu sdang / / de phyir 'grul bsrung gal che thab gzhob 'dzem/ / 'grul sna sdang zhing 'dre kha shin tu rgod/ / gang byas gnod du gyur pa'i gdon can la/11/4gdon bsrung la sogs gang rigs byas na phan/ / zhes gsungs pa

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/bzhinaspyod lam du nyin par gnyid log pa dang yang na drag shul gyi las byas pa/ rta zhon pa/ sems khro zhing 'tshig pa/ chur brgal ba sogs spang / nad gzhi lci ba'i skabs 'grul sna srung zhing thab gzhob la 'dzem rgyu dang / yid 'ongs dben gnas su skyid par 'dug sman gyis bcos par zhi byed dang sbyong byed gnyis su mchis shing / 'dir zhi byed sman gtso bor bzung ste gnyan rims gnyis las kyang gnyan nad kyi ched bcos phyogs su gzhol na/ khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas mdzad pa'i phan bde nor bu'i snye ma ru/ rims bcos rkyang bas gnyan nad sel ba min/ / bsil gyis tshad pa 'joms yang gnyan mi sod/ / dug gis gnyan mgo chom yang tshad pas min/ / chu 'thung skom pa sel yang lto mi 'grangs/ / sha zos bkres pa zhi yang skom mi sel/ /gnyen po gcig gis nad kun sel ba dka'/ / de phyir tsha ba'i bcos tshul ma shes na/ / gnyen po nad kyi grogs su 'gro yang srid/ / ces gsungs pa ltar gnyan nad rigs bcos skabs rims dang bsdongs zla yod med sogs zhib tu brtag rjes/ gnyan srin 'dis don snod dang dbang bo/ yang na yan lag sogs gang du gnas bzung 'dug pa dang / tsha ba'i stobs che'am chung ba sogs la dpag nas der 'tsham pa'i gnyen po'i sman sprod dgos/ dpyad kyi bcos thabs las 'phros te gnyan nad la thog mar rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam dgos zhes parngo cung dpyad na/ de yang rgyud las/ spyi bcos dang po rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam/ / gnyis pa gnyen po sbyar bas bsad pa dang / /gsum pas ro dbyung bzhi bas nad lhag bsal/ / zhes gnyan rims la thog mar rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam par gsungs shing / der sman gyis bsdam pa zhig dang me btsas bsdam pa zhig bcas gnyis su mchis/ me btsas bsdam pa'i thabs ni gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs lta bu dus yun thung ngu'i nang gso bya'i srog la rgol bar byed pa'i rigs rnams gtso bor dgongs pa las 113na

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/rims kyi nad yod do cog gor thog ma nyid nas de bzhin byed mi dgos par ma zad/ gzhung gzhan rnams su sman gyis bsdam dgos pa'i dgongs don yang rnyed khag de ni kurma nges legs kyis mdzad pa'i sman bsdus e ru/gter ma sogs las grags pa'i gnyan rims nag po sum sgril sogs su 'bod pa 'di rgyud las bshad pa'i mkhris pa rtsar rgyug de yin par thag bcad nas/ de thog ma nas gzhan du mi 'bros pa'i phyir rtsa'i 'bros 'phrang me btsas sdom (khyad par nyams yig pas)par mdzad do/ /'on kyang bye ring khong lhog gi bcos dang bdud rtsi bum pa sogs las thog mar rtsa'i 'bros 'phrang sdom par ma gsungs pas dpyad par bya ste/ rgyud kyi mkhris pa rtsar rgyug ces pa de thog mar mchin mkhris gnyis la bab pa dang / mkhris pa'i rtags bstan pa dang / mchin mkhris steng du 'dril ba mnan mi bzod ces 'byung bas nad 'di thog mar mchin mkhris la bab par nges shing / de nas mkhris pa rtsar rgyug ces ming don mthun par don snod sogs la rgyug pas de mi rgyug pa'i phyir 'bros 'phrang sdom pa'i sman dpyad gsungs/ zhes pas kyang rgyud du thog mar rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam rgyu ni gnyan nad kun gyi bcos thabs kyi rtsa don zhig min par gnyan mkhris pa rtsa rgyug kho nar dgongs nas gsungs/ gnyan nad rigs la thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyis bcos pa'i thabs shig kyang mchis mod/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bcos thabs der rang nyid la mtshon na long bar lam bstan pa bzhin gsal cha ci yang ma mchis phyir 'dir de'i skor gling thabs bral/ skabs 'di nas 'chad 'gyur gyi gnyan nad mchin ldem gzhir bzung ste cung gleng bar bya na/ rang nyid nas nad gzhi 'dir nad thog steng zhi byed sman gtso bor bgyis nas lan rer gtar kha dang lto sbyongs bcas btang nas bcos pa yin zhing / nad thog nas nad 'dir btang ba'i sbyor ba rna/rdo sang lung dang rigs pa'i rgyab brten med par mi skyon pas ral gri thog

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/pa bzhin gang byung du sprad pa zhig gtan nas min/ de ni/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa las:srung ba'i kha byang bzhugs so:zhes pa ru/ bdud rtsi chen po'i sbyor ba yis:dang por gnyan gyi ri bo snyil:bsil sman chen po sbags ma yis:bar du tshad pa'i me dbal gsad:bcud bcol tshad dang rnaldan pa yis:tha ma rung bcos lus po gso:zhes dang / khams gtsang 'brug rgyal lags nas mdzad pa'i gso rig phan bde'i snye ma ru/ bcos thabs spyi la sman dpyad rim gro dang / / zas dang spyod lam lnga las dang po ni/ / spyir na ma smin bar du gtar bshal rngul/ /bsil rtsub thang phye'i sbyor ba byas gyur na/ / tshe srog myur du 'dor ram gso dkar 'gyur/ / bcos tshul thog mar gnyan gyi ri bo bsnyil/ /bar du tshad pa rgyas pa'i me dbal bsad/ / tha ma ri thang mtshams su zas spyod bcos/ / 'di yang gnyan nad spyi yi chings su bshad/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin thog mar gnyan gyi ri bo lta bu snyil thub pa'i sbyor sde rigs kyis gnyan srin gzhom zhing / de nas nad gzhi der 'tsham pa'i bsil sman rigs kyis tshad pa'i me dbal chen po bsad/ mthar gso bya'i lus zungs gso dgos par gdams/ yang de las/ mdor na dang po gnyan dang dbral ba dang / /bar du yan lag sdong zla bsad pa dang / / tha ma don snod kha 'dzin bsdebs pa dang / /mjug tu log na gnyen po sbyar zhes gsungs/ / zhes pa'ang gong gi dgongs don dang phal cher mtshungs mod/ tha ma don snod kyi kha 'dzin bsdebs dgos pa 'di dmigs bsal can zhig yin pa ma zad/ nad thog dngos kyi nang mkho gal che ba'i brgyud rim zhig kyang yin la/ 'di rnams ni gnyan nad spyi'i bcos thabs la dgongs nas gsungs pa las/ rigs mi 'dra ba'i gnyan nad bye brag pa so sor gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i dmigs bsal gyi gso thabs kyi rtsa don re yang mchis/ de ni khams gtsang 'bru/ /la

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/lags nas mdzad pa'i gso rig phan bde'i snye ma ru/ 'di la dgos kyi gnyen pos ma slob na/ / gso ba log cing srog gi gshed mar 'gro/ / zhes dang /yang de la/ de phyir gnyan nad gdug pa'i rims rgod la/ / rnam pa mang yang rgyud du cher ma gsung / / dus kyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston/ / de dang bstun pa'i bcos kyang khyad par che/ / de phyir dus babs gter ma zab khyad 'phags/ /zhes dang / zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag bye ba ring bsrel gyi khong lhog nag po gnyan srin gyi sgos bcos mi bsru bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng du/ nad spyir gso ba'i gzhung gdams 'bum shes kyang / /'di la sgos kyi gnyen pos ma slebs na/ / sman dpyad gang yang nad kyi grogs yin te/ / 'chi bdag kha ru de srog myur du 'gro/ / des na thugs rje'i gter mdzod u rgyan gyis/ / mnga' bdag rje la gdams pa'i zab gnad dang / / gzhan yang sgos kyi zab dgu bye ba'i bcud/ / nyung ngur bsdus nas bshad kyis yid la zung / / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de yang gong gi spyi bye brag gi rtsa don rnams gzhir bzung na thog mar gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin gzhom byed kyi gnyan sman bsten dgos shing / de nas gso bya'i pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs dang na tshod/ nad gzhan gyi bsdongs zla yod med/nad gzhi 'dis mchin nus la gnod skyon bzos yod med sogs la gzhigs nas gang la gang 'tsham gyis bcos dgos pas/ phran nyid nas kyang nad gzhi 'dir gso bcos bya skabs gong gi rig par gzhi bcol te rang nyid nas gsar sbyor byas pa'i sman sbyor gnyan 'joms dgu ba dang gar nag dgu sbyor gnyis gtso bor bzung nas bcos shing / nad 'dis mnar ba'i gso byar gso bcos dngos su ma bgyis gong gso bya de'i mchin par nad 'gyur byung yod med rdzas 'gyur gyis brtag rgyu shin tu gal/ gzhan nad gzhi 'di byung rje/ spyazlo yan lag gi tshigs na ba'am snying mi bde ba sogs kyi gnas tshul yang

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/mchis pas/ de rnams kyi rtags dang na lugs sogs yod med zhib tu brtag mthar/ nad gzhan bsdongs zla med cing pho ba'i me drod legs pa'i rigs la thog mar nyin bco lnga tsam gyi yun snga nub tu gnyan 'joms dgu ba btang nas gnyan gyi ri bo snyil bar byas/ de'i rjes nas gong sman steng nyin gung gi dus su pho ba'i me drod gso bar yang phan pa'i gar nag dgu sbyor btang nas pho ba'i me drod srung / yang na rgan byis dang pho ba'i me drod mi legs pa'i rigs la thog ma nas nyin rer gar nag dgu sbyor thengs gnyis re dang gnyan 'joms dgu ba thengs re'am thun chung re bsten pa yin/ sbrum ma dang phru gur gar nag dgu ba kho na btang ba yin/ gal te gso bya'i mchin par nad 'gyur byung 'dug pa'am na bzhin mchis na gong sman gnyis po'am de gnyis kyi gang mkho'i steng zhi byed sman g.yu rnying nyer lnga'am g.yu rnying cur nis/ zla bdud/ brag zhun lnga ba/ gur kum mchog bdun sogs mchin par phan pa'i gnyen po'i sman bsten zhing mchin mkhris kyi sbyongs gtong ba'am ru thung dang mchin mkhris 'doms rtsa sogs gtar bas kyang shin tu phan/ de bzhin yan lag gi tshigs na ba'am snying mi bde ba sogs byung na rang so so'i gnyen po bsten/ de ltar bgyis pas phan 'bras kyang mi dman pa byung mod/ gong sman gnyisapo thog mar gsar sbyor byas pa nas da lta'i yun der 'phri bsnon yang mang du bgyis shing / lan rer sngon ma'i sbyor tshad kyi nus pa las zhan du gyur ba'i skabs kyang phrad/ gang ltar yang bgyi ba 'di don du gnyer nas da lta'i yun dka' las mang po rgyab myong / thengs 'gar 'di ltar bgyis pa ni kun gyis khrel ba'i gzhir gyur 'dug snyam nas las ka 'di spel mtshams kyang 'jog par bgyis mod/ blo zhib mos bsam mno btang tshe rang nyid kyis 'di ltar bgyis na mkhas mang mgu ba'i gtam du gyur mi thub kyang / na mnyam 'ga' dang lhag par nad gzhi 'dis mnar ba'i gso bya 'gar cung pha/ sna'i

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/dge mtshan yang mchis srid pa 'dra bas mu mthud spel/ de yang deng rabs gso rig gi dgongs pa ltar na gnyan nad mchin ldem phog pa'i gso byar gso bcos ji ltar byas kyang phan 'bras mi 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/(1) ga'amyoganyan srin der sra 'khregs ldan pa'i phyi ngos spri dkar skyi thum zhig mchis shing / mchin pa'i srin phol (〉(mimagri)du zhugs rjes de ru 'phel bar byed/ sman rdzas kyi rdul rdzas ches phra ba mchin srin du zhugs nas gnyan srin gsod pa las rag pa'i rdzas gnas der slebs thabs bral/ de'i rkyen gyis nye sngon nad gzhi 'dir ched du spyod pa'i deng rabs kyi rdzas 'gyur sman rnams gnyan srin de'i 'phel mtshams 'jog byed yin pa las thad kur de gsod byed dam gzhom byed kyi sman sbyor min/ sman de rigs bsten skabs gnyanasrin 'di je mang du mi 'phel yang gnyan srin gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mchin pa'i srin phol sogs su yun ring sdod thub/ sman btung mtshams bzhag rjes slar yang 'phel srid/ gzhan gnyan mchin ldem gnyan srin mchin pa ma yin pa'i mkhal ma dang mtsher ba/ tshigs mig bcas su'ang bag tu nyal nas 'dug pa'am gnas de dag tu gong bzhin 'phel bar byed/(2)mkhrimyoganyan srin lus khams su 'phel skabs gso bya'i zungs stobs dang nad gzhi 'dir bsten pa'i sman gyi shugs rkyen 'og lus dang sman la goms shing lhan skyes kyi srin bu gang zhig dang bsdongs pas phyi'i rnam pa srin bu der mtshungs pa'i gnyan srin zhig tu'ang 'gyur srid/ de ltar brgyud 'gyur ba'i gnyan srin rigs gso bya'i lus nas tshar gcod byed rgyu khag(3) g.yaltoganyan srin mchin srin dang bsdongs shing yun lon na de gnyis lhan du 'dres pa las byung ba'i rigs shig thon zhing der yang gong bzhin bcos khag gong gi brjod tshul 'di ni gcig nas gnyan srin de'i gru/ snro| dang gnyis nas deng rabs gso rig gi gso bcos dgongs don

bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gzhir bzung nas bris pa tsam las/ bod sman gyi gnyen po dag sprad na nub lugs sman rdzas ltar srin bu'i khongs su 'dzul mi thub pa'i gnad don 'byung min rtogs thabs bral mod/ nad gzhi 'dir gong sman gnyis gtso bor bzung nas bcos na drag skyed dang sangs drag gi tshad gzhi yang shin tu mtho bas/ der gzhigs na sra mkhregs ldan pa'i phyi ngos skyi thum de'i khongs su yang zhugs thub bzhin par bsam/ de ni dper na/ yakhrigaganyan srin 'gos 'dug pa'i klu chu rdzong bod rigs slob chung gi a dkon 'dzin grwa'i slob ma bcu gsuma'i/ spyi lo 2002lo'i sbyi zla bzhi ba'i zla 'go nas lo de'i spyi zla bdun pa'i zla mjug bar gyi zla bzhi'i yun gnyan 'joms dgu ba dang gar nag dgu ba gnyis bsten nas bcos pa ste/ thog ma'i zla phyed ring gnyan 'joms dgu ba kho na btang rkyen byis pa re gnyis kyi grod pa cung na bar gyur/ byis pa bcu gsum po'i mchin nus la rdzas 'gyur gyis brtag pa'i cha rkyen ma 'dzoms kyang kho tsho tshang mar mchin pa na ba sogs kyi nad rtags ci yang med/ de nas byis pa so so'i pho ba'i me drod dang gnyan srin 'phel bzhin yod med bcas la gzhigs nas gnyen po de gnyis gang la gang 'tsham du bston rjes bskyar brtag byas pa na sangs drag gi tshad gzhi ha cang mtho bas/ gsham nas gso bya de dag la thog mar brtag pa'i dpyad 'bras dang zla bzhir gnyen po'i sman btung rjes kyi dpyad 'bras bcas re'u mig tu 'god pa la/121

gnyan nad mchin ldem gyi brtag bcos/bgyi ba 'di'i steng nas rgyal pham gyi tshor snang sna tshogs re myong dgos byung /dper na spyi lo 2005lo'i lo mgor klu chu'i slob ma tshor 22myoganyan srin 'gos 'dug min du rdzong rims 'gog sa tshugs dang khul rims 'gog sa tshugs gnyis mnyam 'brel byas nas mthayiganyan srin gyi phyi ngos skyi thum mam gcig pu gdags yin min du brtag rjes/ lo der brtag 'bras su gdags yin pa'i klu chu rdzong bod rigs slob chung gi slob ma lnga bcu nga drug la gong sman gnyis kyi sbyor bar 'gyur ldog cung btang nas zla bzhi'i yun bston du bcug kyang / byis pa drug gis sman de 'thung rjes kyi zla phyed kyi rjes nas grod pa na bar bshad/ byis pa gsum gyis btung rjes kyi nyin kha shas nas skyug mer langs par bshad/ de lta bu'i gnas tshul 'dra min re lhag rkyen kho tshos mu mthud btung med/ lo rjes mar sngar bzhin bskyar brtag byas pa'i mjug 'bras su mang che ba'i gdags yin pas/ skyi g.ya' ba'i mjug 'bras 'dis re zhig las ka 'di rgyun skyong ba'i brtas ba bral bar gyur/ 'on kyang bgrang bya du mar gnyer ba'i las ka 'di'i mjug skyong phyir slar yang gong gi sbyor ba gnyis la 'gyur ldog cung btang nas byis pa lnga bcu nga drug por zla bzhi rer rin skar gang yang ma blangs par btung du bcug lo rjes mar sngar bzhin bskyar brtag byas pa'i mjug 'bras su mang che ba'i sribasasu 'gyur 'dug thengs 'dir mthamyoganyan srin 'gos 'dug min du phyi ngos skyi thum mam kho na gdags yin par gzhi bcol nas brtag pa de yin la/gal te sribs yin zhing gzhan rnams gdags yin pa'i dbang du btang tshe de rigs rtogs thub kyin mi 'dug pas/ thengs 'dir sribs su 'gyur 'dug pa rnams sangs drag byung yod sogs kyi kha tshod ci yang gcod mi thub par ma zad/ sangs drag dang drag skyed sogs so so'i tshasdo sduzhi ga tshod 'dug ces pa'i sdom tshig kyang 'jog thabs bral yang /
snra shāgrinalha yibyedachung /mo/ 'gyu ཿgri shā skya(rdzu byi// ḍā dpyakā/skyabastu/dma rtsa / 〉〉sna/shān/ shā skyardo zlozlo nga/ bam/gon po don grub/
